title: Fahrzeug eines Medienunternehmens in Brand gesetzt
summary: A car belonging to a media company was set on fire on Knesebeckstraße in the night, destroying it almost completely. The police State Protection unit is investigating on suspicion of arson, as a political motive cannot be ruled out.

title: Transporter-Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 38-year-old van driver lost control on the A100 motorway in the tunnel section between Gradestraße and Britzer Damm, hitting the tunnel wall and an emergency exit. He died on 12 November from injuries sustained in the crash.

title: Hochschwangere Frau und ihre beiden Kinder wieder da
summary: A heavily pregnant 23-year-old woman and her two young sons, reported missing, have been found safe and well. They were located in the Tempelhof district on the evening before publication.

title: Mutmaßliche Wohnungseinbrecher auf frischer Tat festgenommen
summary: Three suspected burglars were arrested in an apartment in a multi-family building after neighbors reported noises and police found a damaged door lock. A folding knife was seized at the scene and stolen gold jewelry was found on the suspects.

title: Erstes Urteil gegen zwei Männer nach Schüssen in der Ebersstraße
summary: Court convicted two men on 10 November 2026 of attempted manslaughter over a March 2026 shooting of a 38-year-old man in Schöneberg; a third defendant was acquitted and the verdict is not yet final. The shooting itself injured the victim, who was not in mortal danger.

title: Festnahmen nach versuchtem Totschlag – Sieben Personen in Untersuchungshaft
summary: Attempted homicide: a 20-year-old man was shot at several times in Adlershof, and seven people have since been arrested and remanded in custody. The Mordkommission continues to investigate.

title: Sachbeschädigung mit Nahost-Bezug
summary: White paint lettering with a Middle East reference was found on a pavement below three Stolpersteine (memorial stones) on Kottbusser Damm around 5 p.m. Police removed the lettering, and investigations continue.

title: Handtaschenraub mit Schusswaffe
summary: An unknown man threatened an elderly woman and her companion with a firearm and snatched her handbag in Friedrichshain. The 78-year-old man was struck in the face and taken to hospital.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen des Verdachts des illegalen Waffenbesitzes – Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt und eine Festnahme
summary: Police and prosecutors searched three properties in Spandau and Prenzlauer Berg over illegal weapons possession. Eight illegal firearms, ammunition, phones, data storage devices and cash were seized, and a 28-year-old man was arrested.

title: Mann auf Parkplatz angefahren – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A hit-and-run driver struck a 75-year-old pedestrian on a supermarket car park in Hellersdorf and then drove off. The pedestrian suffered bruises and fractures; police are seeking witnesses.

title: Farbschmierereien mit politischem Bezug
summary: Politically motivated paint graffiti was found on the facade of a district citizens' office overnight. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Tötungsdelikt zum Nachteil der 13-jährigen Lisa T. – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen zu einem Fahrzeug
summary: A 13-year-old girl who disappeared on her way to school in Berlin-Marzahn on 3 November 2026 was found dead on 8 November 2026 in a vacant building in Altglietzen, Brandenburg. Police are seeking witnesses regarding a silver Citroën C5 estate suspected to have been used in the offence.

title: Regenbogenflagge beschädigt – Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: A rainbow flag hung in front of a library in Schöneberg was damaged by burning a hole in it and bending the flag bracket. The police Staatsschutz unit is investigating.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen des Verdachts des gewerbsmäßigen Bandenbetrugs im Gesundheitswesen
summary: Searches at 14 residential and commercial premises in Berlin, Brandenburg and Saxony targeted six suspects over alleged gang fraud against statutory health insurers via an occupational therapy practice. The alleged damage exceeds 6.7 million euros, and cash, documents, accounts and two vehicles were seized.

title: Mann mit Schussverletzung
summary: Around 2 a.m. police found a 40-year-old man with a gunshot wound to the leg in a residential building hallway in Schöneberg. Two firearms and ammunition were secured, and the victim was taken to hospital for emergency surgery.

title: Geldautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a cash machine in a supermarket vestibule in Friedrichsfelde at about 3:20 a.m. The machine was destroyed, nearby windows and a pharmacy were damaged, and nobody was hurt.

title: Zigarettenautomat aufgesprengt – mehrere Fahrzeuge beschädigt
summary: An explosion blew up a cigarette vending machine on a pavement in Marzahn, and debris damaged three parked vehicles nearby. Nobody was hurt, and cigarette packs were found around the machine.

title: Zwei verletzte Seniorinnen nach Stürzen im Bus – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A hit-and-run driver cut into the bus lane on Rhinstraße, forcing a BVG bus to brake hard. An 86-year-old passenger was seriously injured and an 83-year-old passenger was hurt in the fall.

title: Mann in der Schlange einer Essensausgabe verhetzend beleidigt
summary: A 29-year-old man was subjected to racist insults by a 35-year-old man while queuing at a charity food distribution point. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation for incitement-related insult, and the suspect received a police order to leave the area.

title: Mutmaßlichen Betäubungsmittellieferdienst nach Handyverstoß festgestellt
summary: Police stopped a 23-year-old driver after a phone-use violation and found suspected cocaine packaged for sale, cash and a pepper spray device in the car. The vehicle also lacked compulsory insurance, and a drug-trafficking investigation was opened.

title: Litfaßsäule einer Gedenkaktion beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons stuck stickers with pro-Palestinian references over the eyes of people depicted on a memorial campaign advertising column, and the images were damaged when the stickers were removed. The state security unit has taken over the investigation for property damage.

title: Verbotenes Kraftfahrzeugrennen endet mit Unfall
summary: A stolen car driven by an 18-year-old under the influence of drugs ran a red light during an unlicensed street race and crashed through a railing into the Landwehr Canal. Two former occupants had to be rescued from the water and were taken to hospital.

title: Teenagerin bewusstlos geschlagen - Zeugenaufruf
summary: A man allegedly approached a 17-year-old pedestrian near the Cecilienbrücke, threatened her with a firearm and struck her on the head with it, causing her to lose consciousness. Police are seeking witnesses.

title: Schüsse auf Fahrschule
summary: Several bullet holes were found in the door and facade of a driving school office in Wittenau, discovered around 10:30 on the morning before publication. Nobody was injured, and the state criminal police task force has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann flüchtet nach Messerangriff zu Polizeikräften - Zwei Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: A 19-year-old man was stabbed near Münsinger Park in Spandau after being held by another man. He fled to a passing police car, and two suspects were arrested.

title: Raubüberfall mit Hammer
summary: Three unknown men attacked a 27-year-old man with a hammer in Friedrichshain and stole his valuables. The victim suffered leg and torso injuries and was treated as an outpatient.

title: Flagge der deutschen Einheit zu Boden geworfen
summary: A 22-year-old man climbed the national monument on Platz der Republik, removed the German unity flag and replaced it with a Palestinian flag, supported by two other men. Police detained the men, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Verletzter nach Schussabgaben
summary: A 45-year-old man was shot in the leg in front of an apartment building entrance after a verbal dispute with two unknown men. The suspects fled toward Kantstraße.

title: Fußgänger nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: An 85-year-old pedestrian hit by a car while crossing Ziekowstraße in Tegel died in hospital on 8 November. The driver was an 86-year-old man in a small car.

title: Durch Messerangriffe verletzte Männer
summary: Two men were stabbed in separate knife attacks around Schlesisches Tor in Kreuzberg overnight and early in the morning. Both were taken to hospital, and police are investigating whether the cases are connected.

title: Volksverhetzende Musik abgespielt
summary: Two teenagers were reported for playing inflammatory extremist music loudly in a park in Köpenick. Police seized one teen's mobile phone, and the Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: In Brand gesetzt
summary: After an argument over alleged sexual harassment, a 24-year-old allegedly doused an 18-year-old with a flammable liquid and set him on fire. The 18-year-old suffered burns and the suspect was arrested nearby.

title: Handyortung überführt mutmaßliche Taschendiebe
summary: A 27-year-old woman's mobile phone was stolen by pickpockets on a tram near Warschauer Brücke around 1 a.m. The phone was located in a venue on Rathausstraße, where two suspects were arrested and the phone was recovered.

title: Schnittverletzungen an Händen und einem Bein
summary: A 25-year-old man was found with multiple cut injuries to both hands and a leg after an altercation in which an unknown man allegedly held a knife-like object. The suspect reportedly fled by car toward Oberspreestraße.

title: Überfall in Wohnung – Täterinnen flüchten mit Beute
summary: Three women forced their way into a 92-year-old man's apartment in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, held him down and fled with stolen property. The victim suffered arm injuries and was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Bildungs- und Kunstprojekt beschädigt
summary: A double-decker bus used as a democracy education and art project was found damaged, with several windows and two doors broken, parked at Olympischer Platz. Police assume a political motive and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfallflucht – Mann im Krankenhaus
summary: After a collision at a turn in Friedrichshain around 1 a.m., the driver of a VW fled the scene while the 35-year-old Opel driver was hospitalized with injuries. Investigations were taken over by a traffic offences unit.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen des Verdachts des bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels vollstreckt – vierzehn Festnahmen
summary: Police and prosecutors executed 28 search warrants in Berlin and Brandenburg against a suspected gang dealing drugs from bunker apartments. Fourteen suspects were provisionally arrested, and drugs, cash, knives and a blank-firing gun were seized.

title: Bewaffneter Überfall auf Tankstelle
summary: A masked, armed man robbed a petrol station employee in Wedding, demanding the cash register contents. He fled and dropped the empty till, which police recovered nearby.

title: Vermisster Senior verstorben
summary: A 74-year-old man reported missing since 3 November 2026 was found dead in Mitte on the morning of 5 November. Police see no indication of third-party involvement.

title: Mann durch Schüsse schwer verletzt
summary: A 22-year-old man was shot several times on Seestraße in Wedding and taken to hospital. The 5th Homicide Squad is investigating a suspected attempted killing.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit gestohlenem Motorrad und ohne Führerschein
summary: A 25-year-old motorcyclist was injured after colliding with a car while changing lanes in Friedrichsfelde. He had no driving licence, had taken drugs, and the motorcycle was reported stolen.

title: Polizist bestohlen - Festnahme
summary: An off-duty police officer caught a suspected pickpocket who had opened his backpack in Schöneberg; a second off-duty officer assisted, and the suspect resisted arrest. A pepper spray and a pocket knife were seized.

title: Politiker tot im Hotelzimmer aufgefunden – Todesermittlungsverfahren eingeleitet
summary: A politician was found dead in a hotel room in Mitte, and a death investigation has been opened by the homicide unit. Police are working to determine the cause of death and rule out third-party involvement.

title: Randalierende Frau verletzt Security-Mitarbeiter und zwei Polizeikräfte
summary: A 39-year-old woman entered a men's hostel without permission, threw glass bottles and struck a security guard with a traffic sign, then attacked a police officer and resisted arrest. Two police officers and one security employee were injured.

title: Schaufenster eingeschlagen und Schmuck entwendet
summary: Two masked people smashed a jewelry shop display window with a shovel in Wedding and took jewelry before fleeing by car. The getaway car had stolen number plates.

title: Schuss auf Reifen eines flüchtenden Fahrzeugs
summary: After a traffic stop attempt, a 44-year-old driver fled through Charlottenburg with police in pursuit, causing several accidents. An officer fired a shot at a tire of the car, and the driver and his 43-year-old passenger were arrested; nobody was injured.

title: Tierskulpturen im Großen Tiergarten beschmiert
summary: Two animal sculptures in the Großer Tiergarten were smeared with red paint containing inflammatory hate speech. Police removed the writing, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Fanschal geraubt – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A suspect allegedly tore a football scarf from a 25-year-old man's neck on a subway platform shortly after 1 a.m. Police are asking the public for information.

title: Mutmaßlicher Räuber festgenommen
summary: A masked man allegedly committed four robberies of flower and other shops in Charlottenburg on the evening of 2 November, with one robbery on Wilmersdorfer Straße. He was arrested in a courtyard on Schillerstraße after a passer-by alerted police.

title: Festnahme in Wohnung
summary: Two women suspected of fraud were arrested at an 84-year-old woman's apartment while collecting money she had been tricked into handing over. The victim reported the scam to police the day before the arrest.

title: Mann bei Angriff im Gesicht verletzt
summary: A 38-year-old man was punched in the face by an unknown attacker at Münsinger Park and taken to hospital with a serious facial wound. The attacker fled and the investigation was taken over by a specialist unit.

title: Farbschmierereien mit politischem Hintergrund
summary: Several large graffiti were sprayed on the courtyard of a residential and commercial building in Kreuzberg, reported via the online police portal. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Feuer in einem Café – Personen durch Rauchgase verletzt
summary: A fire broke out in the women's toilet of a café on Residenzstraße, cause unknown; an employee opened the emergency exit and smoke entered the stairwell. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation, and police are investigating suspected attempted arson.

title: Raub auf Tankstelle
summary: Two masked men robbed a petrol station in Köpenick at night, and one fired a shot into the ceiling with a suspected blank-firing gun before taking cash. Nobody was injured.

title: Schussabgabe auf Gewerbegelände
summary: Bullet holes were found in the roller door of a rented garage on a commercial site in Neukölln. No people were present when the shots were fired, and the police state group BAO Ferrum is investigating.

title: Polizeieinsatz nach Entfernung eines Patienten aus Rettungsstelle
summary: A 42-year-old man in a mental health crisis left a hospital emergency room and was located by police after he initially resisted; he was taken to hospital and admitted. A storm lighter was found in his hand and no one was hurt.

title: Unbekannte werfen Steine auf Straßenbahnen
summary: Unknown persons threw stones at two tram cars in Marzahn, breaking windows while passengers were on board. No one was hurt, and both trams were taken out of service.

title: Bilanzmeldung zum stadtweiten Einsatzgeschehen "Halloween"
summary: Berlin police summarised Halloween operations citywide, with illegal fireworks, arson attempts, thrown objects at police and transit vehicles, and 16 arrests. Incidents included a Molotov cocktail thrown at a police vehicle and several burning bins.

title: Böller und Brandsatz in Kneipe geworfen
summary: An incendiary device was thrown into a bar in Juliusstraße in the evening after a masked person opened the door. The device did not ignite, and nobody was injured.

title: Schüsse vor Restaurant
summary: Several shots were fired from a vehicle in front of a restaurant in Knesebeckstraße shortly before 5 a.m., after an earlier dispute in which an employee was threatened with a firearm. No one inside was injured, and the perpetrators fled; casings were secured.

title: Bürgerbüro beschmiert
summary: Paint graffiti was sprayed on the outer facade and glazing of a citizens' office in Britz. The police political crime unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired at an apartment building in Lankwitz overnight; several bullet holes were found in the front door and adjacent glass. No one was injured.

title: Queerfeindliche Straftaten – Streit im Fitnessstudio und Vorfall an einem Bahnhof
summary: A 30-year-old was verbally abused and threatened with a raised hand in a gym's changing area in an anti-queer attack; the suspect left before police arrived. Staatsschutz is investigating a politically motivated threat case. A second anti-queer incident the same day at Landsberger Allee involved a knife shown and kicking gestures; the suspects fled.

title: Senior fährt gegen Baum
summary: An 86-year-old driver lost consciousness briefly and crashed into a tree on Spandauer Damm in Westend. He and his 85-year-old wife, the passenger, were injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach mutmaßlicher Trunkenheitsfahrt – zwei Frauen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 24-year-old driver allegedly under the influence and speeding collided with another car on Alt-Friedrichsfelde shortly after midnight. Two women were injured and taken to hospital; the driver had about 1.7 per mille.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus
summary: A motorcyclist was injured after a collision with a car at the junction of Gitschiner Straße and Prinzenstraße in Kreuzberg. He was taken to hospital for treatment of a head injury.

title: Verhaltensauffällige Frau sticht einem Polizisten bei Widerstandshandlungen in den Arm
summary: During an emergency psychiatric transport in Prenzlauer Berg, a woman stabbed at police officers during her arrest. A police officer was injured in the arm and was treated at a hospital.

title: DEIG-Einsatz gegen Randalierer
summary: A 35-year-old man repeatedly struck parked cars with a wooden batten in Tegel and threatened passers-by and officers with a glass bottle. Police used a taser, which had no effect, and then overpowered him and took him to hospital.

title: Schwerer Raub auf Tankstelle
summary: Two unknown suspects threatened a 53-year-old gas station employee with a firearm and forced her to open the cash register. They took the cash and fled.

title: Unfall zwischen Fahrrad und E-Scooter – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A cyclist was hit head-on on the bike lane of Großbeerenstraße by an e-scooter that had ridden onto it from the pavement; the two e-scooter riders fled the scene. The 54-year-old cyclist suffered several fractures and was hospitalized.

title: Pyrotechnische Gegenstände und sogenannte Selbstlaborate beschlagnahmt
summary: Police searched a flat in Neukölln under the Explosives Act and arrested a 24-year-old suspect, seizing about six kilograms of net explosive mass, self-made explosive preparations, a knuckle-duster and a knife. The investigation continues.

title: Farbschmiererei an Parteibüro
summary: Paint was sprayed on a window frame of a party office at Cecilienplatz in Hellersdorf. The political police unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall in Mitte
summary: A taxi driver died after a collision on Torstraße shortly after midnight when a car driven by a 38-year-old man, who was under the influence of alcohol, hit the taxi while it was turning. The 38-year-old driver and his 29-year-old passenger were injured.

title: Einschusslöcher an Pkw festgestellt
summary: Bullet holes were found in a car parked on Obstallee in Staaken on the morning of 28 October. No one was hurt, and police secured the vehicle for evidence.

title: Polizist bei Verkehrsunfall von Regelungstonne geschleudert
summary: At a crossing with a failed traffic light that police were manually directing, two cars collided and a police officer was thrown from a pedestal onto the road. The officer was taken to hospital and admitted.

title: Explosion auf Balkon eines Mehrfamilienhauses
summary: An explosion occurred on a balcony of an apartment building in Tempelhof overnight. No one was injured, and the state criminal police explosives unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann durch Schüsse lebensgefährlich verletzt – Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 31-year-old man was seriously injured after several shots were fired at him in Lichtenrade. A homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing, and the unknown perpetrator fled.

title: Festnahme nach Schüssen auf ein Auto
summary: After a car was forced off the road in Spandau, a person fired a firearm several times at the vehicle and the 29-year-old driver was beaten and kicked. Four suspects aged 21 to 31 were arrested at the scene.

title: Autofahrer flüchtet vor Verkehrskontrolle – Polizeibeamter verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old driver fled a traffic check in Mariendorf, driving into bushes and a parked car and accelerating while an officer stood on the bonnet. The officer was injured in a fall and the driver was later found at a hospital; he had no valid driving licence.

title: Autofahrer prallt gegen Baum und Lichtmast
summary: A 50-year-old driver left the road on Vulkanstraße in Fennpfuhl shortly after midnight and crashed into a tree and a light pole. The driver was seriously injured and taken to hospital, and the car was written off.

title: Festnahme nach Handel mit Pyrotechnik
summary: A teenager was arrested for illegally selling fireworks after pepper-spraying officers and bystanders during the attempted escape. Over 2,000 pyrotechnic items, a blank-firing gun, a knife and forged documents were seized from his home.

title: Lkw-Fahrerin fährt Fußgängerin um
summary: A truck turned right into Prinzenallee and struck a 31-year-old pedestrian crossing from Badstraße, running over her in part. The woman was seriously injured and taken to hospital for emergency surgery.

title: Schuss durch Wohnungstür
summary: Overnight, a closed apartment door in a residential building in Lankwitz was apparently shot at. The resident found a bullet hole, and police secured a projectile and a cartridge case; nobody was hurt.

title: Geldautomat auf U-Bahnsteig gesprengt
summary: Two men sprayed surveillance cameras with paint and blew up a freestanding cash machine at the Gneisenaustraße subway station around 2:30 a.m. The station was closed to passengers during the investigation.

title: Stichverletzung nach körperlicher Auseinandersetzung
summary: Police separated two men in a physical fight on Tempelhofer Damm in the evening. One man, aged 24, had a stab wound to the upper body and was taken to hospital; a knife was found in a nearby parked car.

title: Ermittlungen nach mutmaßlichem Schuss auf Wohnungstür
summary: Shots were fired at an apartment door in a residential building, leaving a bullet hole in the door and in a refrigerator behind it. A cartridge case was found in the stairwell; nobody was injured.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt – Festnahme
summary: A 47-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 42-year-old man in the upper body on Oderberger Straße in the evening. The suspect was arrested in a nearby bar and the knife was seized.

title: Mit gestohlenem Roller vor Polizei geflüchtet - Festnahmen
summary: Two suspected scooter thieves fled from police on a stolen scooter, ran red lights and crashed into a police vehicle. Both were arrested with minor injuries and released after police measures.

title: Mutmaßlich antisemitisch motivierte Körperverletzung
summary: A 60-year-old man was attacked on a park bench in Schöneberg after being asked whether he is Jewish and subjected to antisemitic remarks. He suffered facial bruises and a cut, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Wohnungsbrand - toter Mann aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out in a flat in Reinickendorf and firefighters found the body of a 27-year-old male tenant. Police say there is no indication of third-party involvement so far, and the cause of death is still under investigation.

title: Einsatz nach Bedrohung endet mit Angriff auf Polizeibeamten
summary: After a hotel guest threatened hotel staff early in the morning, a 17-year-old struck a police officer in the face with a beer can, and officers also restrained the 47-year-old guest. The officer suffered facial injuries and was treated in hospital.

title: Schussabgabe auf Bar
summary: Several shots were fired at the front windows of a bar in Wilmersdorf around 6:30 a.m., damaging the windows. People inside were not injured, and police secured cartridge casings.

title: Zwei Männer mit Messer verletzt
summary: Three unknown attackers were refused entry to a bar in Pannierstraße, attacked a female employee and then stabbed two men who came to her aid. Both men were injured, were operated on and are not in danger of their lives.

title: Fahrzeuge durch Brand beschädigt
summary: A motorhome parked on Sonnenallee was set on fire and two other vehicles were damaged by the flames. Police and fire brigade responded, and the road was closed for about an hour.

title: Informationstafel zerkratzt – Sachbeschädigung mit antisemitischem Hintergrund
summary: An unknown person scratched an information board at a library entrance with a broken beer bottle and made antisemitic remarks. The Staatsschutz (political crime unit) has taken over the investigation.

title: Zwei Festnahmen nach Graffiti-Schmiererei
summary: Police arrested two suspected graffiti sprayers after six people were seen spraying paint on subway cars on a rail siding between two U-Bahn stations overnight. Four others fled, and evidence including spray cans was seized.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe nach Flucht vor der Polizei beschlagnahmt
summary: After a fleeing car was stopped near Charlottenburger Chaussee, police arrested the 20-year-old driver, who had a loaded firearm in his waistband, and seized the car with forged plates. The driver faces charges including illegal street racing and weapons offences.

title: Radfahrer verstorben
summary: A 71-year-old cyclist fell in Weißensee and later died of his injuries in hospital. Police are still investigating how the fall happened.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung im Straßenverkehr verletzt
summary: After a verbal dispute between drivers at a red light, two 20-year-old men allegedly punched a 25-year-old driver and sprayed irritant gas at him. Both suspects were arrested at the scene, and the victim suffered facial bruises and eye and airway irritation.

title: Auffahrunfall auf der Stadtautobahn – elf Verletzte
summary: A truck crashed into a traffic jam on the urban motorway BAB 100 in Tempelhof, colliding with eight other vehicles. Eleven people were injured, and the motorway was fully closed until 6 a.m.

title: Prävention im Fokus: Polizei Berlin lädt zur Sonderberatung am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026 ein
summary: Police and a carpentry guild invite the public to a free burglary-prevention consultation at police headquarters on 25 October 2026. A demonstration of a break-in attempt on a security window is planned for 13:00.

title: Nachbarschaftsstreit in Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A neighbour dispute in an apartment building in Britz escalated into threats, with one man allegedly approaching with an axe-like object and another imitating loading a firearm. Two suspects were arrested, and police later searched their homes and seized additional weapons and prescription medication; two officers were hurt while handling a cat.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Rollerfahrer verletzt
summary: A car and a scooter collided at a junction in Friedenau while turning onto Hauptstraße. The 56-year-old scooter rider was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Mann durch Stich ins Gesäß verletzt
summary: A 20-year-old man was stabbed in the buttock in the courtyard of a school in Donaustraße overnight. He was taken to hospital and admitted; no suspects were found at the scene.

title: Messerangriff in Hellersdorf
summary: An 18-year-old was stabbed by several unknown assailants in the Hellwichstorp park area in Hellersdorf and taken to hospital. The suspects fled toward Hellersdorf subway station.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung im Straßenverkehr
summary: After a dispute over a lane change, two occupants of a van got out and attacked a 22-year-old cyclist, who was struck with a metal rod. The cyclist was hurt in the arm and hand and declined immediate medical treatment.

title: Fußgänger bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A car hit a 43-year-old pedestrian who stepped into the road on Stralauer Straße in the evening, after emergency braking. A following car then collided with the first vehicle; the pedestrian was taken to hospital with a broken leg and head wound, and two occupants of the second car were treated at the scene.

title: Unbekannte Personen stehlen Fahrräder und flüchten vor der Polizei
summary: Unknown persons loaded stolen bicycles into a van in Kladow and fled from police, who later stopped the vehicle on Kladower Damm. Five occupants escaped on foot, and a female resident lost consciousness during the search and was taken to hospital.

title: Flucht mit E-Scootern endet mit Festnahmen
summary: Two 15-year-old boys fleeing police on E-scooters at high speed were arrested after near-collisions with pursuing patrol cars. A 45-year-old father was pepper-sprayed during the arrest after allegedly attacking officers.

title: An Bushaltestelle angefahren
summary: A 72-year-old woman was struck by the right mirror of a bus at a bus stop in Mariendorf shortly before 18:00. She suffered fractures to her legs and hip and was admitted to hospital.

title: In Wohnung gewürgt – Täter flüchtet
summary: A 61-year-old man was attacked and strangled in his apartment by a previously unknown acquaintance, who fled after the man reached for a kitchen knife. The victim suffered head and shoulder injuries and was hospitalized.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Flucht – Motorrad überschlägt sich
summary: A 17-year-old motorcyclist collided with a car at a junction in Marzahn and crashed after the bike overturned. The car driver fled the scene without stopping.

title: Fahrzeuge durch Brand beschädigt
summary: Overnight, a car burned at the edge of the roadway in Buckow, damaging a second vehicle and a mobile lifting platform. Firefighters extinguished the blaze and nobody was injured.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: After a brawl outside a late-night shop, several people beat and kicked a man in the head, leaving him in life-threatening condition; the homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing. Police are seeking witnesses and information about a dark car used by the suspects.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenkäufer leistet Widerstand und verletzt Polizeikräfte
summary: Plainclothes officers observed a suspected drug deal in Hakenfelde. The suspected buyer, a 57-year-old man, resisted arrest, struck an officer and injured him and a female officer.

title: Mutmaßlicher Wohnungseinbrecher festgenommen
summary: A 30-year-old suspect was arrested after attempting two burglaries in Britz via terrace doors on the same street. Both residents discovered him and he was caught nearby.

title: Polizeiliche Maßnahmen wegen des Verdachts der Arzneimittelkriminalität
summary: Police executed a search warrant at a property in Naunynstraße over suspected illegal trade in prescription medicines, finding medicines, narcotics, data carriers and cash. About 140 people gathered in a protest, with verbal protests and an attempt to open a screen; one person was given a police exclusion order and nobody was hurt.

title: Beifahrerin ebenfalls im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: An 82-year-old driver collided with another car at an intersection in Spandau and later died in hospital; his 84-year-old passenger also died of her injuries two days later. The other driver was unhurt.

title: Öffentlichkeitsfahndung nach gefährlicher Körperverletzung erfolgreich
summary: On a U6 platform at Alt-Mariendorf station, two men allegedly insulted a 30-year-old man in a homophobic manner and assaulted him, also injuring a witness and a bystander. Two 18-year-old suspects have since surrendered to police.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit drei Beteiligten
summary: A car driver allegedly entered a red light at a junction in Fennpfuhl and collided with another car, with a cyclist also hit in the crossing. Three people were hurt, including the driver, who was found to have about 1.6 per mille alcohol and no valid driving licence.

title: Falscher Paketbote und Komplizen rauben Frau aus
summary: Three men, one posing as a parcel courier, forced their way into a 74-year-old woman's apartment, knocked her to the ground, threatened her and stole jewelry. She complained of neck pain but did not need medical treatment.

title: Motorradfahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car turning at a median gap on Mehringdamm collided with an oncoming motorcyclist, who crashed while braking hard and slid across the road. The 20-year-old woman was taken to hospital with a suspected spinal injury.

title: Fußgängerin nach Zusammenstoß mit Auto verletzt
summary: A pedestrian crossing Berliner Straße from a tram stop was hit by a car in the right lane and suffered a serious foot injury. The 69-year-old driver was unhurt, and a bus driver had avoided an earlier collision by braking.

title: Scheibe mit Stein eingeworfen
summary: Unknown persons allegedly threw a stone through the display window of a coffee chain branch overnight. The police Staatsschutz is investigating a possible political motive.

title: Fußgängerin mit Gesichtsverletzungen in Krankenhaus gebracht
summary: A truck driver's exterior mirror struck a 23-year-old pedestrian in the face while she was crossing Heerstraße at a traffic light in Staaken. She was taken to hospital with suspected facial fracture and head injury.

title: Kind nach Unfall im Krankenhaus
summary: A car driver hit a four-year-old girl who allegedly ran into the road in Rosenthal. The girl suffered abrasions and a suspected head injury and was taken to hospital; the driver and his passenger were unhurt.

title: 82-Jähriger nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: An 82-year-old driver collided with a car at the Prisdorfer Straße/Brunsbütteler Damm crossing in Spandau and later died in hospital. His 84-year-old wife and the 28-year-old other driver were also involved; the wife was seriously injured and the other driver was unhurt.

title: Polizeibeamter bei Verkehrskontrolle angegriffen
summary: During a traffic check in Westend, a 20-year-old driver fled and sprayed irritant spray at a police officer, who fell and was hurt. The suspect was later arrested and two irritant spray devices were seized.

title: Erneut Schüsse auf Café
summary: Shots were fired from a car at a closed café on Silbersteinstraße early in the morning, damaging its shop window. Nobody was hurt, and the LKA task force BAO Ferrum has taken over the investigation.

title: Festnahmen nach Angriff auf Heranwachsende
summary: Two 18-year-olds were attacked by a group of youths in Wilmersdorf; one was stabbed in the back and the other was robbed of his phone, bank card and music box. Two suspects were arrested nearby and a third fled.

title: Mann mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 24-year-old man was attacked by three unknown men near a bus stop and suffered stab wounds to his back and leg. He was taken to hospital, and police say his life was not in danger.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car driver hit a pedestrian crossing the Falkenberger Chaussee in Neu-Hohenschönhausen on the evening before publication. The pedestrian, 47, was taken to hospital with a suspected head injury and a head wound; he had about 1.8 per mille alcohol.

title: Kleinkrafträder gestohlen - Festnahmen
summary: Two teenagers suspected of scooter theft were arrested after police stopped them on a stolen small motorcycle in Johannisthal. A second stolen scooter was recovered from Hubertusstraße.

title: Schlag gegen mutmaßliche kriminelle Vereinigung – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt sowie Vermögenswerte in Millionenhöhe gesichert
summary: Police and prosecutors raided 16 properties in Berlin and Brandenburg against four suspects accused of money laundering through a network of front companies and bank accounts. Around 2 million euros were secured, and a firearm, gold, cash and a Lamborghini were seized.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Parteibüros – eine Festnahme
summary: Overnight, political posters were put up on several party offices in Britz, Kreuzberg and Wilmersdorf, causing property damage. One 25-year-old woman was provisionally arrested and later released, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfall – beim Fahrstreifenwechsel Motorradfahrer übersehen
summary: A car driver changing lanes on Heerstraße in Westend overlooked a motorcyclist, who was thrown from his bike and taken to hospital. The 65-year-old motorcyclist suffered bruises and leg injuries.

title: Mann bedroht Ehefrau und Kinder – Festnahme
summary: A man threatened to kill his wife and three children at a single-family home in Altglienicke, and the wife and children locked themselves in a bedroom. Special operations police arrested the 52-year-old man, who was slightly injured, and a no-return order was issued against him.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Fahrerflucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A car ran a red light at the Kreuzbergstraße/Großbeerenstraße junction at about 5:35 a.m. and crashed head-on into a waiting Hyundai; the driver was injured and the two occupants of the first car fled on foot. Police are asking witnesses to come forward.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Schüsse
summary: Suspected bullet holes were found in the shop windows of a flower shop in Wilmersdorf, damage that occurred overnight. A similar incident occurred at the same shop last month; both are being investigated by a state criminal police task force.

title: Brandstiftung auf Fahrbahn
summary: Unknown masked people set fire to e-scooters and debris in the middle of the Rigaer Straße/Liebigstraße crossing shortly before midnight, damaging the road and a street lamp. The police state security unit (Staatsschutz) is investigating.

title: Schussabgabe eines Polizeibeamten
summary: A police officer fired a shot at a 40-year-old driver who fled and allegedly drove at an officer during a stop after dangerous driving through Mitte. The driver was hit in the leg and taken to hospital.

title: Verdacht der Beihilfe zum Computerbetrug – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors executed search warrants and arrest warrants in Germany, Serbia and North Rhine-Westphalia against suspects accused of aiding computer fraud via a spoofed-number VoIP service. Domains, servers and Telegram accounts of the criminal platform were seized and shut down.

title: Schüsse auf Café
summary: Several men reportedly fired shots at a closed café in Neukölln overnight; bullet holes were found in a building facade and the café's shop window. Nobody was injured, and a black car with several occupants was seen leaving at high speed.

title: Mutmaßlicher Einbrecher festgenommen
summary: Witnesses heard a shop window break at a convenience store and saw a man leave; police arrested a 39-year-old suspect nearby with allegedly stolen goods.

title: Ermittlungen der BAO Ferrum nach mutmaßlicher Sprengstoffexplosion
summary: Suspected explosive device detonated overnight at Stuttgarter Platz, damaging two vehicles, a third vehicle and apartment windows nearby. The state criminal police task force BAO Ferrum took over the investigation.

title: Vorrichtungen zum Anbringen von versteckten Kameras entdeckt
summary: Police seized several suspected devices for hidden cameras found in women's restrooms at a university campus in Friedrichsfelde after a witness reported them. No cameras were found and investigations are ongoing.

title: Festnahmen und Haftbefehle wegen mutmaßlichen schweren Bandendiebstahls
summary: Four men aged 21 to 28 were arrested in Britz while loading allegedly stolen car rims from vehicles at a car workshop. Arrest warrants were issued after the suspects were brought before a judge on 7 October.

title: Auf gestohlenem Motorrad eingeschlafen - Festnahme
summary: Passers-by found a man asleep on a motorcycle at Kranoldplatz in the early hours and alerted police. The Honda was believed stolen earlier in the week, and a 21-year-old was arrested.

title: 3. Seniorensicherheitstag 2026 der Polizei Berlin
summary: Berlin police announce the 3rd Senior Safety Day on 13 October 2026, with crime and traffic prevention events at several locations across the city. Events include a market stand in Spandau, a Biesdorf-Center event in Marzahn and a truck-based turning-safety session in Friedrichshain.

title: Schussabgaben auf Einfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired around 7 a.m. on Borgsdorfer Straße in the Märkisches Viertel, leaving bullet holes in a house façade. Two people reportedly fled in a vehicle; nobody was injured.

title: Vermisste Frau wieder da
summary: A 38-year-old woman reported missing after leaving her hotel on the morning of 11 October 2026 has been found alive in a hospital. The police had earlier asked for public help in the search.

title: Zeugenaufruf zu versuchtem Tötungsdelikt
summary: On the morning of 5 October 2026, a 40-year-old man was attacked with a knife-like object on a commercial site in Lichtenberg and seriously injured; a suspect, 53, later turned himself in. The 1st Homicide Commission is investigating the attempted killing and appealing for witnesses.

title: 19-Jähriger von Unbekannten angegriffen
summary: In the early hours of the night before Sunday, a 19-year-old man was beaten by three unknown attackers in Köpenick and left the scene. He was later identified and is in hospital with a cheekbone fracture.

title: Seniorin um Bankkarte betrogen – Wer erkennt die Tatverdächtigen?
summary: A 66-year-old woman was tricked by a phone caller posing as a bank employee into handing over her bank card and PIN; a man collected the card at her flat and cash was withdrawn at a bank branch. Police are seeking two unknown suspects via CCTV images.

title: Zwei gegen Einen
summary: Children aged 10 to 12 were involved in a fight at a car park in Marzahn; a 10-year-old was kicked in the head and taken to hospital. Two suspects were detained by witnesses until police arrived and later also assaulted the witnesses.

title: Fahrer eines Leichtkraftrades bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 50-year-old light motorcycle rider was seriously injured in a collision with a car at a junction in Oberschöneweide. The car driver, also 50, was involved, and the investigation into the cause continues.

title: Stichverletzung im Oberkörper – lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: After a dispute, a 29-year-old man was repeatedly stabbed in the upper body by an unknown assailant in Neu-Hohenschönhausen and remains in life-threatening condition. A pepper spray attack injured a 14-year-old girl, and the group of suspects fled.

title: Alkoholisierter Mann schlägt Nachbarn, greift Polizeibeamte an und leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: A drunk man hit his neighbour with a key ring in a residential building in Gesundbrunnen, then resisted arrest and was subdued with a stun device (DEIG). Police officers were not injured.

title: Mann niedergeschlagen – lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: After a brief collision on the street, an 18-year-old allegedly punched a 49-year-old man unconscious, causing him to hit his head on the pavement. The victim suffered a life-threatening head injury and underwent emergency surgery; the suspect was held by witnesses until police arrived.

title: Kind wird von Jugendgruppe bedroht und beraubt
summary: A group of four to six youths threatened a 13-year-old child and robbed them of a small amount of money and their jacket at Spandau town hall square. The child was not physically injured.

title: Auseinandersetzung zwischen zwei Männergruppen
summary: Two groups of about ten men fought outside a nightclub in Tiergarten; a 29-year-old was chased, beaten and kicked while on the ground and later lost consciousness. Five men were arrested after the group scattered.

title: Fahrradfahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 12-year-old girl on a bicycle collided with a car at a junction on Tempelhofer Damm in the morning. She suffered head, back and pelvis injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Jugendlicher fährt gegen wartendes Auto und verletzt sich am Kopf
summary: A 17-year-old cyclist rode into the back of a waiting car at an intersection in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, breaking the rear window. The cyclist suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Mann durch Messerstiche verletzt
summary: An unknown man attacked a 27-year-old man with a knife on Unionstraße in Moabit and fled. The victim was treated by witnesses and taken to hospital by paramedics.

title: Einsatzwagen der Polizei geriet ins Schlingern
summary: A police patrol car with emergency signals lost control in the Flughafen Tegel tunnel on the A111 and hit the tunnel wall. The crew was not injured, but the vehicle is no longer roadworthy and the motorway was closed until about 21:30.

title: Frau wird von Sattelzug angefahren und tödlich verletzt
summary: A 59-year-old woman was fatally struck by a semi-trailer truck while crossing Holländerstraße in Wedding. The truck driver left the scene without stopping.

title: Aus mutmaßlich antisemitischen Gründen wiederholt beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: Repeated insults and pepper-spray attacks against a 67-year-old shop owner who displayed posters against antisemitism, with the latest attack on 9 October 2026. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Einfamilienhaus
summary: Several shots were fired at a single-family house in Rudow around 3:15 a.m. The unknown perpetrator fled, and bullet holes were found in the glass front of the entrance door; no one was injured.

title: Seniorin betrogen – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Fraudsters posing as bank and police officials phoned an 81-year-old woman, then entered her flat and took jewelry and coins. A bank card was also used at an ATM at Hermannplatz before it could be blocked.

title: Autofahrer verursacht mehrere Verkehrsunfälle mit hohem Sachschaden
summary: An audi driver caused a hit-and-run collision in Alt-Hohenschönhausen and then a second crash on Buschallee in Weißensee, where a car burned out and ten parked vehicles were damaged. Two people, the driver and a 64-year-old woman, were injured.

title: Bilanz zur Versammlungslage mit Bezug zum Nahostkonflikt vom 7. Oktober 2026
summary: Police summarized the Berlin demonstrations on the third anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel; eight pro-Israeli and two pro-Palestinian assemblies were policed. A pro-Palestinian march was dissolved early after antisemitic chants, assaults on officers and other offences; 46 criminal proceedings were opened and four officers were injured.

title: Drei Fahrzeuge auf Parkplatz in Brand geraten
summary: Three vehicles caught fire on a public parking lot in Alt-Hohenschönhausen overnight; two were completely burned out. Nobody was hurt, and a fire-investigation unit is probing suspected arson.

title: Radfahrer von Lkw-Fahrer angefahren
summary: A 79-year-old truck driver turned left on Franklinstraße and hit a cyclist, who was seriously injured. The road was closed to traffic for about three hours during the police investigation.

title: Versuchte schwere Brandstiftung
summary: Unknown perpetrators smashed a window of an apartment in Silbersteinstraße at around 0:30 and threw in pyrotechnics and burning objects, setting a mattress on fire. A 24-year-old man in the room threw the burning items out and was hurt on the hand.

title: Einsatzkräfte mit Steinen und Pyrotechnik angegriffen
summary: Unknown persons attacked police officers in Rigaer Straße with stones and pyrotechnics after burning tyres and wood were set on the road. One officer suffered a blast injury and had to end their shift; the Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Fußgänger verstorben
summary: An 85-year-old pedestrian struck by a reversing vehicle on Berliner Straße in Zehlendorf on 13 September 2026 died in hospital the following evening. The driver of a service vehicle was involved in the collision.

title: Nach Fund von Kameras in Damentoiletten – Durchsuchung bei Tatverdächtigem
summary: Police searched the home of a 66-year-old man suspected of secretly filming in women's restrooms at a university campus; the cameras had been found there on 10 June 2026. The suspect was released after identification measures and questioning, and evidence analysis continues.

title: Kind fällt aus dem Fenster – Mann fängt es auf
summary: A six-year-old girl fell from a third-floor window of a homeless shelter and was caught by a resident. She suffered grazed legs and was taken to hospital for observation; no guardian was present.

title: Seniorin angefahren und geflüchtet
summary: An unidentified e-scooter rider struck a 91-year-old woman waiting for a bus on the pavement in Spandau and fled the scene. The woman was taken to hospital with a broken leg and remains there as an inpatient.

title: 18-Jähriger soll Reizgas in Schule versprüht haben
summary: An 18-year-old, carrying a knife, a telescopic baton and a pepper spray device, allegedly entered a school and released tear gas. Nine pupils and four teachers were injured and the suspect was arrested.

title: Durchsuchungen nach Messerangriff am Ottoplatz
summary: Three men were stabbed in a park in Moabit after a fight between two groups in the early hours of 3 October 2026. Police later searched six residences and a café in several districts and seized replica guns and knives.

title: Geldausgabeautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a freestanding cash machine inside a shopping centre in Biesdorf in the early hours. They fled without any money and no suspects were found in a search.

title: Mann durch Schuss ins Bein verletzt
summary: A 40-year-old man was shot in the leg in a café in Neukölln, and the unknown gunman fled by car. The victim was taken to hospital with a gunshot wound.

title: Senior vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: An 89-year-old man with dementia has been missing since 1 October 2026 after leaving a senior care centre in Frohnau on a walk. Police are asking the public for information on his whereabouts.

title: Zwei Personen bei Auseinandersetzung zwischen Jugendgruppen verletzt
summary: After shots were reported in Altglienicke, police found two injured teenagers, one with stab wounds, in a fight between youth groups. No firearms or ammunition were found, but an airsoft gun was seized.

title: Auseinandersetzungen nach Fußballspiel
summary: After a football match in Westend, about 50 away fans tried to reach home fans and attacked police, who used pepper spray and detained five men. Two detained people were treated for eye irritation.

title: Schwere Brandstiftung
summary: Unknown persons set objects on fire under power cables at a bridge, damaging the cable sheathing. The power supply was interrupted only briefly. The State Criminal Police Office has taken over the investigation.

title: Kollision mit geparktem Pkw – E-Scooter-Fahrer verletzt
summary: An 18-year-old e-scooter rider collided with a parked car in Ruschestraße and was found injured on the ground. He was taken to hospital with suspected head injury.

title: Kind auf E-Scooter bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A twelve-year-old on an e-scooter collided with a car changing lanes on Geraer Ring and fell, injuring his knee and hip. He was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment and later released; proceedings were opened for violating compulsory insurance rules.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A 24-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured after crashing into a curb on the car park of a DIY store on Landsberger Allee. The motorcycle overturned several times and was no longer roadworthy.

title: Schussabgabe auf ein Restaurant
summary: Bullet holes were found in the window front of a restaurant in Moabit, and the owner alerted police around 13:10. Nobody was inside during the incident, and investigations into the background are ongoing.

title: Widerstand und tätlicher Angriff - Polizist bei Festnahme verletzt
summary: After a suspected assault, a 20-year-old man resisted arrest and injured a police officer. The officer was hurt in the shoulder and finger and had to end his shift.

title: Reizstoff gesprüht – zwei Verletzte
summary: An unknown person sprayed irritant gas at an event in Hellersdorf, injuring a 17-year-old woman. A 17-year-old man who followed the attacker was also sprayed and kicked, and both were treated as outpatients.

title: Auseinandersetzung im Hotel
summary: A group of about ten people attacked two guests in a hotel stairwell in Charlottenburg, and one of them threatened a 20-year-old with a weapon and a knife. Two 17-year-old guests were also punched while the group fled, and three suspects were arrested and released after identification measures.

title: Unbekannter Kradfahrer entzieht sich einer Verkehrskontrolle, fährt Einsatzwagen an und flüchtet
summary: An unknown motorcyclist fled a traffic stop at night, speeding through red lights and colliding with a police vehicle that had been blocked across the road. He escaped towards Henningsdorf and police lost contact with him.

title: Einbruch in Einfamilienhaus – Ein Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: Three men were surprised at a single-family home in Lichterfelde in the evening; they fled by car, crashed into three parked cars, and one suspect was arrested. Jewelry was reportedly stolen during the burglary.

title: Zwei fremdenfeindliche Angriffe
summary: A woman wearing a headscarf was insulted with xenophobic remarks and struck on the shoulder by an unknown woman, who also shouted a Nazi-motivated phrase. A witness intervened, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: DEIG-Einsatz – Festnahme nach Hausfriedensbruch, Sachbeschädigung und Widerstand gegen Vollstreckungsbeamte
summary: Police were called to a person behaving erratically on a roof, who then entered a flat under renovation and barricaded himself in a bathroom. He was subdued with a stun device, arrested and taken to hospital; charges include trespassing, property damage and resisting officers.

title: Gedenksteine mit Farbe besprüht – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 46-year-old man allegedly spray-painted several memorial stones laid in the pavement on Greifswalder Straße and was temporarily detained. The case was taken over by the state security unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Messerangriff auf Jugendlichen
summary: A 15-year-old was stabbed several times in the buttocks with a knife by a man in a park after an argument with a group of people. He was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Regenbogenbank im Großen Tiergarten beschmiert
summary: Unknown perpetrators sprayed a rainbow memorial bench in Großer Tiergarten with black paint, apparently in connection with an attack on the CSD. The police Staatsschutz (political crimes unit) took over the investigation.

title: Duo nach Diebstahl festgenommen
summary: Two men were arrested after a 20-year-old smashed a parked car's window and stole an item from it, while a 44-year-old accomplice acted as lookout. Police seized suspected tools, phones, a knife and scissors.

title: Keine Straftat – Geplante Nachbeschriftungsarbeiten
summary: Grave slabs at a cemetery honoring victims of National Socialism were found smeared with black paint, initially reported as vandalism. Police later determined the paint work was a planned relabeling job by a stonemason company, so no crime occurred.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit lebensbedrohlich verletztem E-Scooter-Fahrer
summary: An 18-year-old e-scooter rider was seriously injured after colliding with a car while crossing Raoul-Wallenberg-Straße in Marzahn. The 73-year-old driver was unhurt.

title: Unbekannte Person flüchtet nach Unfall mit vierjährigem Kind
summary: A four-year-old boy was struck by a vehicle on Zossener Straße in Hellersdorf and taken to hospital for outpatient treatment. The unidentified driver, possibly of a van, left the scene.

title: 20-Jährige bei E-Scooter-Unfall verletzt
summary: A 20-year-old on an e-scooter was seriously injured after colliding with a car driving in a bus lane on Helmut-Kohl-Allee in Tiergarten. The woman was taken to hospital with head injuries, and police say her life was not in danger.

title: Rassistische Beleidigung und Körperverletzung – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 52-year-old driver allegedly punched a 24-year-old woman through the window of her car at a red light after a traffic dispute, while making racist insults. The suspect then followed the victim closely and fled; the case is handled by the state security unit.

title: Glasflasche auf den Kopf geschlagen
summary: Shortly after midnight, several unknown young men attacked three men aged 62 to 69 on the terrace of a snack bar. One man was hit on the head with a beer bottle and all were sprayed with pepper gas.

title: Storno in Handfesseln – Räuberisch erpresste Fahrt endet mit vier Festnahmen
summary: A food delivery courier was robbed at knifepoint by a group of five young people, who took his phone and ordered a ride using his account. Four suspects were arrested after police stopped the ride vehicle.

title: Rettungskräfte angegriffen und bespuckt
summary: An unknown man pushed and spat at an emergency doctor and hit the windscreen and door of the ambulance vehicle while paramedics were treating a 44-year-old man. The treated man was not in critical condition and was taken to hospital.

title: Senior nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 78-year-old cyclist collided with a parked car in Nikolassee and fell, suffering serious head and upper-body injuries. He later died in hospital, and police are seeking witnesses.

title: Auftaktveranstaltung der Präventionswoche „Taschendiebstahl“
summary: Joint Berlin, Brandenburg and federal police prevention week on pickpocketing opens with an event in Potsdam on 5 October 2026. No specific incident is reported.

title: Drei Tatverdächtige nach Wohnungseinbruch festgenommen
summary: Three men broke into an apartment in a Lichtenrade apartment building and stole jewelry before fleeing by car. Police arrested three suspects aged 25, 27 and 37 shortly afterwards.

title: Fußgänger nach Zusammenstoß im Krankenhaus
summary: A 30-year-old pedestrian stepped from a central refuge onto Blumberger Damm shortly after midnight and was struck by a car. He suffered serious head injuries and was kept in hospital.

title: Schüsse von Motorroller in Treptow-Köpenick
summary: Two unknown men on a scooter fired several shots at three men on a pavement in Baumschulenweg around 20:30. Two of the men were hit in the legs and taken to hospital; the third was unharmed.

title: 13-Jährige wieder da
summary: A 13-year-old girl who had been missing since 23 September 2026 has been found. She went to a youth welfare facility on her own and is being looked after there.

title: Autofahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall lebensbedrohlich verletzt
summary: A 41-year-old woman driving alone left the road and hit a tree in Gatow, suffering life-threatening injuries. She later died in hospital, in the night to Monday (report dated 2026-09-30).

title: Leichnam aus Tegeler See geborgen – Mordkommission und Staatsanwaltschaft ermitteln
summary: A body was found floating in Lake Tegel and recovered by the fire brigade. A homicide unit is investigating after an autopsy confirmed suspicion of a killing.

title: Festnahme nach Einbruch in Bäckerei
summary: Two men broke into a bakery in Niederschönhausen overnight; a witness alerted police, who arrested one suspect nearby while the second fled. Burglary tools and a small amount of narcotics were seized.

title: Regenbogenbank erneut beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons damaged a rainbow memorial bench in Großer Tiergarten that had been set up after the attack on the Berlin CSD. The Staatsschutz is investigating, as the bench was also destroyed twice earlier in September.

title: Messerangriff verletzte Polizisten und Schussabgabe
summary: After a knife attack in Wedding that injured two police officers, three suspects released from custody were shot at from a passing vehicle on Perleberger Straße. One man was hit in the leg and taken to hospital.

title: 64-Jähriger wieder da
summary: A 64-year-old man reported missing since 10 September 2026 has been found safe at a petrol station in Brandenburg. The public search has been called off.

title: Live-Einbruchversuch und Experten-Tipps: Polizei Berlin zeigt wirksame Sicherungstechnik am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026
summary: Berlin police and the tischler guild invite the public to a burglary-prevention day at police headquarters on 25 October 2026, featuring a live break-in demonstration. The event runs from 12 to 16 noon and is not an incident.

title: Mann mutmaßlich durch Messerstich verletzt
summary: A 30-year-old man was pepper-sprayed by a group in a park in Britz and stabbed in the buttock while fleeing. Two companions were also pepper-sprayed and suffered eye irritation.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt - Zeugenaufruf
summary: A 28-year-old man was stabbed in the chest on the pavement in front of a bar in Turmstraße around 10 p.m. The unknown suspect fled; the victim underwent surgery and is not in danger of his life.

title: Flucht vor Polizeikontrolle endete mit Verkehrsunfall
summary: A driver fled a police check at high speed, running several red lights, and crashed into a parked excavator in a dead-end street. He then reversed into a police vehicle; both occupants were arrested and nobody was hurt.

title: Auto vollständig ausgebrannt
summary: A parked BMW was set on fire on Keplerstraße in the early morning and burned out completely, damaging two neighbouring cars and a street tree. Arson is being investigated by a fire unit of the Berlin LKA; no one was hurt.

title: Große Gruppe greift Trio an
summary: A group of 15 to 20 people attacked three young men in Zehlendorf with punches, and one was knocked unconscious. One victim was also struck against a parked car and taken to hospital.

title: Heranwachsender mit Messer verletzt
summary: An 18-year-old was stabbed several times with a knife in a dispute with a group on a supermarket car park. The suspected attacker, a 13-year-old, has been identified.

title: Homophober Angriff
summary: A 31-year-old man was punched in the face by an unknown person at Viktoria-Luise-Platz in the early hours, while a couple was allegedly filmed. The State Security unit is investigating a possible hate crime.

title: Mann bei Raub mit Messer verletzt
summary: An unknown woman stabbed a 60-year-old man in Görlitzer Park around 00:30 and took cash from him before fleeing. The man suffered a facial cut and was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Bilanz zu einem Versammlungsgeschehen gegen die Wehrpflicht
summary: A demonstration of about 3,400 people against conscription in Mitte involved police-hostile chants, pyrotechnics from a library roof and one temporary arrest. Sixteen people were temporarily detained and eleven criminal complaints were filed in total.

title: Späti ausgeraubt
summary: At about 5:45 a.m., a man threatened a convenience store employee with a suspected firearm and took cash. The 28-year-old employee was knocked to the ground and suffered a head injury.

title: 13-Jährige bei Unfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A car driver hit a 13-year-old girl who ran onto the road at a junction in Prenzlauer Berg in the night. The girl suffered multiple fractures and was taken to hospital.

title: Kinder auf Tretrollern angefahren
summary: Two ten-year-old boys on scooters were hit by a car while crossing Bergstraße in Steglitz. Both were injured and taken to hospital; the driver was not hurt.

title: Jugendlicher mit Schussverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: Police are investigating an attempted killing in Steglitz after a 17-year-old was found with gunshot wounds on Düppelstraße shortly after 10 p.m. The teenager underwent emergency surgery and is no longer in danger of his life.

title: Regenbogenbank im Großen Tiergarten erneut beschädigt
summary: A rainbow memorial bench in Großer Tiergarten, set up after an attack on the Berlin CSD, was damaged again, with one wooden slat removed and two others damaged. Police Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Allgemeinverfügung zur Kampfmittelbeseitigung am 30. September 2026
summary: A general order establishes a restricted zone from 9:30 on 30 September 2026 for ordnance clearance in Brandenburg, extending into Berlin-Gatow. Roads, public transport and gatherings are restricted until the zone is lifted.

title: Bauarbeiter bei Auseinandersetzungen verletzt
summary: Two construction workers were injured in attacks from a building during a construction site dispute in Friedrichshain, including a bottle thrown at one of them. Police halted the construction work temporarily, and the state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Berlin startet mit KI-gestütztem Videoschutz
summary: Berlin police are launching a pilot project using AI-assisted video surveillance at crime-burdened locations, starting at Kottbusser Tor with a roughly four-week camera configuration phase before test operation. No incident occurred.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Feuer und Farbschmiererei
summary: Overnight, a large graffiti inscription was found on a building facade and window front in Marktstraße, and a fire damaged office furnishings inside the building. Nobody was hurt; the State Security unit (Staatsschutz) took over the investigation.

title: Versuchter Raub auf Motorrollerfahrerin – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Three young men attempted to rob a 43-year-old woman of her scooter key on Delbrückstraße; one sprayed her with pepper spray. The suspects were detained shortly after and released following identification procedures.

title: Mann kündigte Amoktat an – mehrere Waffen beschlagnahmt
summary: A 47-year-old man announced an "amok" attack at a bar in Marzahn and returned with a rifle after an argument. Police later searched his flat, seizing replica weapons, a revolver and accessories, and he faces charges for threatening crimes and weapons law violations.

title: Überfall auf Hotel
summary: A young man entered a hotel and, threatening staff with pepper spray, demanded money and took it. Two employees were sprayed; one was treated in hospital for eye irritation.

title: Seniorin fährt Kind an
summary: A 92-year-old driver hit a 13-year-old girl crossing Spandauer Damm in Westend and ran over her, causing a leg fracture. The driver was also treated at hospital and released.

title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Stadtweite Durchsuchungsmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität
summary: Police and prosecutors carried out 14 search warrants across six Berlin districts against suspected illegal trade in semi-automatic firearms, involving over 300 officers. Seven suspects aged 22 to 52 were provisionally arrested and two firearms with ammunition were seized.

title: Distanzelektroimpulsgerät eingesetzt
summary: Police used a taser (DEIG) on a 20-year-old man in a hospital after he became aggressive during admission for a psychiatric crisis. He suffered minor facial injuries and was then admitted to the psychiatric ward.

title: Festnahme nach Straßenraub
summary: A man was arrested after allegedly punching two people sitting on a park bench and stealing a backpack at Stuttgarter Platz. One victim was lightly injured and declined medical treatment.

title: 14-jähriger E-Scooter-Fahrer flüchtet vor Verkehrskontrolle – Beamter setzt DEIG ein
summary: During a traffic check in Köpenick, a 14-year-old e-scooter rider sped off and crashed, then fled on foot and was hit by a police taser (DEIG). He was treated by paramedics for a torso injury and released to his father.

title: Nach Brand in Seniorenheim – Patient im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in a room of a Kreuzberg care home for seniors, and 27 residents were evacuated. A 61-year-old resident was found dead, and a 74-year-old who was seriously injured later died in hospital; investigators suspect negligent arson.

title: Frau bei Sturz in Linienbus lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: An 84-year-old woman was seriously injured when she fell inside a bus in Mitte after the driver pulled away from a stop. She hit her head on a handrail and was taken to hospital.

title: Unter Alkoholeinfluss – E-Scooter-Fahrerin fährt gegen wartendes Auto
summary: An e-scooter rider aged 21 with about 1.3 per mille alcohol collided with a car waiting at a red light early in the morning. The rider was injured and taken to hospital, and the driver was unhurt.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 31-year-old driver speeding in a BMW lost control on the Bösebrücke bridge early on 19 September 2026 and crashed onto the S-Bahn tracks below, dying at the scene. Police are seeking witnesses and video footage.

title: Ermittlungen nach Schussabgabe auf Wohnungsfenster
summary: A bullet hole was found in a double-glazed bedroom window of a residential flat in Backbergstraße, Britz. A projectile was recovered from between the panes and nobody was hurt.

title: Allgemeinverfügung zum 52. Berlin-Marathon erlassen
summary: Police issued a temporary general order banning knives, weapons and similar devices in a section of Mitte along the Berlin Marathon route on 26 and 27 September 2026, from 6 a.m. to 5 p.m. Road closures are expected during the marathon weekend.

title: Überfall auf Geldtransporter – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Unknown suspects threatened a cash-transport driver (38) with a weapon on the Virchow Clinic grounds and stole several cash boxes. The suspects fled in an anthracite Audi A3.

title: Kind bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A four-year-old boy ran into the road between stationary cars and was struck by a passing car driven by a 19-year-old. The child was injured and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall auf der Stadtautobahn verletzt
summary: A 32-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a collision with a Ford and a Kia on the urban motorway (BAB 100) near the Alboinstraße junction. The motorway was closed in the direction of the north for about half an hour.

title: Raub mit Schusswaffe
summary: Five suspects robbed a 23-year-old man during a planned phone purchase in a backyard, one of them holding an apparent firearm to his head. Cash, a bag and a phone were taken, and the suspects fled.

title: Koordinierte internationale Kontrollmaßnahmen in indischen Restaurants wegen des Verdachts des Menschenhandels zum Zwecke der Arbeitsausbeutung
summary: Police, customs and Europol carried out coordinated checks on Indian restaurants in Berlin over suspected labour exploitation and human trafficking. Two restaurants were inspected, with 27 employees and one manager checked, and two main suspects were arrested in the Netherlands.

title: Verdacht des bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels mit Waffen – vier Festnahmen
summary: Police arrested four suspects in Friedrichshain from an alleged gang dealing drugs, seizing about 2.7 kg of cocaine, around 900 g of ecstasy and other drugs, plus a firearm. Cash, a knife and packaging material were also seized.

title: Mehrere Straftaten festgestellt – Polizeilicher Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: Police found multiple graffiti, including a swastika, on a footpath and removed stickers with unconstitutional symbols from a car. A 23-year-old companion then allegedly threatened and insulted two kiosk workers in a xenophobic manner; the State Protection unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Festnahme nach Handel mit Arzneimitteln
summary: Police arrested a 22-year-old driver after observing a bag handover and seizing prescription medicines, a loaded firearm without a full magazine, and about 60 rounds of ammunition. A 29-year-old woman was also investigated and cash was seized from her apartment.

title: Beraubt und durch Stiche verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man was found with several stab wounds in Nogatstraße and told police he had also been robbed of his phone and cap. He was taken to hospital and is not in danger of his life.

title: Brand auf Schulgelände
summary: A fire broke out at the cafeteria building in a school yard in Steglitz and was extinguished by the fire brigade. A 49-year-old suspect was arrested on the school grounds.

title: Raubüberfall auf Lokal
summary: Two unknown youths entered a restaurant in Charlottenburg-Nord, one brandished a firearm while the other took a cash register and both fled. A 60-year-old female customer was pushed from a chair and injured.

title: Unbekannter beschädigt Einsatzfahrzeug der Polizei
summary: During a street festival in Rosenthal, an unknown person threw a glass bottle at a parked police group vehicle, cracking the windscreen and damaging the interior mirror. No one was injured.

title: Jugendliche nach mehreren mutmaßlichen Raubtaten im Mauerpark festgenommen
summary: Three youths threatened several teenagers with a knuckleduster and a baton at Mauerpark and robbed them of cash, a wallet and a bank card. Two suspects aged 16 and 17 were arrested at the scene, and a third suspect is still being sought.

title: Mann nach schwerer Körperverletzung festgenommen
summary: A 48-year-old man was seriously injured in a fight in Hellersdorf after being punched and kicked in the head. A 29-year-old suspect was arrested near the scene.

title: Bedrohung mit Schusswaffe am U-Bahnhof Schönleinstraße
summary: Around 23:00 a man allegedly threatened a passenger with a firearm on a U8 train, pressing it to the passenger's head. No one was hurt, and the suspect fled before police arrived at Schönleinstraße station.

title: Bedrohung mit Machete - Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: After a verbal dispute in an apartment, a 33-year-old man allegedly beat another man and threatened him with a machete. The suspect was identified and arrested after a search; the victim suffered a head wound from a fall.

title: Polizeiliche Einsatzmaßnahmen an kriminalitätsbelasteten Orten
summary: Police Direktion 5 carried out overnight control and presence measures at crime hotspots, including checks and some dispersal orders. The most serious case in the report was a homophobically motivated assault near Uber Platz, where a 20-year-old suspect was identified.

title: Polizisten mit Waffe bedroht - Wohnungsdurchsuchung
summary: Police responding to a disturbance in a Spandau apartment building were threatened with a starter pistol by a 38-year-old man, who was subdued and arrested. A search of his flat found further weapons, including a crossbow and an axe.

title: Festnahme nach Brandstiftung an Wohnmobilen
summary: A motorhome caught fire on a car dealer's premises in Marzahn, spreading to nine other motorhomes; a 21-year-old suspect was arrested nearby. Nobody was injured.

title: Unbekannter schlägt Parteimitglied
summary: A 36-year-old member of a party campaigning for the Berlin House of Representatives election was punched in the face and put in a headlock in a residential building elevator on Heckerdamm. The attacker fled with two companions; the State Protection unit is investigating.

title: Festnahmen nach Scheinankäufen
summary: Police carried out controlled test purchases of illegal drugs in Köpenick, Friedrichsfelde and Alt-Hohenschönhausen, arresting three male sellers of a drug delivery service. Large quantities of cocaine, cannabis, ecstasy and amphetamine were seized, and one suspect was remanded in custody.

title: Drogenerkennung im Straßenverkehr – Bilanz zu Schwerpunktkontrollen im Rahmen der 7. Berliner DiS-Tage
summary: Police ran traffic checks on drug detection over three days (15–17 September 2026) at three Berlin locations during the 7th DiS days. A total of 1,330 vehicles and 1,366 people were checked, with 68 blood tests ordered.

title: Aktionswoche zur Verkehrsunfallprävention von Seniorinnen und Senioren
summary: Berlin police announce a road safety prevention week for senior pedestrians, with information events at several locations between 21 and 25 September. The events include reaction tests, a traffic quiz and burglary prevention tips.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Beifahrerin im Krankenhaus
summary: A car left the road after leaving the Grunertunnel, hit a curb, a bicycle rack and a tree, and overturned. The driver was hurt on the head and declined further treatment, while the 25-year-old passenger was taken to hospital.

title: Schussabgabe durch Polizeibeamten
summary: In the night, a police officer fired a shot at a car whose driver had sped toward an officer after a pepper-spray attack on a colleague. The car escaped toward Wassertorplatz despite the shot.

title: Körperverletzung und versuchter Raub – wer erkennt die Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Three unknown people demanded money from a 30-year-old man on a staircase at Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn station, then beat him, one using a glass bottle. He was treated as an outpatient and the trio fled without loot.

title: Polizist bei Verkehrskontrolle angefahren
summary: During a traffic check in Reinickendorf, a driver accelerated and struck a police officer who was trying to stop his car with a baton. The officer suffered minor injuries and the vehicle was seized; the 43-year-old owner was detained and later released.

title: Hotel überfallen
summary: Two men entered a hotel reception at night, threatened the receptionist with a firearm and demanded money. The receptionist was punched in the face, the pair fled without money, and he was taken to hospital.

title: Homophober Angriff
