summary: A 26-year-old man was attacked by several people at the entrance to Landsberger Allee S-Bahn station late at night, punched in the face, and robbed. The police Staatsschutz unit has taken over the investigation as a suspected anti-gay hate crime.

title: Fußgängerin von Tram angefahren
summary: An 84-year-old pedestrian was struck by a tram on the Berliner Allee in Weißensee and suffered life-threatening head injuries. Tram line M4 was interrupted for nearly two hours.

title: Farbschmierereien an Wahlkreisbüro
summary: Unknown suspects smeared unconstitutional slogans and symbols on the windows of a party office. The police state security unit is investigating.

title: Heranwachsende angegriffen - Polizei Berlin sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen
summary: Two unknown attackers assaulted a 19-year-old woman and a 19-year-old man in Friedrichshain, causing abrasions and cuts. The attackers allegedly shouted right-wing extremist slogans, and the case is handled by the State Protection unit.

title: Attacke am Infostand
summary: Early in the morning, a 32-year-old cyclist allegedly rode into a party's information stand, pushed a 61-year-old aside and threw campaign material on the ground. A 52-year-old witness detained the cyclist until police arrived, and the 61-year-old was allegedly injured on a leg; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Several election posters were damaged or set on fire overnight in Mahlsdorf, Köpenick and Wilmersdorf ahead of the Berlin state election. The State Protection unit is investigating all cases.

title: Feuer in einem Fast-Food-Restaurant
summary: A fire broke out in a fast-food restaurant in Lichterfelde around 3 a.m., and the street was closed during firefighting. Property damage was caused, and nobody was injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Kettenreaktion
summary: An 84-year-old woman lost control of her car on Motzener Straße in Marienfelde and crashed into parked cars, causing a chain reaction that also involved an oncoming VW. The woman suffered several fractures and was taken to hospital, while the 58-year-old VW driver was uninjured.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeifahrzeug
summary: A civilian police car responding with siren and blue lights collided with a van at a junction in Tempelhof on the evening before publication. Two people, the police passenger and the 21-year-old van driver, were injured and treated as outpatients.

title: Frau an einem Informationsstand einer Partei angegriffen
summary: A man threw two mobile phones at people at an election stall in Schöneberg, hitting a 44-year-old woman on the leg, and then fled. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Abgeordneter an Partei-Infostand angegangen
summary: An unknown man verbally attacked a 40-year-old member of parliament at a party information stand, then pushed him, shouted at him and dropped a campaign stand to the ground. The police Staatsschutz unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Angriff auf Geldtransporter – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe - Belohnung ausgelobt
summary: Unknown perpetrators attacked a cash transport vehicle in a discount store car park in Lankwitz and stole cash and valuables. The vehicle was later found abandoned near an S-Bahn underpass on Edenkobener Weg.

title: Schwerverletzte Radfahrerin durch Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 39-year-old cyclist was seriously injured on Lauenburger Straße in Steglitz after colliding with a car door opened by a parked car's driver and falling. Rescue workers took her to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Gegen einen Baum geprallt
summary: A van driver left the road at night in Buch and hit a tree. The 36-year-old driver was freed by rescue crews and taken to hospital with multiple fractures and internal injuries.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A truck pulled away from a junction in Biesdorf and collided with an e-scooter rider crossing the road. The 42-year-old rider was injured and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: DEIG Einsatz nach Widerstand
summary: Police checked a 49-year-old woman carrying an axe in the Görlitzer Park weapons-ban zone. She attacked officers, who used a distance electroshock weapon (DEIG) to subdue her.

title: Vermisster Tourist wieder wohlbehalten bei Freunden
summary: A 31-year-old tourist reported missing since 14 September 2026 has been found safe. He had been taken to hospital in a helpless state on 13 September and was discharged on 14 September.

title: Großes Interesse am 45. Tag der offenen Tür der Polizei Berlin
summary: Police open day at the police academy in Spandau drew about 20,000 visitors. Two children were hit by training ammunition fragments during a demonstration and taken to hospital as a precaution.

title: Vermisster Senior wieder im Kreise seiner Familie
summary: A 91-year-old man with advanced dementia, reported missing since 13 September 2026, has been found safe by relatives in a green area near his home. The police press release is an update to the original missing-person appeal.

title: Wahlplakat und E-Scooter angezündet
summary: An e-scooter and an election poster on it were set on fire in Moabit in the evening. Fire services extinguished the blaze; nobody was hurt, and the police state security unit is investigating.

title: Mann durch Faustschlag verletzt
summary: Shortly after midnight, three people ran at a 42-year-old man at a street crossing in Schöneberg, and one of them punched him in the head in an apparent homophobic attack. The man was injured at the ear and taken to hospital; the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall mit BVG-Bus
summary: A BVG bus left the road and hit a tree on Fulhamer Allee in Britz late at night, injuring 15 people. A 25-year-old passenger's leg was trapped and freed by the fire brigade.

title: Einsatzkräfte angegriffen
summary: About 20 people gathered at a crossing in Friedrichshain, set objects and an armchair on fire and attacked police and fire crews with pyrotechnics from a residential building. One police officer suffered burns to the neck; the State Security unit took over the investigation for severe riot offences.

title: Autos in Flammen
summary: Overnight, three vehicles burned out completely and two others were damaged in a car park in Hellersdorf after residents reported bangs and flames around 2:30 a.m. Nobody was hurt, and the LKA arson unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Antisemitischer Angriff
summary: A 43-year-old woman was insulted antisemitically and attacked with a broken glass bottle by two men on Torstraße in the early hours. She suffered cuts to one hand and was taken to hospital; the state security unit is investigating.

title: Einbruch in Kunstauktionshaus
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into an art auction house in Charlottenburg in the early morning, smashing the entrance door and display cases and stealing antique cups and porcelain. The State Criminal Police Office's art crime unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Friseurgeschäft
summary: Shots were fired at a hairdresser's shopfront on Tempelhofer Damm around 7 a.m., leaving bullet holes in two shop windows. Nobody was injured, and the perpetrator fled in a vehicle; police secured cartridge cases.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall in stationärer Behandlung
summary: A 92-year-old driver and a 37-year-old motorcyclist collided at a crossing in Rummelsburg after the car allegedly failed to yield. The motorcyclist suffered bruises and abrasions and was taken to hospital; he lacked a valid licence and the motorcycle was wanted for embezzlement.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 26-year-old driver turning left collided with an oncoming motorcyclist on Rennbahnstraße in Weißensee. The 61-year-old motorcyclist died later in hospital; the driver and his passenger were treated as outpatients.

title: Wahlplakate beschmiert - Festnahmen
summary: Four teenagers were arrested in Pankow after election posters of a party were smeared with paint at the Breite Straße/Berliner Straße crossing. The Staatsschutz (political crime unit) is investigating.

title: Abgeordneter bedroht
summary: A man threatened a 40-year-old politician at his information stall on a market square and then ran away. The police state security unit is investigating.

title: Toter identifiziert
summary: A homeless man was identified after he fell down stairs at Warschauer Straße S-Bahn station on 19 July 2026 and later died in hospital on 21 July. No external force was apparent.

title: Polizei Berlin lädt zum 45. Tag der offenen Tür ein
summary: Berlin police announce their 45th open day on Sunday, 13 September 2026, at their Charlottenburger Chaussee site in Spandau, running 10:00 to 18:00. The event includes information stands, demonstrations, themed parks and recruitment information.

title: Klassenraum mit reizender Substanz besprüht
summary: An unknown person sprayed an irritant substance into a tenth-grade classroom at a secondary school, injuring 13 pupils and a teacher. The attacker fled; an animal repellent spray was found in the stairwell and seized.

title: Waffe nach Verkehrsüberprüfung gefunden
summary: After a traffic check on an e-scooter in Kreuzberg, police found suspected cocaine and cannabis and a firearm with a loaded magazine during a search of the man's apartment. He was released after police measures were completed.

title: Mann schießt auf mehrere geparkte Autos – Mehrere nicht scharfe Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: A man allegedly fired an air-pressure weapon at several parked cars, damaging windows of seven vehicles. Police later searched his nearby home and seized several blank-firing, gas and airsoft guns.

title: Angriff auf Vollstreckungsbeamte – DEIG Einsatz
summary: A 45-year-old man in a forensic psychiatric hospital in Buch threatened staff and an officer with a broken plate shard, attacking police after they entered his cell. He was subdued with a distance electroshock weapon (DEIG) and handcuffed, and was not injured.

title: 31 Verletzte nach Reizgaseinsatz in Jugendherberge
summary: An group of 8 to 10 people stormed a youth hostel and sprayed pepper spray at a school group of about 30 teenagers. 31 people were treated for eye and airway irritation, and the attackers fled before police arrived.

title: Einsatzfahrt abgebrochen – Mann verletzt Mitarbeiter der Feuerwehr
summary: A car driver tailgated and obstructed an ambulance on an emergency run, then allegedly drove deliberately into a fire brigade employee who had blocked the car. The employee reported knee pain and was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Bronzeskulpturen entwendet – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Three bronze sculptures were stolen from the garden of a clinic between 25 and 26 August 2026. Police are asking for information on their whereabouts.

title: Baustellenbrand am Bundeskanzleramt
summary: Several small fires were found at a pedestrian protection tunnel at a construction site near the Federal Chancellery early in the morning. The fires were extinguished by the fire brigade and no one was hurt.

title: Queere Person angegriffen
summary: Two unknown suspects allegedly approached a 38-year-old person on an e-scooter on Motzstraße and punched them, causing a facial injury. The attack is being investigated by the state security unit (Staatsschutz) as a possible anti-queer hate crime.

title: Wahlplakate durch Feuer beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons set election posters on several lampposts on fire in Lichterfelde early in the morning. Police and fire brigade extinguished the fires, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Tötungsdelikt auf öffentlichem Straßenland – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 27-year-old man was shot several times at the Planetenstraße/Sonnenallee crossing in the early hours and died at the scene. Police homicide unit is seeking witnesses; suspects fled in a dark vehicle.

title: Senior wieder da
summary: A 79-year-old man with dementia who had been missing since 4 September 2026 was found at a construction site on Hindenburgdamm and taken to a nearby emergency room. Police thanked the public for their help in the search.

title: Rollerfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A scooter rider was seriously injured in a collision with a van at a turn in Mariendorf on the evening of 7 September. The van driver left the scene without stopping and is still being sought.

title: Jugendlicher geschlagen und homophob beleidigt
summary: A 17-year-old was attacked from behind and knocked to the ground by an unknown person, who also insulted him in a homophobic way. The teenager suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital; the state security unit is investigating.

title: Brand in einem Restaurant
summary: A fire was reported at a restaurant on Schöneberger Straße in the early hours after bangs were heard. The flames had already gone out when officers arrived, and no one was hurt; police are investigating suspected attempted arson.

title: Autofahrer fährt gegen Gebäudewand
summary: A car driver left the road, drove over a bicycle stand and hit the wall of a museum building. The driver and his passenger were seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Vermisste 36-jährige Frau wieder da
summary: A 36-year-old woman who had been reported missing is safe again. She went to a hospital on her own and received medical care.

title: Mann randaliert und verstirbt im Krankenhaus
summary: A 36-year-old man in a mental crisis set fire to items in a house in Marienfelde and collapsed after being restrained by police; he died in hospital. The state homicide commission has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Einfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired at a single-family house in Buckow in the early morning, with bullet holes found in a garden gate and damage to the glass facade and a shutter. Several people were inside the building, but no one was injured.

title: Vermisste 52-Jährige tot aufgefunden
summary: A 52-year-old woman reported missing since 30 August 2026 has been found dead. Police state there is no indication of third-party involvement.

title: Wahlplakate angezündet
summary: Two election posters attached to street lamps were set on fire in Tegel overnight, damaging nearby garbage bags, a bicycle and the lamps. Nobody was injured, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Transperson mit Schusswaffe bedroht
summary: An 18-year-old trans person sitting on a bench at Mehringplatz was threatened with a firearm by two unknown men after disclosing their gender identity. The suspects fled before police arrived, and the state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann durch Schuss verletzt – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 53-year-old man with a gunshot wound was found in a car parked on a pavement in Tempelhof. He was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery; the homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Zwölfjährige bei Unfall mit E-Scooter verletzt
summary: A car collided with an e-scooter at a crossing in Niederschönhausen, throwing its two riders onto the pavement. A 12-year-old girl was hospitalised and her 38-year-old mother was treated as an outpatient; the 73-year-old driver was unhurt.

title: Gedenkbaum erheblich beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons severely damaged a memorial tree planted in Tiergarten in commemoration of the Berlin CSD attack. The damage was found by police around 1:20 a.m. and is being investigated by the State Security unit.

title: Fünf Versammlungen vor dem Russischem Haus
summary: Five rival demonstrations took place near the Russian House on Friday evening, largely without disruption. During the events, a 63-year-old man and a 61-year-old woman were investigated for resisting and assaulting police officers; the woman and two officers were slightly injured.

title: Räuberische Erpressung
summary: Three masked people demanded cash from a 24-year-old man on a pavement in Kreuzberg, beat and kicked him when he could not pay, and demanded further payment for the next day. The man reported that the same group had been extorting money from him since 2023.

title: Versuchte räuberische Erpressung
summary: Two men aged 20 and 22 allegedly demanded a mid-four-figure sum from a 23-year-old at a hair salon and in front of it, threatening violence and snatching his phone. The suspects were arrested shortly after and released after police measures.

title: Mann nach mutmaßlich homophober Beleidigung angegriffen
summary: A 20-year-old man was insulted in a suspected homophobic attack and then assaulted by an unknown man at Dorothea-Schlegel-Platz in Mitte. The suspect fled, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann mit Schreckschusswaffe beschossen
summary: Two men in a car allegedly fired a blank-firing gun at a man at the roadside in Niederschönhausen around 1 a.m. The apparently injured man left the scene before police arrived.

title: Schwerer Raub in Nachtklub
summary: A 33-year-old club security employee allegedly forced a 22-year-old man and his companion into an elevator, held a suspected firearm to his forehead, threatened him, and stole a cigarette pack. No firearm was found during the police search of the club.

title: Autofahrer fährt Mann und Frau an
summary: A car turning left struck two elderly pedestrians crossing Ostpreußendamm in Lichterfelde. The 75-year-old woman died later in hospital and the 81-year-old man was slightly injured.

title: Mann verursacht mehrere Verkehrsunfälle und greift Polizeibeamten an
summary: A 47-year-old man caused several hit-and-run traffic accidents with parked cars in Buckow, then fled the scene. He was later found nearby, resisted police and headbutted an officer, injuring the officer.

title: Beleidigung und Nötigung im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: A 38-year-old party member replacing election posters at a Steglitz intersection was insulted and then blocked by an unknown man, who left after an acquaintance intervened. The case is handled by the state security unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Eierwürfe auf Informationsstand einer Partei
summary: Eggs were thrown at a party information stand in Heinersdorf around 17:20. A 74-year-old man standing nearby was hit on the leg and was not physically injured; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Sicherstellung einer scharfen Schusswaffe in Spandau
summary: Police searched an apartment in Wilhelmstadt under a warrant for suspected illegal drug trafficking and seized a live firearm with ammunition and prescription-only medicines. A 34-year-old suspect was arrested and remanded in custody.

title: Seniorin mit Bierflasche geschlagen
summary: An unknown woman struck an 87-year-old woman on the head with a full beer bottle while on a U5 train at Schillingstraße station. The victim suffered a bleeding head wound and was taken to hospital.

title: Fußgängerin bei Verkehrsunfall mit Lkw erheblich verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured after being run over by a truck driven by a 61-year-old woman on Blankenfelder Straße. The road was closed in both directions until about 11:30.

title: Mann droht während Fernsehinterview mit Einsatz einer Schusswaffe
summary: During a TV interview on Boxhagener Platz, a young man on an e-scooter allegedly drew a firearm and pointed it at the interviewee, then fled. Nobody was reported injured.

title: Mann nach Wohnungsbrand leblos aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out overnight in a ground-floor apartment in a multi-family building in Wittenau. A 55-year-old man was found unresponsive and died despite resuscitation attempts.

title: Raubüberfall vor Wohnhaus – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen
summary: Three unknown men attacked a man with a knife in front of a residential building at around 00:30 and stole his shoulder bag before fleeing. A related earlier report describes a 36-year-old stabbed near a kiosk on the same street, who was robbed of cash and an ID document.

title: Neun scharfe Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: Police checked a 38-year-old man's van after an suspected drug deal and seized nine firearms, three in the vehicle and six in a garden plot. The man was arrested for resisting officers and is to be brought before a judge.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A nine-year-old girl ran onto the road from the pavement and was hit by a car on Märkische Allee. She was taken to hospital with a head injury and grazes; police say her life was not in danger.

title: Mann von unbekanntem Tatverdächtigen geschlagen und homophob beleidigt
summary: A 62-year-old man was insulted in a homophobic manner and punched in the face by an unknown suspect at Nollendorfplatz. He suffered a nose injury, fell to the ground and was taken to hospital.

title: Mann beschädigt Wahlplakat, entblößt sich und leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme
summary: A man allegedly tore down an election poster and exposed himself to plainclothes officers who identified themselves, then resisted arrest. The 48-year-old was taken to a prison after an existing detention warrant was found.

title: Diebstahlserie aus Handwerkerfahrzeugen – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Police arrested two suspects after three men broke into a parked tradesman's van in Prenzlauer Berg and stole tools; a third suspect fled on foot. Police are seeking other victims of a series of tool thefts from vehicles in Lichtenberg and Pankow.

title: Senior betrogen – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: An 87-year-old man was defrauded by callers posing as a hospital doctor, who handed over jewelry and gold to a collector at his home in Alt-Hohenschönhausen. Police are searching for an unknown suspect shown on surveillance footage.

title: Verdacht des schweren Menschenhandels und des gewerbsmäßigen Einschleusens von Ausländern – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors executed 20 search warrants across eight Berlin districts in an investigation of suspected aggravated human trafficking and commercial smuggling of foreigners. Eighteen suspects are accused of housing at least eleven Vietnamese women in Berlin flats for prostitution; ten suspects were found, and one police officer was slightly injured.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin bei Kollision mit Lkw verletzt
summary: An e-scooter rider was seriously injured after colliding with a truck at a junction in Kreuzberg. The traffic light reportedly showed red for the scooter rider.

title: Mann von unbekannten Tätern mehrmals angeschossen und schwer verletzt
summary: A 26-year-old man was shot several times by unknown perpetrators from a group on Feurigstraße in Schöneberg and seriously injured. The homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Junger Mann nach Gewalttat identifiziert
summary: A young man on a U8 train at Kottbusser Tor allegedly punched a 48-year-old man in the face and head after a verbal dispute. The suspect has since been identified, according to police.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall in intensivmedizinischer Behandlung
summary: A car turning left at a junction collided with a motorcyclist, a 55-year-old man, who was seriously injured and needed intensive care. The driver, a 31-year-old woman, was treated as an outpatient.

title: Seniorin bei Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: An 80-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured after being hit by a car while crossing Mariendorfer Damm from the median strip. She suffered multiple fractures and was briefly in life-threatening condition.

title: Transperson verletzt und beleidigt
summary: An unknown man insulted and assaulted an 18-year-old trans person in front of a restaurant, kicking them in the head while on the ground. The case was taken over by the State Security unit.

title: Sicherstellung einer scharfen Schusswaffe und Sicherstellung von Vermögenswerten durch die BAO Ferrum im Zusammenhang mit Schussabgaben auf eine Wohnung
summary: Police report on the investigation into shots fired at a residential building in Ritterstraße in February 2026, with attempted murder charges. Four suspects are in custody, and a loaded firearm and ammunition were seized from a suspect's car.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt in einer Anwaltskanzlei
summary: A dispute between two women in a law office at Teterower Ring left one woman, 46, with life-threatening injuries. A 51-year-old suspect was arrested, and the 5th homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Festnahme nach Einbruch in Auto
summary: A car's side window was smashed and a backpack was stolen in Mitte; a 29-year-old suspect was arrested shortly afterwards. The suspect is to be brought before a judge for an arrest warrant.

title: Regenbogenbank im Großen Tiergarten beschädigt
summary: A rainbow memorial bench set up after an attack on the Berlin CSD was heavily damaged overnight on Ahornallee in Tiergarten. The Staatsschutz is investigating the criminal damage.

title: Sprengung auf dem Sprengplatz Grunewald
summary: Police will detonate a World War II bomb found and defused last week at the Grunewald demolition site on 3 September 2026, between 10 and 13 hours. A 500-metre safety zone will be set up, and residents within it will be asked to leave.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: A car turning left collided with an 86-year-old pedestrian crossing at a crosswalk in Wilhelmsruh. The woman fell, suffered a head injury and was taken to hospital.

title: Politiker antisemitisch beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 28-year-old election candidate campaigning in front of a supermarket was antisemitically insulted and an attempted punch was thrown at him. The suspect, a 68-year-old man, faces charges of assault, incitement and insult.

title: Ermittlungen der BAO Ferrum: Vollstreckung eines Haftbefehls in Nordrhein-Westfalen und Sicherstellung von Vermögenswerten
summary: A 42-year-old suspect linked to a Berlin group accused of shootings and extortion was arrested in Hamm, North Rhine-Westphalia, on a warrant issued by the Berlin investigation team. Assets worth roughly several hundred thousand euros have been provisionally seized from members of the group.

title: DEIG-Einsatz nach Widerstand - Festnahme
summary: Police were called to a disorderly 40-year-old man at a garden colony event in Mariendorf, who resisted arrest and insulted officers. Officers used a taser (DEIG) to subdue him; he was unharmed and later taken to a prison after outstanding warrants.

title: Fußgänger bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A car driver hit a 20-year-old pedestrian crossing Johannisthaler Chaussee in Gropiusstadt late at night. The pedestrian suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital; life is not believed to be in danger.

title: Schüsse in Fußgängerzone
summary: Shots were fired in the pedestrian zone of Steinmetzstraße in Schöneberg before 5 a.m., after which a small car drove off at high speed. Two apartment windows on the street were hit by bullets, and no one was injured.

title: Unfall mit verletzter Person und fünf beschädigten Autos
summary: An 84-year-old driver crashed on Segelfliegerdamm in Johannisthal, hitting parked cars and overturning onto the roof. Four parked cars were damaged and the driver was seriously hurt, requiring hospital treatment.

title: Fremdenfeindlicher Angriff - Festnahme
summary: A 42-year-old man allegedly attacked a 25-year-old passer-by at Ostkreuz station, throwing him onto the road and punching him in the head, with xenophobic insults and threats. Federal police ended the attack and arrested the suspect; the Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Sachbeschädigungen durch Farbschmierereien
summary: Between 26 and 27 August 2026, unknown persons sprayed 18 politically worded graffiti on building facades and a supermarket in Tempelhof. The State Security unit of the State Criminal Police Office has taken over the investigation.

title: Verstoß gegen das Sprengstoffgesetz - Festnahme
summary: Police arrested a 37-year-old man at a street crossing in Köpenick after finding an improvised explosive and incendiary device in his backpack. The device was secured and neutralised, and the man was released after identity checks; the Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Von Personengruppe geschlagen und beleidigt
summary: A seven-person group attacked two women, aged 21 and 22, at Kaulsdorf U-Bahn station after they declined to talk to them. A 46-year-old passerby who came to help was struck in the face with a beer bottle.

title: Mit Drogen vor der Polizei geflüchtet - Festnahme
summary: After a traffic stop attempt, a driver fled police on foot and discarded a bag, which contained about one kilogram of suspected cocaine. The 37-year-old man was arrested and cash was seized.

title: Unfallflucht nach Zusammenstoß mit zweijährigem Jungen
summary: A hit-and-run driver allegedly struck a two-year-old boy at Köthener Straße in Marzahn, then collided with a waiting truck while reversing and fled. The boy was taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Motorradfahrer erlag seinen Verletzungen und verstarb
summary: A 34-year-old motorcyclist lost control after accelerating sharply on the BAB 111 motorway, collided with a car and a guardrail, and later died in hospital. The car driver was unhurt.

title: Einer Polizeikontrolle entzogen und Unfall verursacht
summary: A 17-year-old motorcyclist without a helmet fled a police traffic check at high speed and crashed into a street lamp in Mariendorf. He was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Durchsuchungsmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität
summary: Police searched four properties in Kreuzberg and Neukölln in connection with a weapons law violation, seizing a concealed pistol, ammunition and a blank-firing/signal weapon. Four suspects aged 19 to 35 are under investigation.

title: Allgemeinverfügung erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte
summary: Police issued a general order with security measures and road closures around the Government District and Tiergarten for a commemoration of the German invasion of Poland on 1 September 2026, from 6 to 20 hours. Parking and public assemblies are prohibited in the restricted areas during that time.

title: Trickdiebstahl in Wohnungen - Festnahmen und Durchsuchungen
summary: Three men were arrested after allegedly posing as plumbers to gain entry to an 83-year-old woman's flat in a distraction-theft attempt; no loot was taken. Searches followed and the investigation into a wider Berlin-wide gang continues.

title: Zehnjähriger geschlagen und homophob beleidigt
summary: A ten-year-old boy was insulted with a homophobic remark and kicked and choked by a classmate during break at a school. The boy was hurt on the neck, and the State Protection unit was informed.

title: Schlägerei nach Streitigkeiten
summary: Several suspects beat and insulted a 26-year-old kiosk employee at a snack bar in Hellersdorf after he asked to close, and a passer-by was also drawn into the fight. Three suspects were arrested and the employee was treated in hospital for a head injury.

title: Wohnwagen und Pkw in Flammen
summary: In the early hours a caravan caught fire on Kiefholzstraße and spread to two cars, which burned out along with several other vehicles damaged. Nobody was injured; the LKA arson unit is investigating.

title: Mutmaßliche Einbrecher festgenommen
summary: Police were alerted to a suspected break-in in an apartment building in Schöneberg after a resident saw two masked people in the stairwell. Two men aged 19 and 20 were arrested in the building's elevator, and fresh break-in traces were found at an apartment door.

title: Festnahmen nach Schockanruf
summary: Two suspected fraudsters were arrested in Rudow while collecting cash and gold from a 91-year-old man after a fake accident call. The caller had threatened harm to the man's daughter if the money was not paid.

title: Festnahmen nach Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten
summary: Several police incidents overnight involved damage to election posters in Berlin, handled by the State Protection unit. In Mitte, a 27-year-old man and 28-year-old woman were arrested at the scene after damaging and removing posters and were released after identification measures.

title: Gemeinsam für mehr Sicherheit am Berliner Hauptbahnhof und Ostbahnhof
summary: Police, Federal Police, DB Sicherheit and local public order offices launched joint patrols at Berlin Hauptbahnhof and Ostbahnhof to boost presence and security. No specific incident was reported.

title: Parteibüro mit Fäkalien beschmiert
summary: Feces were smeared on the lock and door handle of a party office in Johannisthal, discovered around 3 p.m. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Geschäftsstelle einer Partei beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons damaged the lock of a party office entrance door with glue, so the door could no longer be opened. The State Security unit of the LKA has taken over the investigation.

title: „Sichtbar mobil zur Schule" – Verkehrssicherheits-Aktionstag zum Schulanfang in der STATION Berlin
summary: Road safety action day "Sichtbar mobil zur Schule" for second-graders was held at STATION Berlin near Park am Gleisdreieck. Officials urged drivers to take care around schoolchildren at the start of the school year.

title: Zwei Personen bei Angriff verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 17-year-old sprayed pepper spray at two people, then injured a 28-year-old man with a pointed object. Two people were hurt and the suspect was arrested shortly afterwards.

title: Mann nach Stichverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: A 53-year-old man was stabbed in the chest on Bülowstraße around midnight by an unknown attacker, who then fled. The victim was taken to hospital in life-threatening condition and underwent emergency surgery.

title: 19-Jähriger leblos aufgefunden
summary: A 19-year-old man reported missing since 11 August 2026 was found dead today. Police see no indication of third-party involvement.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: An e-scooter carrying two teenagers collided with a pedestrian on Alexanderplatz. Three people were slightly or moderately hurt, and police seized the scooter over suspected speed manipulation.

title: Zwei Männer bei körperlichem Angriff verletzt
summary: Two men aged 32 and 27 were attacked by an unknown group after a verbal dispute; one was sprayed with pepper spray and the 32-year-old suffered head injuries and lost several teeth. The group fled.

title: Radfahrerin bei Unfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A van driver allegedly ran a red light at the Danziger Straße junction in Prenzlauer Berg and struck a cyclist who had entered on green. The 74-year-old cyclist suffered serious head and face injuries.

title: Autofahrer fährt Motorradfahrer an
summary: A car turning left collided with a motorcyclist travelling at high speed on Berliner Straße in Wilmersdorf on the evening of 24 August. The motorcyclist, 24, was injured and taken to hospital; the motorcycle was reported stolen and seized.

title: Wohnungsraub mit Schusswaffen
summary: Two masked suspects forced their way into a 73-year-old man's flat in Mariendorf, demanded valuables and searched the apartment before fleeing. They were reportedly armed with firearms; the man was not hurt.

title: Schussabgaben auf Geschäft
summary: Shots were fired at a shop in Lichterfelde around 3:55 a.m., leaving bullet holes in the shop windows. A non-detonated explosive device was also found and seized by police.

title: Mehrere Fahrzeuge durch Feuer beschädigt
summary: Five vehicles were damaged by fire in a car park on Germersheimer Weg in Falkenhagener Feld overnight. Four were burning fully, and nobody was hurt.

title: Tote Frau gefunden – Polizei und Staatsanwaltschaft bitten um Mithilfe
summary: A 46-year-old woman was found dead in bushes near the Zeiss-Großplanetarium in Prenzlauer Berg. Police homicide unit is investigating the death as a killing and has asked the public for information.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Radfahrer und Fußgängerin
summary: A cyclist and a pedestrian collided on a bicycle lane on Schlesische Straße at night. Both fell to the ground, and both were taken to hospital.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Berlin police report several cases of damage to election posters linked to the Berlin House of Representatives election, handled by the state security unit. In Schöneberg, a 54-year-old woman was seen tearing down a poster and was released after identity checks.

title: Mann geschlagen und rassistisch beleidigt
summary: A 36-year-old man was repeatedly punched in the face at Boxhagener Platz, then subjected to a racist insult. The Staatsschutz (political police unit) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mit Gullydeckel in Supermarkt eingebrochen
summary: Two unknown men broke into a supermarket on Königin-Luise-Straße at around 0:30 using a manhole cover and stole large quantities of tobacco products and e-cigarettes. They fled before police arrived.

title: Mann mit Cuttermesser verletzt
summary: A 39-year-old man allegedly injured a 37-year-old man with a box cutter on the U8 platform at Kottbusser Tor after the victim said he was pro-Israel. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Fremdenfeindlich beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: A 52-year-old woman was verbally harassed with xenophobic insults, pushed and struck in the face after a dispute on tram line M 16 and at the stop Möllendorffstraße. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Wahlplakate in Brand gesetzt
summary: Two men aged 24 and 26 were arrested after allegedly throwing flammable objects at election posters on Falkenseer Damm and Falkenseer Platz, damaging both. The police Staatsschutz is continuing the investigation.

title: Schutzscheibe in Linienbus eingeschlagen
summary: A man boarded a BVG bus at S-Plänterwald after being asked to leave, then smashed the protective screen to the driver's area with a tool and fled on foot. The driver was not hurt.

title: Rad- und Motorrollerfahrer kollidieren – beide im Krankenhaus
summary: A cyclist and a scooter rider collided in Rummelsburg while turning on the Köpenicker Chaussee cycle path. Both men were taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Frau nach religionsfeindlicher Beleidigung mit Glasflasche angegriffen
summary: A 36-year-old woman was verbally abused with religious hostility on a tram and then struck on the head with a glass bottle at a red pedestrian light. She was taken to hospital, and the attacker fled; the Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Mann schießt vom Balkon – Festnahme durch SEK
summary: A 45-year-old man fired several shots from his balcony in Mariendorf after threatening people, and was arrested by a special unit. Nobody was injured; the gun found was a blank-firing revolver.

title: Gesuchter Vermisster wieder untergebracht
summary: A 20-year-old man reported missing from a psychiatric ward, who was considered a danger to others, was found and taken back into care at Helsingforser Platz in Friedrichshain. He is back under supervision at the hospital.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Multiple election posters were damaged overnight across Berlin, including several in Lichtenberg, Pankow and Schöneberg; the State Protection unit is investigating. In Schöneberg, a 35-year-old man was found to have set a poster on fire and was taken to a hospital for psychiatric care.

title: Mann mit Messer angegriffen – Ermittlungen zu einem versuchten Tötungsdelikt
summary: A 33-year-old man was stabbed in the leg during a dispute on Hobrechtstraße and the suspect fled after city officers intervened. A homicide unit is investigating the attempted killing; the 38-year-old suspect was arrested.

title: Brandstiftung an einem Späti
summary: An unknown masked person threw an incendiary device at a convenience store in Wedding overnight, and it bounced off the awning and set a parked car on fire. Witnesses extinguished the fire and nobody was hurt.

title: Mann von mehreren Personen beraubt
summary: A 40-year-old man was robbed by four unknown men at a street crossing in Kreuzberg in the night. He was punched in the face and ribs, and his wallet and phone were taken with a sharp object.

title: Aktionswoche zum Waffen- und Messerverbot im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr
summary: Police and Bundespolizei announce a Berlin-wide action week from 24 to 28 August 2026 enforcing the weapons and knife ban in public transport. The ban has applied since 17 July 2025.

title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – Festnahmen wegen versuchten Mordes, Erpressung und des Verstoßes gegen das Waffengesetz
summary: A 21-year-old suspect was arrested in Treptow-Köpenick over shots fired at a café window in Hermannstraße, Neukölln, in April 2026, linked to extortion for protection money. Police also searched seven addresses and seized two firearms, ammunition and suspected cocaine.

title: Kind von Erwachsenen geschlagen
summary: A 13-year-old boy was attacked by adults after a dispute with a 10-year-old, leaving him with arm injuries. He was treated on scene by paramedics and police are investigating the grievous bodily harm.

title: Senior bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 82-year-old scooter rider was seriously injured after colliding with a car while changing lanes on Gutschmidtstraße in Britz. The car driver was unhurt.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Several election posters for the Berlin House of Representatives election were vandalised on 19 August 2026, including one set on fire at a lamp post in Schöneberg. The State Protection unit is investigating the damage to posters across several districts.

title: Festnahmen nach versuchtem Trickdiebstahl
summary: Two women aged 19 and 28 allegedly gained entry to an 84-year-old woman's apartment by posing as care service staff to steal from her. A witness alerted police, and both suspects were arrested at the scene for attempted fraud-based theft.

title: Regenbogenflagge beschädigt
summary: A rainbow flag and its lighting fixture were found damaged at an art university on Hanseatenweg in the Hansaviertel. The State Security police unit took over the investigation.

title: Radfahrer nach Unfall mit Autotür verletzt
summary: A passenger opening a car door in Herzbergstraße caused a collision with a passing cyclist, who was injured and taken to hospital. The unidentified passenger fled the scene on foot.

title: 18-Jähriger mit Schusswaffe bedroht und ausgeraubt
summary: An 18-year-old was threatened with a firearm, tied up and robbed of cash in an apartment on Florastraße in the evening. He escaped and alerted police; the suspects were gone when officers searched the flat.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Around 6:45 a.m., a man allegedly struck several election posters with a pole at a junction in Märkisches Viertel, was arrested after boarding a bus, and the posters were damaged. The State Security unit is investigating; the case is one of several election-related vandalism reports on this day.

title: Vermisster Demenzkranker wohlbehalten im Krankenhaus
summary: A 65-year-old man with dementia who had been missing since 16 August was found safe in a hospital. Hospital staff alerted police after recognizing him among patients brought in by the fire service.

title: Touristin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 72-year-old tourist stepped onto a bike lane in Schönhauser Allee and collided with an e-scooter rider, both falling. The tourist suffered a foot injury and was taken to hospital; the rider was unhurt.

title: Festnahmen nach Trickdiebstahl in Wohnung
summary: Two suspects posing as telecom employees allegedly stole jewelry and cash from a 92-year-old woman's apartment in a distraction theft. Two 26-year-old suspects were arrested the same evening in Charlottenburg, and the stolen goods were recovered.

title: Mahnmal beschmiert
summary: Unknown persons spray-painted a deportation memorial at Putlitzbrücke in Moabit; the paint could not be removed. The police state security unit is investigating.

title: Autofahrerin bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A 21-year-old woman lost control of her car in Friedrichshagen, hit a tree and overturned. She was injured and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an und Diebstahl von Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Election posters of two parties were torn from a light pole and damaged, and a sticker was placed on one of them. The State Protection unit is investigating.

title: Erheblich verletzter Radfahrer
summary: A 47-year-old cyclist hit an opened car door on Albrechtstraße and fell, suffering serious injuries. He was taken to hospital by ambulance.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Schussabgabe
summary: Several gunshots were heard overnight on Johannisthaler Chaussee in Rudow on the night of Saturday to Sunday. A 39-year-old woman found a bullet hole in her parked car later that morning and alerted police.

title: Mehrfach gegen den Kopf getreten
summary: A 37-year-old man repeatedly kicked a 43-year-old man lying on the ground at Europaplatz in Mitte, causing a serious head injury. BVG employees intervened and held the suspect until federal police arrived.

title: Streitigkeiten mit Messer und Flaschenhieb ausgetragen
summary: After a group of teenagers argued near the Rathausbrücke, one 17-year-old was stabbed in the shoulder with a utility knife and another was hit with a glass bottle. Two 17-year-olds were taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Rassistische Beleidigung
summary: A 37-year-old man allegedly racially insulted three women aged 23, 24 and 27 in Volkspark Hasenheide. He was detained after a search near the Sommerbad Neukölln and the Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Autofahrer und Begleiter greifen Pedelecfahrer an
summary: A car driver and his passenger attacked a 21-year-old cyclist after blocking him with their car on the bike lane. The victim suffered serious facial injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Sachbeschädigungen und eine Beleidigung im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: During the Berlin state election campaign, a man allegedly insulted a party campaigner at an information stand, and another man allegedly grabbed a party member's arm and tore up party leaflets. The Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Mitarbeiter eines Spätkaufs mit Schusswaffe bedroht und Geld geraubt
summary: An unknown man threatened a 30-year-old convenience store employee with a firearm and took cash and cigarettes. He fled by car and the employee was unhurt.

title: Mann angefahren und anschließend geflüchtet
summary: A driver struck a sleeping 52-year-old man at a car lift exit of a commercial building and then fled the scene. The man suffered serious injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Mehrere Einbrüche in einem Einkaufszentrum
summary: Two masked people broke into a shopping centre in the early morning and smashed the glass doors of 14 shops, taking cash drawers from some. The affected areas were closed until about 10 a.m. for evidence collection.

title: Mann auf dem Müggelsee durch Schiffsschraube schwer verletzt
summary: A 32-year-old man fell into the water from a rented raft on the Müggelsee and was caught in a still-rotating propeller. He was seriously injured and taken to hospital by ambulance.

title: Mehrere beschädigte Wahlplakate
summary: Several election posters of different parties were damaged across Reinickendorf and Tempelhof-Schöneberg, including two large posters sprayed with paint on the Lindauer Allee median. The police Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Mann in U-Bahn antisemitisch beleidigt und bedroht
summary: A 30-year-old man was antisemitically insulted and threatened by a group of young men on the U9 subway line in Wilmersdorf overnight. He reported it to a police precinct, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Zwei Männer durch Messerstiche verletzt
summary: After a misunderstanding in a group gathering, a man stabbed a 48-year-old repeatedly and also attacked a 45-year-old friend who came to help; the 48-year-old was in life-threatening condition. The suspect fled and was arrested later in Niederschöneweide.

title: Rollerfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A van driver allegedly ignored a right-of-way sign at a junction and collided with a 61-year-old scooter rider, who died in hospital. His 15-year-old passenger was injured and the van driver and his 27-year-old passenger were unhurt.

title: Schüsse treffen Lokalscheibe
summary: Several shots struck the window of a venue in Pankow in the early hours of Thursday. Police found cartridge casings and damage to the window at Wollankstraße.

title: Auseinandersetzung beim Anbringen von Wahlplakaten
summary: During an altercation while putting up election posters in Moabit, several men insulted each other and one man was punched in the face by an unknown person. The police Staatsschutz (political crime unit) is investigating.

title: Brandstiftung in einer Bar
summary: An unknown masked man threw an incendiary device into a bar on Wiener Straße around 23:30. A 22-year-old employee extinguished the fire before the fire brigade arrived, and nobody was hurt.

title: Frau beschädigt Wahlplakate und greift Polizist an
summary: A 43-year-old woman damaged election posters on a lamppost in Brunnenstraße and struck out at police officers. One officer was hurt on the arm and the case was taken over by the state security unit.

title: Lieferfahrer im Park überfallen
summary: Two unknown men attacked a 25-year-old delivery rider on an e-bike, pepper-sprayed him and punched him before stealing cash and fleeing. The victim was taken to hospital with severe eye irritation.

title: Festnahme einer mutmaßlichen Diebesbande auf frischer Tat
summary: Three suspects aged 25, 34 and 35 allegedly broke into two apartments in Gropiusstadt on the same morning and stole jewelry, coins and cash. The trio was arrested by LKA officers later that day after being found with the loot and burglary tools.

title: Spätkauf ausgeraubt – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: An unknown man entered a convenience store posing as a customer and tried to take cash from the till. He struck the shop owner, pushed her to the ground and fled with part of the cash register.

title: Wahlplakate von Laternen entfernt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: Election posters were removed from lampposts in Prenzlauer Berg by cutting their cable ties. A 57-year-old male suspect was arrested, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Dachgeschoss abgebrannt
summary: A fire broke out in a top-floor flat of a residential building in Biesdorf and spread to the roof structure and neighbouring flats. 28 people suffered smoke inhalation and the whole building was made uninhabitable.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin fährt Fußgänger an
summary: An e-scooter rider with an unauthorised passenger struck a pedestrian on a cycle path at about 14:15. The 65-year-old pedestrian was seriously hurt and taken to hospital; the two teenage riders were unhurt.

title: Kontrollen gegen Arbeitsausbeutung und Menschenhandel
summary: Police and customs checked two nail studios in a commercial area on Herzbergstraße for labour exploitation and human trafficking. Over 40 people were found to have violated residence law, and no one identified as a trafficking victim.

title: Frau vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 58-year-old woman with a medical condition left her supported housing on the evening of 3 August 2026 and has not returned. Police have published photos and ask for public help in the search.

title: Beleidigung und Volksverhetzung auf einem Spielplatz
summary: A 59-year-old man insulted an eleven-year-old girl on a playground in Rummelsburg with xenophobic remarks and made inflammatory statements toward her. Police Staatsschutz are investigating after witnesses helped identify the suspect.

title: Schüsse auf einen Mann
summary: A 40-year-old man allegedly shot another 40-year-old man several times in a bar in Baumschulenweg and then fled. The victim was taken to hospital; the Homicide Commission is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Fahrradfahrer verstorben
summary: A 73-year-old cyclist collapsed on Streitstraße and was declared dead at the scene after bystanders attempted resuscitation. Police investigators have taken over the follow-up inquiries.

title: Durch Messerangriff erheblich verletzt
summary: After an argument between two small groups of young men at the entrance of Park am Weißensee, one man was stabbed in the back with a knife. The injured man was taken to hospital with serious but non-life-threatening injuries.

title: Gewerbsmäßiger Computerbetrug und Diebstahl – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Police are searching for a suspect who allegedly stole mailed bank cards and PINs and withdrew money between August 2024 and September 2024, with three theft and nine computer fraud cases attributed. Surveillance images of the suspect at an ATM on Leipziger Platz were released.

title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der zweiten ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ 2026 – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz
summary: Berlin police reported results of the ROADPOL Speedweek speed checks from 3 to 9 August 2026 at 247 locations, recording 12,413 speeding violations. 61 drivers exceeded the limit by more than 31 km/h and face at least a one-month driving ban.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: After an argument in Rudow, a 52-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 38-year-old man in the upper body with a knife. The injured man was taken to hospital, was not in life-threatening danger, and the suspect was arrested at the scene.

title: Verhaltensauffällige Person - DEIG-Einsatz
summary: Police were called to a flat in Oranienstraße where a 37-year-old man was behaving erratically, claiming to have a firearm and threatening officers. He injured himself, and an officer used a stun device; he suffered minor injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse auf 30-Jährigen – Zeugenaufruf
summary: After an argument among several people at Hardenbergplatz, one person fired shots at a 30-year-old man, who died at the scene despite resuscitation attempts. The shooter fled the scene by vehicle; the homicide squad is investigating and seeking witnesses.

title: Falscher Stromzählerableser – Auseinandersetzung nach versuchtem Trickdiebstahl
summary: A suspected distraction thief posing as a meter reader entered an 86-year-old man's flat in Singerstraße and opened cupboards. When his son and a neighbour confronted him, he punched the son and fled without stolen goods.

title: Wahlplakate beschädigt – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Two suspects, aged 27 and 29, were seen tearing down and defacing election posters in Schöneberg overnight and were arrested in a nearby convenience store. The State Security unit of the LKA is investigating.

title: Streit zwischen mehreren Personen eskaliert
summary: A dispute in Altglienicke escalated late at night; two men were beaten and a 47-year-old man allegedly struck one with a hammer and then drove a car at them. The 29-year-old was seriously injured and three suspects aged 39 to 47 were identified, all under the influence of alcohol.

title: DEIG-Einsatz im Hotel nach tätlichem Angriff und Widerstand
summary: After a hotel guest allegedly triggered a fire alarm without cause, he attacked and resisted officers in a lift. An officer used a taser (DEIG) to end the resistance, and the 31-year-old was taken to hospital.

title: Feuer in der Küche – Bewohnerin verstorben
summary: A kitchen fire broke out in a semi-detached house in Lichtenrade overnight. A 56-year-old woman was found unresponsive and died despite resuscitation attempts.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Radfahrer an
summary: A car driver turning left collided with a cyclist at a junction in Rummelsburg in the early hours. The 34-year-old cyclist was injured with head injuries and taken to hospital; he is not in danger of his life.

title: Wahlkampfhelfer beim Plakatieren angefahren
summary: A 47-year-old campaign helper putting up election posters was hit from behind by a cyclist and fell, suffering injuries. The cyclist fled, and the police Staatsschutz unit is investigating.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Sturz in Lebensgefahr
summary: An e-scooter rider, 52, was seriously injured after falling alone on Allee der Kosmonauten in Marzahn. He was put into an artificially induced coma in hospital.

title: Unbekannter entwendet Regenbogenflaggen
summary: An unknown man tore down two rainbow flags from the front windows of a bar in Prenzlauer Berg and fled toward the Eberswalder Straße U-Bahn station. The incident was reported around 3:50 a.m., and investigations are ongoing.

title: Versuchter Totschlag – Mann vor Café angeschossen
summary: An unknown gunman shot a 22-year-old man sitting outside a café in Graefestraße, Kreuzberg, and fled. The victim was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery; he is no longer in danger of dying.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A motorcyclist rammed the rear of a car waiting at a red light on Streitstraße in Hakenfelde. The 53-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured in the head and neck area and taken to hospital.

title: DEIG-Einsatz nach Widerstand
summary: Police used a taser (DEIG) on a 20-year-old man who resisted a search after a dispute in a hotel room, where he had damaged furniture. He was arrested and taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Spezialkräfte durchsuchen Wohnung nach Schüssen
summary: A 37-year-old man allegedly fired blank-firing guns into the air from a window in the Märkisches Viertel, prompting a police operation. Special forces searched the flat, arrested him temporarily and seized several blank-firing guns and ammunition.

title: Imbiss mit Waffe ausgeraubt
summary: Two unknown men robbed a snack bar in Hakenfelde early in the morning, threatening an employee with a firearm and taking the cash box. The employee was not injured and the suspects fled on a motorcycle.

title: Raubüberfall auf Lebensmitteldiscounter
summary: Two masked men robbed a discount food store in Friedenau in the evening and took cash from the register while armed with a firearm. They fled toward Rheinstraße; a search with a police helicopter was unsuccessful and nobody was hurt.

title: Zwei Polizeibeamte bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A police patrol car responding to an emergency collided with a car in the Friedenau tunnel on the A103 after a lane change. Two police officers were injured, and the patrol car was no longer roadworthy.

title: Mann durch Messerstiche verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 22-year-old man during an argument in front of Südkreuz S-Bahn station overnight. The suspect was arrested at the scene; the injured man underwent emergency surgery and is not in danger of his life.

title: Zahlungsstreit endet mit Messerangriff
summary: After a dispute over a payment at a snack bar, one of three unknown men allegedly stabbed a 36-year-old who tried to intervene. The victim was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Drogenhandel
summary: Police observed suspected drug sales in front of a residential building and later arrested a 49-year-old suspect in his apartment. Officers seized amphetamine in kilogram quantities, cannabis, air rifles and blank-firing replica weapons, and cash.

title: Verbleib von gesuchter 16-Jähriger geklärt
summary: A 16-year-old girl reported missing since 1 April 2026 has been located and the public search has ended. She had left a youth welfare facility on Mindener Straße.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A 45-year-old motorcyclist lost control while overtaking on Grottkauer Straße in Kaulsdorf, hitting a bollard and a tree. He was injured and taken to hospital; he did not hold a valid driving licence.

title: Störung beim Anbringen von Wahlplakaten
summary: Members of a political party putting up election posters on Gürtelstraße were verbally confronted and a ladder was shaken; one man sprayed animal repellent. Three people were treated in hospital for irritation and breathing difficulties.

title: Fahrradfahrer umgefahren und geflüchtet
summary: A car driver hit an 80-year-old cyclist in Rudow and drove off without helping. The cyclist was taken to hospital, and a 38-year-old man who admitted to driving without a licence later came forward.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Auseinandersetzung
summary: Several men fought in front of a bar in Dominicusstraße in Schöneberg; baseball bats, glass bottles and a knife were reportedly used. One 32-year-old was stabbed and three suspects aged 23, 33 and 34 were temporarily arrested.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren Verletzten
summary: Two cars collided at a junction in Pankow in the evening, when one car was thrown into a traffic light. Two men and two women were injured, the two older ones requiring hospital treatment.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung mit Messer
summary: After an argument between four men on the Kronprinzenbrücke around midnight, one man struck two others with a fist, a bottle and a knife, injuring both. Police later found several knives at the suspect's apartment and seized them.

title: Schüsse auf Wohnhaus
summary: Shots were fired at a residential building in Spandau on the evening of 31 July, around 20:15. Two suspects fled, and bullet holes were found in an apartment door; nobody was hurt.

title: Bedrohung mit Messer – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: A 77-year-old man allegedly threatened a neighbour with a knife in Britz after an argument. Police used a taser on him during an apartment search; the knife turned out to be a replica.

title: Festnahme von mutmaßlichen Fahrraddieben - Mehrere verletzte Polizeikräfte
summary: Two suspected bicycle thieves were arrested after plainclothes officers saw them break a bike lock; during the arrest, five officers were injured in resistance and attacks. A third suspect escaped.

title: Fahrzeuge durch Brand beschädigt
summary: Several parked cars were damaged by a fire in a sports facility car park in the Märkisches Viertel. Three vehicles are no longer roadworthy, and no one was hurt.

title: Schüsse auf Imbiss
summary: Shots were fired at a snack bar in Mariendorf from a moving vehicle around 2:20 a.m. Two people were inside, and nobody was hurt.

title: Trickbetrug durch falsche Polizeibeamte – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Callers posing as police officers told a 76-year-old man that his wife had caused a serious traffic accident and needed bail, and he handed over gold to an unknown person. Police are seeking public help identifying the suspect from a surveillance image.

title: Vermisster Senior ist wieder da
summary: A 66-year-old man reported missing from a care facility in Pankow has been found again and taken to hospital by rescue workers. The missing-person search was originally launched on 17 April 2026.

title: Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erfolgreich - Tatverdächtiger ermittelt
summary: A 17-year-old was attacked on the U8 platform at Alexanderplatz subway station with punches and kicks, suffering facial injuries. A suspect has now been identified after a public appeal, and investigations continue.

title: Senior angegriffen und erheblich verletzt
summary: An unknown man punched and pushed a 77-year-old pedestrian from behind on Kleiststraße, causing him to fall and suffer serious head and shoulder injuries. The attacker fled toward Lietzenburger Straße.

title: Radfahrer von Lastwagen angefahren
summary: A truck turning right at the Turmstraße junction hit an 80-year-old cyclist, who fell and was pulled under the vehicle. The cyclist suffered hip injuries and polytrauma and was taken to hospital.

title: Umfangreiche Einsatzmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – BAO Ferrum und EG Telum vollstrecken Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse
summary: Police raided twelve properties in Berlin and Hamburg in a coordinated operation against weapons trafficking, seizing seven firearms, ammunition and about 6,000 euros plus large cash sums. Six suspects aged 40 and 66 are investigated; the people found were released after the measures.

title: Kind bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A 42-year-old driver hit a seven-year-old boy crossing Werneuchener Straße in Alt-Hohenschönhausen on the evening before the report. The boy suffered head and leg injuries and was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 2. August 2026
summary: Police issued a general order banning public assemblies and events in the government district around the Sinti and Roma memorial in Berlin-Mitte on 2 August 2026, the international day of remembrance. The restriction runs from 6:00 to 23:59 to protect commemorations and quiet remembrance.

title: Autofahrer bei Zusammenstoß mit Straßenbahn erheblich verletzt
summary: A 90-year-old driver collided with a tram at the Mehrower Allee crossing in Marzahn and was trapped in the car, requiring fire brigade extrication. He was seriously injured but reportedly not in mortal danger, and the crossing was closed until 3 p.m.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Brand auf Schulgelände
summary: Overnight, unknown suspects entered a school sports ground in Zehlendorf, forced open a equipment shed, and set sports equipment alight in a long jump pit. Police are investigating criminal damage and arson.

title: Sachbeschädigung in Parkanlage
summary: Unknown persons damaged a vase and set fire to a cardboard heart in a park area in Tiergarten. The case was reported to police on the same day and taken over by the State Protection unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Denkmal mit Hakenkreuz beschmiert
summary: A swastika was painted on a memorial to antifascist resistance fighters in a park in Weißensee. Police removed the paint and the political police unit (Staatsschutz) took over the investigation.

title: Ermittlungen nach Schussabgaben führen zur Festnahme eines Tatverdächtigen
summary: In March 2026, several shots were fired during an altercation on Karl-Marx-Straße, injuring an uninvolved 24-year-old in the leg. A 40-year-old suspect was arrested on 24 July 2026 in Sonnenallee.

title: Knallgeräusch löst Polizeieinsatz aus
summary: A loud bang reported in Falckensteinstraße was followed by a power outage affecting several buildings in the area. A short circuit in a nearby transformer station is believed to have caused the outage, and no one was hurt.

title: Brand an Gemeinschaftsunterkunft
summary: Fire was set against the facade of a refugee shelter in Hellersdorf overnight; a burning object was thrown at the building. The fire was extinguished by a security service, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mit Maschinenpistole bedroht – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 42-year-old man allegedly lured a 25-year-old into his flat, demanded his phone and laptop, and threatened him with a submachine gun and a machete. The suspect was arrested in the stairwell and the weapon was seized.

title: Mann durch Schuss aus mutmaßlicher Schreckschusswaffe und Reizgas verletzt
summary: A 23-year-old man was attacked on the U2 platform at Alexanderplatz station by three unknown men; one allegedly fired a blank-firing gun into his face, and the attackers then sprayed him with pepper spray. He was injured in the eyes and skin and taken to hospital.

title: Mit Luftdruckgewehr auf Passanten geschossen – Tatverdächtiger vorläufig festgenommen
summary: In the early hours, a man was hit by an air rifle pellet on Falkenseer Damm in Spandau and suffered a superficial skin injury. A 28-year-old suspect was arrested in a nearby flat, where police seized an air rifle, a blank pistol, a butterfly knife and an axe.

title: Mutmaßlicher Brandstifter greift Polizeikräfte an – Schusswaffengebrauch
summary: Police officers fired their service weapons at a 38-year-old suspected arsonist who allegedly attacked them with an axe after a fire in an apartment building. He was taken to hospital, and two residents were hospitalised for smoke inhalation.

title: Streit eskaliert – zwei Männer erleiden Stichverletzungen
summary: After a dispute over drug dealing in Gesundbrunnen, two men aged 24 and 25 were stabbed by members of a group. Four suspects were arrested nearby, and a knife and the stolen phone were recovered.

title: Auffahrunfall mit mehreren beteiligten Polizeifahrzeugen
summary: A convoy of eight police vehicles with lights and siren on the A115 in Nikolassee was involved in a multi-vehicle collision with a civilian car. Six emergency vehicles and one other car were damaged, and nobody was injured.

title: Anschlag im Umfeld des Christopher Street Day - Tatverdächtiger bei Polizeieinsatz erschossen
summary: A 21-year-old suspect in an attack near the Christopher Street Day events was shot dead by special forces during a police operation in a garden colony after allegedly attacking them with a stabbing weapon. Investigations are ongoing.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei endet in Sackgasse
summary: A 19-year-old driver fled from plainclothes police at high speed in a BMW, including on sidewalks and through a red light, before ending in a dead-end street. He and his 20-year-old passenger were arrested, and the car was seized.

title: Körperliche Auseinandersetzung zwischen mehreren Personen
summary: Four men got into a verbal and physical fight in a park in Moabit around 17:30, with a dog involved. Several people were injured, some with a glass bottle, a hammer and a knife, and the dog was stabbed.

title: Mann bespuckt und beleidigt Passanten und Polizeikräfte
summary: A likely intoxicated man spat at and threatened passers-by and police officers on Frankfurter Allee and threw objects around. He was taken into custody, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Senior nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben – Polizei sucht Ersthelfer und weitere Zeugen
summary: A 78-year-old man crashed his small motorcycle into a construction barrier on Waidmannsluster Damm in Tegel and died two days later. Police are seeking witnesses, especially a cyclist who helped him after the fall.

title: Gedenktafel beschmiert
summary: Unknown persons painted a swastika on a memorial plaque for Nazi victims in Witzlebenstraße. Police removed the symbol and the State Protection unit (Staatsschutz) took over the investigation.

title: Transfrau ins Gesicht gespuckt
summary: A man on a bicycle allegedly spat at and insulted a 33-year-old trans woman on the street in Wedding. The State Protection unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation for assault and insult.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Farbschmiererei an Moschee
summary: Unknown perpetrators sprayed a two-line paint inscription about 1.5 metres long on the outer facade of a mosque. The community arranged for removal, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Zwei Festnahmen nach mutmaßlichem Raub
summary: Two suspects, an 18-year-old woman and a 26-year-old man, were arrested after a 65-year-old woman was allegedly drugged and cash was stolen from her home. The victim's house door was found open the following morning.

title: Mann rast durch die Stadt – vorläufige Festnahme
summary: A man was arrested after speeding and driving erratically through Gesundbrunnen in a BMW, endangering several road users. During the identity check he resisted and attacked police officers, and three officers were slightly injured.

title: Mann schießt mit Schreckschusswaffe
summary: A man fired two blank shots into the air with a starter pistol in a park in Hellersdorf and then threatened a witness who confronted him. Nobody was hurt.

title: Mann bei Streit mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: After an argument in Lankwitz, a 33-year-old man was stabbed in the upper body with a knife by a 31-year-old man, who was arrested shortly afterwards. The victim was hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries.

title: Mann von mehreren Unbekannten angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A 27-year-old man was attacked by several unknown men on a green area in Kreuzberg after being approached by a stranger. One attacker reportedly struck him with a machete and others used a baseball bat and other objects.

title: Frau stirbt nach Messerangriff
summary: A 43-year-old man allegedly stabbed his 65-year-old mother on a balcony of their shared flat in Mariendorf; she died in hospital. The 7th Homicide Commission is investigating.

title: Mann durch wegrollendes Auto verletzt
summary: A 68-year-old man was run over by his own car, which rolled backwards from a parked position in Bohnsdorf, and suffered internal injuries. The car also damaged two parked vehicles before stopping; he is not in danger of his life.

title: Mann und Hund von Autofahrer angefahren
summary: A car driver hit a 32-year-old man and his dog on Sonnenallee in Neukölln around midnight while the man was trying to catch the dog. The man suffered head and torso injuries and was admitted to hospital; the dog died at the scene.

title: Mann mit Hammer angegriffen und ausgeraubt
summary: Two men aged 18 and 20 allegedly attacked a 49-year-old man with an emergency hammer and robbed him of his wallet and phone. Both suspects were arrested near Heidelberger Platz and released after identification measures.

title: Frau mit Messer angegriffen und angezündet
summary: A man allegedly attacked his ex-partner and a neighbour with a knife in a homeless shelter, then doused the woman with suspected petrol and set her on fire; a neighbour put out the flames with a blanket. The woman suffered burns and cuts, and the suspect fled.

title: Bei Auseinandersetzung mit Messer verletzt
summary: After an argument between two groups, one person from the smaller group allegedly stabbed two young men, aged 18 and 19, who were treated as outpatients. The attacker's group fled and escaped.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Radfahrer verletzt
summary: A cyclist aged 55 fell after braking hard to avoid a car turning right at the Fahrenheitstraße junction on Osdorfer Straße in the evening. The unidentified driver left the scene, and the cyclist was taken to hospital with shoulder injuries.

title: Toter identifiziert
summary: A man whose body was found in the Havel at Schwanenwerder island in December 2023 has now been identified. The case was handled by the State Criminal Police Office, which had sought public help with his identity.

title: Streit im Straßenverkehr eskaliert
summary: After a verbal dispute over a driver's speed, a 28-year-old man was struck by a BMW driver who then fled the scene. The 28-year-old was injured and the suspected driver was later found to be over the alcohol limit.

title: Verfolgung auf der Müggelspree – Festnahme nach Bootsdiebstahl
summary: A 19-year-old man allegedly stole a motorboat from a mooring in Köpenick and fled across the Müggelspree before being arrested near Friedrichshagen. He later resisted and insulted police officers at the station.

title: Festnahmen nach Wohnungseinbruch
summary: Police arrested three suspected burglars after a break-in at a ground-floor flat in a rear building, where a window was smashed and items were stolen. The men were found in a car with suspected stolen goods from the flat and possibly another burglary.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car struck a five-year-old child on a bicycle crossing a pedestrian crossing at Heiligenseestraße/Reiherallee. The child suffered a shoulder fracture and was taken to hospital.

title: Brandstiftung an einer Arztpraxis
summary: A man set several waste containers on fire against the wall of a medical practice in Galenstraße, and the flames spread to the building facade. He then turned himself in at a federal police station; nobody was hurt.

title: Einsatzkräfte mit Schusswaffe bedroht - Festnahmen
summary: Police stopped a car after its occupants threatened civilian officers and another unidentified person with a weapon during the night. Three toy guns were found in the vehicle, and the driver's licence and car were seized.

title: Auseinandersetzung im Bus mit Pfefferspray
summary: Two unknown men fought on a BVG bus on line 122 and one sprayed the other with pepper spray. Three people, including the bus driver, suffered facial irritation and refused treatment.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall tödlich verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old car driver pulling out of a parking bay to turn collided with a 19-year-old motorcyclist on Vorarlberger Damm. The motorcyclist died at the scene despite resuscitation attempts, and two other people were treated in hospital.

title: Auf Fahrbahnen zugerannt und Widerstand geleistet – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: A 29-year-old man in a mental health crisis repeatedly ran toward vehicles on Blumberger Damm and then resisted officers during transport to a hospital. A police officer used a conducted electrical weapon (DEIG) on his arm after a warning; he was not injured and was admitted to psychiatric care.

title: Mann mit Messer angegriffen
summary: A 29-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 26-year-old man near a barbershop in the evening, after an earlier argument. The injured man was taken to hospital and is not in danger of his life.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: An 84-year-old driver hit an 18-year-old pedestrian while turning left at a crossing in Spandau. The pedestrian was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Mit Messer und Baseballschläger lebensbedrohlich verletzt
summary: Four unknown men attacked a car with a baseball bat and stabbed an 18-year-old occupant, who was seriously injured. Two companions aged 16 and 20 were hurt by shattered windows.

title: Zwei Männer nach Messerangriffen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 22-year-old man stabbed a 25-year-old man in Kreuzberg shortly after 0:40 a.m. and then stabbed a second 25-year-old man nearby. Both victims were taken to hospital, and the suspect was arrested with the knife.

title: Rassistisch beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: A 22-year-old woman was struck in the face and racially insulted by a 76-year-old man on a sidewalk in Kreuzberg. No injuries were found by the ambulance crew, and the case was handed to the State Protection unit.

title: Festnahmen und Durchsuchungen in Berlin nach Schussabgaben
summary: Police and prosecutors executed six search warrants across Berlin against five suspects linked to shots fired at a house in Spandau on 1 May 2026 and an attempted coerced payment in June 2026. Three suspects were arrested and arrest warrants are being sought.

title: Mann bei Messerangriff am Auge verletzt
