summary: A 36-year-old man was stabbed in the eye by one of three attackers outside a snack bar in Kreuzberg early in the morning. A passerby intervened, and the attackers fled.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlich homophober Beleidigung und Bedrohung
summary: A 38-year-old man was allegedly insulted for being gay and threatened with a knife in the Südpark in Wilhelmstadt. Police arrested a 38-year-old suspect near the scene, seized the alleged knife, and the State Protection unit is investigating.

title: Radfahrer bei Ausweichmanöver gegen geparktes Auto geprallt
summary: A 24-year-old cyclist swerved to avoid a car overtaking too closely, crashed into a parked car and was injured. The driver did not stop and fled the scene.

title: Senior in Wohnung beraubt und verletzt
summary: Several unknown perpetrators forced their way into a flat in Weißensee by knocking, attacked the 72-year-old tenant with a baseball bat and iron bar, and searched the apartment. The tenant was injured and sprayed with pepper spray before the suspects fled.

title: Pyrotechnik explodiert – Mehrere Verletzte
summary: Unknown persons allegedly set off several pyrotechnic devices in Käthe-Dorsch-Ring in Gropiusstadt around 20:40, injuring three children and a woman. Police are investigating for causing an explosion and dangerous bodily injury.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe sichergestellt
summary: A loaded firearm was seized after a witness saw an unknown man leave it under a parked car on Zimmerstraße the previous evening. The car had left the spot shortly afterwards, and the investigation is handled by a LKA specialist unit.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei – Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall festgenommen
summary: A 19-year-old driver fled a police traffic check at high speed and crashed into a parked van in Hellersdorf. He was arrested; his passenger escaped, and the rental car was seized.

title: Mann nach räuberischem Diebstahl im Juweliergeschäft gesucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A man opened a display case in a jewelry shop in the Eastgate shopping centre and took jewelry. When a saleswoman confronted him, he fled and physically struggled with her, leaving her with minor injuries.

title: Mann durch Schussabgaben verletzt
summary: A 33-year-old man was shot in the legs in an altercation with three unknown men in Reinickendorf. He underwent surgery and is hospitalized; police say his life is not in danger.

title: Vom Unfallort geflüchtet und weiteren Unfall verursacht
summary: A 23-year-old driver under the influence of drugs hit a traffic bollard and fled the scene, then crashed into two parked cars at another junction. He was slightly injured, and police seized two weapons and a folding knife from his car.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 50-year-old e-scooter rider died after colliding with a car at the Blücherstraße/Urbanstraße junction in the early hours. Traffic accident investigators have taken over the case.

title: Alkoholisierter Kleintransporterfahrer ohne Fahrerlaubnis fährt gegen Motorrad
summary: A van driver allegedly under the influence of alcohol and without a valid driving licence turned into a motorcyclist at the Brunnenstraße/Bernauer Straße junction. The 18-year-old motorcyclist was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Autofahrer fährt Radfahrer an
summary: A car driver attempting to overtake collided with a cyclist on Elisabethstraße in Marzahn, causing the cyclist to fall. The cyclist was taken to hospital with head injuries.

title: Autofahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 40-year-old van driver allegedly turned left at high speed and caused a collision in which a 59-year-old driver was seriously injured and two cars were damaged. The van driver, who had no valid licence and reportedly about 2.9 per mille alcohol, was held by an off-duty officer and a blank-firing pistol was seized.

title: Überprüfung im Straßenverkehr führt zu Schusswaffenfund
summary: Police stopped a car for suspected drunk driving in Reinickendorf and found a loaded pistol, nitrous oxide canisters, cannabis, medication blisters and cash inside. Both occupants were arrested on suspicion of illegal drug dealing and later released.

title: Ausschreitungen in der Rigaer Straße – Strafermittlungsverfahren eingeleitet
summary: Over the weekend of 11 July 2026, groups in Friedrichshain set fires on the street, burned bins and a construction barrier, and attacked police with pyrotechnics and a glass bottle during a rally-related disturbance. No one was injured; four criminal proceedings were opened.

title: Zwei mutmaßliche Drogendealer festgenommen
summary: Police arrested two suspected drug dealers aged 25 in Kreuzberg and seized large quantities of drugs, including about 1.3 kg of amphetamine and 4.2 kg of ketamine, from a suspected bunker flat. Cash, scales, a knife and a blank-firing gun were also secured.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Unfall verletzt
summary: A motorcyclist (53) rear-ended a car on Bernauer Straße in Tegel, fell, and collided with a cyclist (57). The motorcyclist and cyclist were injured, and the road was closed for about an hour.

title: Geldausgabeautomat aus Spätkauf entwendet
summary: Unknown masked offenders forced entry into a convenience store and stole a cash machine, loading it into a waiting car. They fled in an unknown direction shortly before 2 a.m.

title: Verdacht des erpresserischen Menschenraubes im Supermarkt - Untersuchungshaft
summary: A 29-year-old man allegedly held a supermarket employee hostage at knifepoint, using pepper spray and restraints, and made demands. Police freed the woman the next morning and overpowered the suspect with a stun device; he was remanded in custody.

title: Verletzter nach Schussabgabe
summary: A 46-year-old man shot a 48-year-old man in the chest with an air rifle during a dispute on a site in Oberschöneweide. The injured man underwent surgery and is not in mortal danger; the suspect was not found during a search of his home.

title: Farbschmierereien an Fahrzeugen und Hausfassaden - Festnahme
summary: Early in the morning, several vehicles and building facades in Wedding were sprayed with paint, some with political content. A 38-year-old man was arrested with two spray cans and later released, and the State Security unit took over the politically motivated cases.

title: Mit Schusswaffe bedroht - Festnahmen
summary: Three men met on Borussiastraße over a money claim, and one allegedly threatened a 23-year-old with a firearm to press the demand. Police arrested the group after a chase and seized a live handgun and ammunition.

title: Fahrradfahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A car and a cyclist collided on Hellersdorfer Straße at about 9:25 p.m. after the cyclist crossed the road via the central reservation. The cyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe bei Personenüberprüfung im Hosenbund gefunden – Haftbefehl erlassen
summary: Police found a loaded firearm and suspected cocaine on a 39-year-old man during a patrol check at Körnerpark. He was arrested and a judge issued an arrest warrant.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer und unerlaubt mitfahrende Sozia bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 16-year-old e-scooter rider and an unauthorized 15-year-old passenger were injured after a collision with a car on Britzer Straße in Mariendorf. The car driver, 21, could not stop in time.

title: Kind bei Zusammenstoß mit Radfahrer verletzt
summary: An eight-year-old girl was injured when she collided with a cyclist at a crossing in Friedrichshagen and suffered a leg fracture. The cyclist was unhurt.

title: Senior in Kleingartenanlage überfallen
summary: Several unknown attackers tried to rob a 77-year-old man in a allotment garden area in Charlottenburg after he refused to hand over his valuables. He was beaten, bitten and injured with a pointed object, and taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Streit eskaliert – Angriff mit Schlagring auf jungen Mann
summary: Two people were fighting outside a bar in Rathausstraße. When an 18-year-old tried to break it up, one of them allegedly struck him repeatedly in the face with a knuckleduster, leaving him with a facial laceration.

title: Unbekannte greifen Parkbesucher an
summary: Several unknown attackers assaulted a 39-year-old man near the public toilets in James-Simon-Park, apparently because of his sexual identity. Shortly after, a 19-year-old was chased to the Spree embankment, knocked down, and attacked by a group that also sprayed pepper spray.

title: Radfahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall mit Sattelzugmaschine notoperiert
summary: A truck tractor collided with a 58-year-old cyclist on Warschauer Straße, and a wheel ran over her arm. She was taken to hospital with a suspected arm fracture and underwent emergency surgery.

title: Ermittlungen wegen queerfeindlichen Angriffs und Beleidigung
summary: A 51-year-old non-binary person was insulted and attacked by three unknown youths in Hakenfelde, with objects thrown and fireworks set off nearby. The person was unharmed, and the police state protection unit is investigating a possible queer-hostile motive.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Rettungswagen bei Sonder- und Wegerechtsfahrt im Kreuzungsbereich
summary: A car collided at an intersection with an ambulance responding under emergency rights, pushing the car into a waiting van. All three vehicles were rendered undriveable.

title: Moscheemauer mit Farbschmierereien beschädigt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: Around 0:45 a mosque's outer wall on Columbiadamm was sprayed with large black graffiti over about 150 meters. A 30-year-old suspect was arrested at the scene and later released after police measures.

title: Jugendliche E-Scooter-Fahrer verletzt
summary: Two teenagers on an e-scooter (aged 14 and 13) were injured in a collision with a car at a junction in Kladow. The 48-year-old driver was not hurt.

title: Toter Säugling aufgefunden – Tatverdächtige ermittelt
summary: A dead infant was found on a lawn in a residential complex in Lichterfelde, and a juvenile female suspect has been identified by the homicide unit. The investigation continues.

title: Festnahme nach versuchtem Geschäftseinbruch – Haftbefehl vollstreckt
summary: A 20-year-old man was arrested after attempting to break into a bakery at night; an off-duty police officer caught him and police seized his tools. No loot was taken, and a judge later ordered his detention.

title: Verkehrsunfall auf Einsatzfahrt
summary: A police patrol car responding to an emergency call collided with a car at the Otto-Braun-Straße/Alexanderstraße intersection in the evening. Both vehicles were no longer roadworthy, and one officer was injured.

title: Unter dem Einfluss von berauschenden Mitteln zwei Verkehrsunfälle verursacht
summary: A 36-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol and drugs crashed into a parked car and rolled his vehicle onto its roof in Tempelhof. He had earlier hit two other parked cars and fled the scene.

title: Autofahrerinnen ungebremst miteinander kollidiert
summary: Two car drivers collided at an intersection in Marzahn, causing one car to roll over and hit a traffic sign. A pedestrian and a passenger were injured, and both vehicles were badly damaged.

title: Vermisstes Mädchen wieder im Kreise der Familie
summary: A nine-year-old girl reported missing since 29 June 2026 after failing to arrive at school has been found safe and unharmed. She was returned to her mother.

title: Haftbefehl wegen Verstößen gegen das Waffengesetz vollstreckt
summary: A 35-year-old man was arrested in a courtroom after a hearing on a weapons law violation, under an arrest warrant for a later offence in May 2026 when he was found with a firearm and magazines. Two more firearms and ammunition were seized during a search of his residence.

title: 20-Jähriger nach Raubserie in Berlin festgenommen
summary: A 20-year-old suspect was arrested in Rudow over a series of robberies in which men were lured to meetings via dating apps and robbed at gunpoint or with threats in 2025. The main accomplice was previously sentenced to five years in prison.

title: Schleuser sollen Sprachzertifikate gefälscht haben – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt
summary: Police executed search warrants at five residences and one business premises in Wedding, Kreuzberg and Lichterfelde over suspected forged language certificates and residence confirmations used for people-smuggling. Four suspects were found during the searches, and no arrests were made.

title: Mann bei Streit mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: During a dispute at Boxhagener Platz, a 43-year-old woman allegedly stabbed a 31-year-old man in the neck with a kitchen knife. She was arrested at the scene and the man was taken to hospital with injuries that were not life-threatening.

title: Unter Drogeneinfluss vor Polizei geflüchtet und Verkehrsunfall verursacht
summary: A scooter rider under the influence of drugs fled a police check at high speed, running red lights and riding on pavements. He crashed into a car at an intersection and was injured; he had no licence and the scooter was stolen.

title: Mann bei Raubüberfall verletzt
summary: A 21-year-old man was robbed at knifepoint by four masked men on a hill beside the Monbijou fountain in Mitte and suffered cut and stab wounds. The attackers fled with cash and his bank card.

title: Fahrradfahrer nach Unfall verletzt
summary: A car turning left collided with a 64-year-old cyclist on Neuendorfer Straße in Hakenfelde, causing the cyclist to fall. The cyclist was taken to hospital with back injuries.

title: Raub auf ein Pfandleihhaus – Tatverdächtige flüchten
summary: Several masked suspects forced their way into a pawnshop, threatened staff with a firearm and fled with jewelry after spraying fire extinguisher powder. Four employees suffered respiratory irritation and declined medical treatment.

title: Mehrere Fahrzeuge in Flammen
summary: Several cars and trucks were set on fire on Heerstraße in Wilhelmstadt overnight, and firefighters extinguished the vehicles. Six cars, three trucks and a trailer were damaged, and nobody was hurt.

title: Autofahrer fährt mit Fahrzeug mehrfach gegen Tunnelwand und flüchtet
summary: A driver speeding on the A111 motorway in Tegel crashed several times into a tunnel wall and fled on foot; the occupants were found nearby, and one person with an open arrest warrant was taken into custody. No one was reported injured.

title: Tötungsdelikt in Krankenhaus – Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 26-year-old man fatally injured a 65-year-old man with an unknown object in a hospital after an argument on the previous evening. The suspect was arrested at the scene and a homicide unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Raubüberfall auf Grillimbiss
summary: An unknown man entered a grill snack bar on Brunnenstraße, talked with an employee, then used physical force to take cash and fled, possibly in a waiting car. Police published surveillance images seeking the suspect.

title: Mit Schreckschusspistole auf Mann geschossen
summary: A 27-year-old man was shot at with a blank-firing pistol that discharged irritant gas after an argument with several men in Meinekestraße. He was injured and treated as an outpatient at a hospital.

title: Zigarettenautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a cigarette vending machine in the Hansaviertel overnight and fled by vehicle. No one was hurt.

title: Bewaffneter Überfall auf Schnellrestaurant
summary: A masked person threatened a fast-food restaurant employee with a pistol at about 3:10 a.m. demanding the cash register be opened. The employee sprayed the attacker with pepper spray and the attacker fled without loot.

title: Auseinandersetzung zweier Personengruppen
summary: Two opposing politically motivated groups clashed at a building in Hellersdorf over use of rooms, with fire extinguishers emptied and objects thrown. Later, people on the roof were seen attacking each other with baseball bats; 29 people were detained and no one was hurt.

title: Polizeibeamter bei Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Drogenhandel verletzt
summary: Police arrested a 35-year-old driver after observing a suspected drug handover near Heidelberg Square in Schmargendorf. A 42-year-old resisted arrest, biting and striking an officer, who was injured.

title: Frau bei Auseinandersetzung mit Messer verletzt
summary: A 41-year-old man allegedly stabbed his 79-year-old mother with a knife in an apartment in Moabit. The woman fled, neighbours alerted police, and the suspect was arrested nearby.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe aus dem Verkehr gezogen
summary: Police observed a suspected drug handover in Anita-Berber-Park and seized a loaded firearm with ammunition under a tree trunk nearby, plus a small amount of suspected amphetamine. Two men were taken into custody for identification measures and later released.

title: Dreizehnjährige wieder da
summary: A 13-year-old girl who left her father's home on 23 April 2026 is reported missing. She has been found safe in Duisburg, according to the follow-up report.

title: Schüsse auf Firmengebäude und geparktes Fahrzeug
summary: Bullet holes were found in a company building and a company vehicle parked in front of it in Wilmersdorf. Several cartridge casings were secured, and no one was hurt.

title: Mit Reizgas in Straßenbahn gesprüht
summary: An unknown man allegedly insulted and pushed members of a group on a tram in Oberschöneweide with xenophobic remarks, then sprayed pepper spray inside the tram. Eleven people were injured and the suspect escaped.

title: Radfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A 70-year-old cyclist was seriously injured when he was hit by a tram while crossing Rudower Chaussee in Adlershof. The tram driver was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Mutmaßlich mit Messer verletzt
summary: Two 17-year-old males were injured with cuts after a confrontation between two groups of youths in Volkspark Mariendorf. An unknown person allegedly drew a machete and attacked them.

title: Frau bei Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A 58-year-old woman died in a flat fire in a multi-family building in Lichterfelde. A 77-year-old neighbour was treated for suspected smoke inhalation, and the fire is being investigated as possible negligent arson.

title: Polizei warnt vor falschen Pflegedienstmitarbeitenden
summary: Police warn of a rising number of distraction thefts by suspects posing as care service staff who enter seniors' homes and steal money and valuables. The suspects are mostly two women and the thefts occur citywide.

title: Versuchte gefährliche Körperverletzung nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: After a traffic collision in which a six-year-old girl was lightly hurt, a 44-year-old man ran at the driver with a utility knife and was stopped when an officer drew his service weapon. He was arrested and later released, and investigations are ongoing.

title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahme wegen Raubtat am S-Bahnhof Karlshorst
summary: Five suspects, aged 14 to 21, were charged over a group assault and robbery of a 31-year-old man at Karlshorst station on 9 May 2026; police raided seven addresses in several states. The victim was hospitalised, and one suspect was arrested for threatening a pursuer with a blank-firing pistol.

title: Schussabgabe in Spätkauf-Geschäft
summary: An unknown man threatened a 20-year-old shop employee at a late-night shop with a gun and fired a shot into the floor before fleeing. The employee was not injured.

title: Vermisste 18-Jährige tot aufgefunden
summary: An 18-year-old woman reported missing since 16 June 2026 was found dead two days before publication; police found no sign of a crime.

title: Festnahmen nach räuberischer Erpressung von Jugendlichen
summary: Two teenagers on a school trip were threatened and robbed of wallets and phones near Alexanderplatz station after midnight. Police arrested two suspects, aged 15 and 20, and recovered part of the stolen property.

title: Raubüberfall auf Bordell
summary: An unknown man entered a brothel in Gesundbrunnen at about 3 a.m., threatened six employees with a firearm and stole cash, three mobile phones and a backpack. The employees were not injured.

title: Mann durch Flaschenwurf verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man was hit on the back of the head by a thrown glass bottle in a park after being insulted, reportedly for his party membership. He was taken to hospital, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Kind nach Unfall in Krankenhaus
summary: A car turning into Pilgramer Straase in Mahlsdorf hit a five-year-old cyclist on the morning of 30 June 2026. The child was pulled out from under the car by rescuers and taken to hospital.

title: Schwerer Landfriedensbruch nach Fußball-WM-Aus
summary: After a public viewing of a World Cup match at Uber Platz, a brawl broke out around 1:30 a.m. following the German team's elimination, with bottles thrown at police and others. Seven people were arrested, and two officers were lightly injured.

title: Explosion auf Betriebsgelände – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: An explosion occurred on the premises of a car dealership in Zehlendorf in the early hours of 26 June 2026, damaging several vehicles and parts of a building. No one was hurt, and the police are seeking witnesses.

title: Gemeinsame Präventionsaktion im ÖPNV im Juli 2026
summary: Joint Berlin police and federal police announcement of a crime-prevention campaign in public transport, with advice sessions at several S-Bahn and train stations on 2 to 7 July 2026. The sessions cover civic courage and protection against pickpockets.

title: Tätlicher Angriff und Widerstand - mehrere verletzte Einsatzkräfte
summary: A 38-year-old man resisted police and attacked officers in Prenzlauer Berg, injuring a police officer's nose and climbing onto a patrol car roof. Twelve officers were treated for irritation after pepper spray was used, and two patrol cars were damaged.

title: Polizeibeamtin bei Einsatz angegriffen und verletzt
summary: After a dispute involving a taxi driver, a 43-year-old woman punched a police officer in the face during an operation at a hotel. The officer was taken to hospital and was treated as an outpatient; the suspect was arrested.

title: Festnahmen nach räuberischer Erpressung und Schussabgabe – BAO Ferrum ermittelt
summary: Masked men threatened a bistro employee with a firearm and demanded money; a shot was fired during a struggle before they fled. Four suspects aged 23 to 28 were arrested shortly afterwards.

title: Mann nach wechselseitiger gefährlicher Körperverletzung notoperiert
summary: A 42-year-old man was beaten and kicked by a group after a verbal dispute and an attempted brawl with a bottle and wooden lath, and needed emergency surgery for a head injury. Police are investigating and a suspect was briefly detained.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe beschlagnahmt
summary: Witnesses reported a man holding a firearm in Kreuzberg; police detained him at Hobrechtbrücke and seized a live handgun with a loaded magazine and a knife. No shots were reported.

title: Sicherheitskooperation (SiKoop) der Länder führt gemeinsame Aktionswoche gegen Straftaten zum Nachteil von älteren Menschen (SÄM) durch
summary: Berlin and four other German states launch a joint action week (29 June to 5 July 2026) on crime against older people, mainly fraud such as phone scams and fake shops. Berlin police are running more than 40 prevention events citywide.

title: Busfahrer verletzt und mit Reizstoff besprüht
summary: Three unknown people boarded a rail replacement bus in Johannisthal and refused to leave when the 67-year-old driver asked them to. One of them struck the driver in the head and sprayed irritant spray in his face; he was treated as an outpatient.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 11-year-old riding an e-scooter collided with a car on Daumstraße in Haselhorst and was injured. The 52-year-old driver was unhurt.

title: Vermisste 16-Jährige wieder da
summary: A 16-year-old girl reported missing after leaving a shared accommodation on 24 June 2026 has returned safely to her family. The police have closed the search.

title: Mann erleidet Stichverletzung und Augenreizung – mutmaßlicher Täter flüchtet
summary: A 33-year-old man was sprayed with irritant gas and stabbed in the upper body during an argument outside a supermarket. The unknown suspect fled with a female companion, and the man was taken to hospital.

title: Aus Hochzeitskorso heraus mit Waffe bedroht
summary: During a wedding convoy in Kaulsdorf, a 20-year-old driver was arrested after a witness reported a gun in his car. Police seized an unloaded blank-firing pistol and ammunition; the driver had earlier pointed the weapon at a passing car's occupants.

title: Versammlungsgeschehen zu einem angezeigten Aufzug anlässlich des 10. Muharram
summary: A registered Ashura march with about 600 participants at its peak went from Berliner Dom to Gendarmenmarkt in Mitte. A children's stage performance was stopped, several participants needed medical treatment for heat-related circulatory problems, and police reported no offences.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung nach Streit – Mann mit Stichverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: After an argument at a refugee accommodation car park in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, a 39-year-old man was stabbed in the leg and taken to hospital. The two attackers fled.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeibeteiligung
summary: A police vehicle responding to an emergency collided with a car at an intersection in Kreuzberg. Two police officers were taken to hospital for outpatient treatment, and the 26-year-old driver of the car was unhurt.

title: Angeschossener Jugendlicher im Krankenhaus
summary: A 17-year-old was shot on a pavement and seriously wounded by an unknown gunman, who fled; a homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing. The victim is in critical condition after emergency surgery.

title: Streit eskaliert – Mann mit Stichverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: After an argument between a man and two unknown men, one attacker stabbed a 25-year-old in the groin and both fled. The victim was taken to hospital, where he underwent emergency surgery.

title: Angriff auf Passanten endet mit DEIG-Einsatz
summary: Early in the morning a man allegedly attacked passers-by with stones and sticks in Nehringstraße and then resisted arrest on Seelingstraße. Police used a DEIG (irritant/discharge device) to make the arrest; no one was reported injured.

title: Queerfeindlicher Angriff
summary: Two unknown men attacked a non-binary person and a trans woman at a junction in Kreuzberg early in the morning after insults, injuring both. The Staatsschutz is investigating the case as queerphobic.

title: Gegenseitig beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: Two groups insulted each other with xenophobic remarks and then fought at a snack bar, using chairs. Three men and one teenager suffered minor injuries and were treated at the scene; a specialist unit took over the investigation.

title: Fußgängerin unter Straßenbahn eingeklemmt
summary: A 16-year-old pedestrian was pinned under a tram after being hit at a pedestrian crossing in Adlershof. She suffered life-threatening injuries but is no longer in immediate danger.

title: Geparktes Fahrzeug in Brand geraten – zwei weitere beschädigt
summary: A parked Audi caught fire overnight in Rudow and two other nearby parked cars were damaged. Nobody was hurt, and the fire cause is being investigated by a arson unit of the LKA.

title: Radfahrer bei Sturz verletzt
summary: A 62-year-old cyclist fell after missing a curb at the Frankfurter Allee junction while overtaking other cyclists. He was taken to hospital with upper-body and head injuries.

title: Fahrradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 22-year-old cyclist suffered serious head injuries after falling from his bicycle on the Dudenstraße cycle path in Kreuzberg. He was given emergency care at the scene and taken to hospital.

title: Mutmaßlichen Einbrecher festgenommen
summary: In the early hours of the night, a 29-year-old rental car business owner found an intruder in his business premises, who fled through a window. Police arrested a 43-year-old suspect nearby shortly afterwards.

title: Mann nach Gewalttat gesucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Police are seeking a suspect in connection with a group assault on a 36-year-old man in front of the S-Bahn station Alexanderplatz, in which the victim was stabbed in the thigh with a knife. The incident occurred on 29 April 2025 shortly before 22:30.

title: Fußgänger nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A 35-year-old pedestrian who was hit by a car at a junction in Moabit on 16 June 2026 died in hospital from his injuries. The report concerns the traffic accident and the pedestrian's death.

title: Fußgängerin nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A motorcycle collided with two pedestrians on Alt-Friedrichsfelde in Friedrichsfelde; one pedestrian died at the scene and an 85-year-old pedestrian later died in hospital. The 19-year-old motorcyclist was also seriously injured.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A BVG bus swerved onto the pavement to avoid a pedestrian crossing against a red light and hit a lamp post, which fell onto passers-by. Several people were injured, including a 68-year-old woman and a 38-year-old man.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A six-year-old girl stepped out between parked cars in Alt-Moabit and was hit by a passing car. She was injured in the pelvis and head area and taken to hospital.

title: Tötungsdelikt in Bäckerei – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 61-year-old man was fatally stabbed at a bakery in Wedding on the evening of 10 June 2026. A 28-year-old suspect was arrested on 19 June and is in pre-trial detention on suspicion of manslaughter.

title: Auf Tauben geschossen – mehrere Druckluftwaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: A man is suspected of shooting pigeons in a residential building stairwell in Charlottenburg. Police searched his flat with a court order, seized more than ten air guns, magazines and ammunition, and the 41-year-old suspect was present during the search.

title: Nach Auseinandersetzung und Widerstand – DEIG eingesetzt
summary: A 25-year-old man threatened a café employee, then was attacked by relatives of the employee and was injured. Police used a distance electroshock device against a 28-year-old who resisted arrest, and an officer was hurt.

title: Sprengstoffexplosion – BAO Ferrum ermittelt
summary: Unknown perpetrators detonated an explosive device in front of an apartment building in Wedding shortly after 2 a.m., damaging the façade, a shop window and several parked cars. No one was injured; a special investigation unit is examining the origin of the suspected grenade.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Fahrzeug der Berliner Feuerwehr - Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A car collided with a Berlin fire brigade fire engine responding to an emergency with lights on at the Fehrbelliner Platz junction. Police are seeking witnesses and video footage; the traffic light phase is under investigation.

title: Tankstelle überfallen
summary: Two unknown men entered a petrol station in Lankwitz shortly before 2 a.m., threatened a 26-year-old cashier with a knife and took money from the till. They sprayed the cashier with pepper spray before fleeing on a scooter.

title: Sechs Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall – Säugling in Lebensgefahr
summary: A rental car turning on Roedernallee collided with another car, injuring six people, including a one-month-old baby in life-threatening condition. The road was closed for about five hours during the investigation.

title: Ermittlungen nach rassistischen und antisemitischen Vorfällen beim Deutschlandspiel
summary: Several men made racist and antisemitic remarks while watching a World Cup match outside a late-night shop in Prenzlauer Berg; a 40-year-old allegedly showed a far-right gesture and was about 2 per mille drunk. Police are investigating, including for incitement of hatred.

title: Politiker an Informationsstand mit Eiern beworfen
summary: A woman on an e-scooter threw several eggs at a member of the Berlin House of Representatives standing at a party information stand. He was hit on the forearm, felt pain, and declined medical treatment; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Antisemitischer Angriff – Geschlagen und bespuckt
summary: A 31-year-old man allegedly insulted, spat at and assaulted a group in Charlottenburg in an antisemitic manner, including a man wearing a kippah and two children. No one required medical treatment, and the Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Mann bei Raub verletzt
summary: A 37-year-old man was robbed of his shoulder bag by two unknown men at about 4:50 a.m. on Kinzigstraße. He was knocked down, kicked in the head and hospitalized with head injuries.

title: Auto in Gegenverkehr geschleudert – drei Verletzte
summary: A car collided with another vehicle at an intersection in Friedrichsfelde and was thrown into oncoming traffic, hitting a waiting car. Three people were taken to hospital for outpatient treatment, including a two-year-old child.

title: Frau geschlagen, getreten und fremdenfeindlich beleidigt
summary: A 23-year-old woman was attacked by two men at Lausitzer Platz, insulted with a presumed xenophobic motive, and kicked and beaten after falling to the ground. Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Bei schwerem Raub verletzt
summary: An 18-year-old man was attacked by four men in Lindauer Allee and robbed of cash and his mobile phone, with one attacker carrying pepper spray. The victim was injured badly enough to need hospital treatment.

title: Polizeikontrolle entzogen und Verkehrsunfälle verursacht
summary: A 19-year-old driver without a driving licence fled a police traffic check on the A100 at about 2:45 a.m., causing several collisions. He was briefly detained on foot before being released after his identity was checked.

title: Angegriffen, randaliert und Einsatzfahrzeug beschädigt
summary: Two men aged 44 and 47 allegedly rioted at a youth facility, attacked a caregiver and a passer-by, and later damaged two police vehicles during arrest and transport. One suspect was taken to hospital for psychiatric reasons.

title: Mann in hilflosem Zustand noch nicht identifiziert - Polizei bittet erneut um Mithilfe
summary: An unidentified man, estimated at 50 to 65 years old, was found in a helpless condition in mid-March 2025 and remains unidentified. Police have released a new photo and are asking for public help.

title: Drei Verletzte Personen nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A car turning left collided with an oncoming car at the Danziger Straße/Prenzlauer Allee junction, which then hit a cyclist and several objects. Three people were injured, including a 52-year-old cyclist with serious injuries.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach mutmaßlichem Driftmanöver
summary: A 22-year-old driver attempting to drift on the A100 lost control, hit a median, and crashed into parked cars in Wilmersdorf. Two people were injured, and the driver was taken to hospital for a blood test.

title: Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – BAO Ferrum und EG Telum stellen bei Durchsuchungen fünf scharfe Schusswaffen sicher
summary: Police and prosecutors executed eleven search warrants against 13 suspects over illegal arms trafficking and extortion, seizing five firearms, drugs, cash and knives. Three suspects were arrested and were to be brought before a judge.

title: Schüsse auf eine Gaststätte in Tempelhof
summary: Shots were fired at a restaurant in Tempelhof overnight, leaving bullet holes in its facade. No one was inside and no one was injured.

title: Reizstoff in Linienbus versprüht – Mehrere Fahrgäste verletzt
summary: During a dispute on a BVG bus in Gropiusstadt, pepper spray was released, injuring nine passengers, two of them children. The suspect was detained for identification and released.

title: Gebissen und Widerstand geleistet – zwei Polizeibeamte verletzt
summary: Police were called to a threat in an apartment and a 30-year-old man resisted officers, biting one of them. Two police officers were injured, one of whom was treated in hospital.

title: Allgemeinverfügung anlässlich des zweiten nationalen Veteranentages – Einschränkungen im Berliner Regierungsviertel
summary: Police issued a general order closing roads and areas in the government district on 21 June 2026 from 8 to 20 hours for the second national Veterans Day. Parking and public assemblies are banned in the marked zones during these hours.

title: Seniorin bei Bremsmanöver in Linienbus verletzt
summary: A bus driver braked for traffic on Wittelsbacherstraße in Lichtenrade, and an 85-year-old passenger fell from her seat and suffered serious head injuries. She was taken to hospital.

title: Einbrecher mithilfe des DEIG festgenommen
summary: A 29-year-old suspected burglar forced entry into an apartment and armed himself with a kitchen knife. Police arrested him after using a conducted energy device (DEIG) when he approached officers, and he was taken to hospital.

title: Randalierer im Kaufhaus festgenommen
summary: A drunk 43-year-old man threw food and a glass in a department store restaurant and then resisted police, biting and headbutting officers. Two officers were lightly injured and the man was taken to a hospital for psychiatric care.

title: Flasche auf Einsatzwagen geworfen
summary: A glass bottle thrown from an elevated station platform struck a police vehicle on Skalitzer Straße, causing scratches but no injuries. A 19-year-old suspect was found nearby, with 1.8 per mille alcohol, and later released.

title: Israelfeindliche Farbschmiererei
summary: Two anti-Israel graffiti were found on the forecourt of Wittenbergplatz U-Bahn station after a witness alerted police on the evening before publication. Police covered up both works, and the State Security department has taken over the investigation.

title: Festnahme nach bewaffnetem Raubüberfall
summary: A 22-year-old suspect allegedly robbed a fast-food restaurant at gunpoint in the night to Sunday and fled in a car whose driver he had forced to drive. He was arrested the following afternoon in Adlershof, and police found cash, cash boxes and a blank-firing pistol.

title: Durchsuchungen und Haftbefehle wegen bandenmäßiger Urkundenfälschung
summary: Police and prosecutors raided 14 residences across Berlin and arrested five suspects over an alleged gang forging language certificates sold nationwide. Ten suspects, aged 22 to 32, are under investigation for gang-based document forgery.

title: Mann leistet nach Verkehrsunfallflucht Widerstand gegen Einsatzkräfte
summary: After a hit-and-run traffic accident in Britz, a man resisted police officers and swung at them without hitting anyone. He was brought to the ground and arrested, and one officer sustained a minor arm injury.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe vom Balkon geschossen
summary: Several shots were fired with a blank-firing gun from a balcony of an apartment building, which police had been alerted to by a resident. Police seized the weapon, magazine and cartridges and opened investigations against the two occupants under weapons law.

title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 17. Juni 2026
summary: Police issued a general order banning public assemblies, marches and rallies at the Memorial for Poland 1939-1945 in Berlin-Mitte on 17 June 2026 to protect the commemoration. The restriction runs from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.

title: Mehrere Fahrzeuge in Brand gesetzt
summary: Six company vehicles were set on fire and burned out on the fenced premises of a telecommunications company in Alt-Hohenschönhausen. A passerby reported the blaze around 1:50 a.m., and arson is suspected.

title: Mit einem Einsatzwagen zusammengestoßen und verletzt
summary: A motorcyclist fleeing police at high speed and running red lights crashed into a police vehicle that had blocked Treskowallee. The 22-year-old rider suffered a leg abrasion and was treated on scene.

title: Festnahme nach Verdacht des unerlaubten Handels mit Betäubungsmitteln
summary: Police arrested a 36-year-old suspected drug dealer who barricaded himself in his flat in Oberschöneweide after a cannabis plantation was found. Over 5 kg of cannabis was seized, and the flat was partly set alight before a special unit forced entry.

title: Mann erlitt Stichverletzungen
summary: A 60-year-old used car dealer was attacked by an unknown man and suffered several stab wounds. The suspect fled toward Schöneberg S-Bahn station, and the victim was taken to hospital.

title: Frau mit Kopftuch fremdenfeindlich beleidigt und mit Messer bedroht
summary: A 59-year-old woman allegedly insulted a 53-year-old woman with xenophobic remarks in a supermarket car park and made stabbing movements with a knife. The suspect was arrested, the knife was seized, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt – drei Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: A 28-year-old man was beaten and stabbed in the thigh by a group after an argument in Wedding; a snack bar owner trying to intervene was sprayed with irritant gas. Three suspects aged 42, 38 and 26 were arrested nearby.

title: Bewaffneter Überfall auf Schnellrestaurant
summary: A masked man robbed a fast-food restaurant in Köpenick around 2 a.m., demanding the till open at gunpoint. He fled with the cash drawer after a shot failed to fire, and nobody was hurt.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen Erpressung vollstreckt
summary: Police executed search warrants in several flats in Tempelhof, Hellersdorf and Kreuzberg in an attempted aggravated extortion investigation. Two firearms, over one hundred rounds of ammunition, drugs and scales were seized and three suspects arrested.

title: Vorläufige Festnahme nach Schussabgabe
summary: Several shots were reportedly fired at the Schwedenstraße/Koloniestraße crossing in Gesundbrunnen. Police found cartridge cases and live rounds on a traffic island and arrested a 17-year-old nearby, who was later released.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A 12-year-old boy was struck by a Jeep and then by a Mercedes on Forckenbeckstraße in Schmargendorf in the late afternoon. He suffered serious injuries and was treated by rescue services and in hospital.

title: Notoperation nach Angriff mit Messer
summary: A 39-year-old man was stabbed in his apartment in the night, and a 43-year-old man was arrested as a suspect. The injured man was taken to hospital in life-threatening condition and underwent emergency surgery.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 45-year-old driver rear-ended a stopped car at a red light on Südwestkorso in Wilmersdorf, injuring four people. The driver was found to have alcohol and suspected narcotics in his car and had a blood sample taken.

title: Mit Stichwunden zurückgelassen
summary: A 19-year-old man was attacked by a group and left with multiple stab wounds near Cottbusser Platz. He underwent emergency surgery and remains hospitalized.

title: Netzwerk aufgedeckt - Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse gegen den illegalen Handel mit Betäubungsmitteln vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors executed 16 search warrants against a drug trafficking network in Berlin, Saxony and Brandenburg, seizing cocaine, cannabis, synthetic drugs and cash. Four people were arrested.

title: Widerstand geleistet – Distanz-Elektroimpulsgerät (DEIG) eingesetzt
summary: Police were called to a restaurant on Karl-Marx-Straße over alleged bill evasion, trespassing and threats by a five-person group. Three men were detained after resisting handcuffing, and a stun device was used on two of them.

title: Not-OP nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A scooter rider aged 39 was seriously injured after a collision with a car at a crossing in Schöneberg. He was taken to hospital for emergency surgery.

title: Festnahme nach Taschendiebstahl
summary: An 18-year-old was arrested after allegedly pickpocketing an 89-year-old man's wallet at Frankfurter Tor subway station. The wallet was returned to the victim, and the suspect was taken into custody pending an arrest warrant.

title: Ein Tatverdächtiger nach räuberischem Diebstahl identifiziert
summary: Two suspects robbed a 53-year-old man at Grenzallee subway station on 10 December 2025, and one of the two knocked him to the ground when he held one of them. Police have identified one suspect following a tip; the search for the second continues.

title: Verstorbene Person nach Wohnungsbrand
summary: A fire broke out in a ground-floor apartment of an apartment building in Wittenau in the night. A man was found dead in the flat, several people were injured and the building is currently uninhabitable.

title: Trickbetrug durch falsche Polizeibeamte – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Police are running a public appeal for information about a suspect in a fraud case where people posing as police officers tricked a victim, which took place in Biesdorf on 18 September 2025. One of two men shown in the earlier appeal has been ruled out, and the search for the other continues.

title: Kind angefahren – Fahrzeugführer flüchtet vom Unfallort
summary: A car driver struck a seven-year-old girl crossing Willdenowstraße in Wedding and then left the scene before emergency services arrived. The child suffered a head wound and knee pain and was taken to hospital.

title: Fahrradfahrerin fährt Kind an
summary: A 29-year-old cyclist hit a five-year-old girl who had allegedly stepped out between parked cars on Königsallee in Grunewald. The child suffered a broken leg and the cyclist was also injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Fahrradfahrer und Motorradfahrer
summary: A motorcycle and a cyclist collided at a pedestrian crossing on Leipziger Straße, and the motorcycle then hit a car turning into Charlottenstraße. The cyclist suffered serious head injuries and the road was closed until 21:00.

title: Diebstahl und Kartenbetrug
summary: Police are searching for an unknown man who allegedly used a debit card stolen in Berlin in November 2024 for fraudulent payments in several German cities, including Aurich. The card was used at a retail store in Aurich on 18 November 2024.

title: Fahrzeuge in Flammen
summary: Overnight, a car and a motorhome were completely burned out and a third car was damaged by heat in a fire on Paul-Lincke-Ufer in Kreuzberg. A witness heard a loud bang around 1:40 a.m. and alerted the fire brigade and police; nobody was injured.

title: Vermisster Senior wieder da
summary: An 87-year-old man with dementia who went missing after leaving a hospital in Neukölln on 21 May 2026 has been found again. The police report was published on 9 June 2026.

title: Nach gewalttätigen Ausschreitungen im Olympiastadion - Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Police are still seeking public help to identify people sought over violent disorder at the Olympiastadion football match of 17 January 2026, in which police officers were attacked and several injured. A police officer initially suspected of involvement was ruled out.

title: Fahrradfahrer und E-Scooter-Fahrer verunfallt
summary: A cyclist overtaking an e-scooter rider on Petersburger Straße in Friedrichshain touched the scooter, and both fell. The 48-year-old cyclist suffered multiple fractures and a skull base fracture.

title: Festnahme nach Räderdiebstahl
summary: Two men were seen removing wheels from a parked car in Mitte and fled in a rental vehicle. Police later found the vehicle, five tyre sets and suspected tools, and arrested a 19-year-old man at his Neukölln flat.

title: Feuer in Sporthalle
summary: A fire broke out in a school sports hall in the Märkisches Viertel on Saturday evening, after a bang was heard. Firefighters extinguished the blaze; nobody was injured, but the hall was heavily damaged.

title: Steine von Autobahnbrücke getreten
summary: A 73-year-old woman was arrested after allegedly pushing paving stones from a bridge onto the A100 motorway and threatening a witness with a stone. No vehicles were hit and no one was injured.

title: Mehrere Einsatzkräfte angegriffen und verletzt
summary: After a police vehicle braked hard on Frankfurter Allee, a 34-year-old man was arrested in Kreutziger Straße. Several people then attacked officers, leaving five police officers injured.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 60-year-old motorcyclist was injured after overtaking via the bus lane and colliding with a waiting car while merging back. Both the motorcyclist and a 24-year-old car driver were hurt, and the road was closed for several hours.

title: Bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A 33-year-old pedestrian was struck by a bus while crossing Goerzallee in Lichterfelde and suffered life-threatening injuries. The 45-year-old bus driver was in shock; a traffic investigation unit took over.

title: Besonders schwerer Landfriedensbruch
summary: A fight between a 26-year-old and a 30-year-old escalated into a brawl involving about 30 people, with bottles and stones thrown. Police used pepper spray during arrests, slightly injuring two bystanders.

title: Einsatzwagen der Polizei verunglückt – acht Verletzte
summary: A police patrol car ran a red light at an intersection at about 6:10 a.m. while on an emergency run and collided with a taxi, overturning the car. Eight people, including seven police officers, were injured, mostly with outpatient treatment.

title: Mann flüchtet im Auto vor Polizeikontrolle - Festnahme
summary: A 34-year-old man fled from a traffic stop in a stolen car at high speed, running red lights and driving on the pavement, before being arrested in Goldammerstraße. Police found a blank-firing pistol, suspected stolen e-scooters and burglary tools in the car.

title: Mann geschlagen und getreten - Festnahme
summary: After a verbal dispute, a 28-year-old man punched a 38-year-old man in the head and kicked him, causing a broken jaw and other injuries. The suspect was arrested nearby, released after identification measures, and investigations continue.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Zugangstor zum Görlitzer Park
summary: Unknown perpetrators smeared a substance into the lock cylinder of a park gate, so it can no longer be closed. The State Security unit of the LKA has taken over the investigation for criminal damage.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 56-year-old driver turning left struck an 85-year-old pedestrian at a crossing in Niederschönhausen. The pedestrian died in hospital from head injuries the following night.

title: Stichverletzung erlitten
summary: After a dispute in an apartment, a 28-year-old allegedly stabbed a 24-year-old man in the leg. The injured man was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries; the suspect was arrested and released after police measures.

title: Ermittlungen gegen eine Dienstkraft der Polizei Berlin wegen des Verdachts eines Gewaltdelikts
summary: Police are investigating an off-duty Berlin police officer suspected of involvement in a violent altercation in Westend at the beginning of the year. The investigation by a Landeskriminalamt unit is ongoing, and possible disciplinary measures are being examined.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach medizinischem Notfall
summary: A 67-year-old driver suffered a medical emergency and crashed into two vehicles on Mariendorfer Damm in Mariendorf. He was found unconscious and died at the scene despite resuscitation attempts.

title: Schussabgaben auf Personen – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Multiple live rounds were fired at a playground in Kreuzberg on the evening of 25 May 2026; a man present was unharmed. Shots were also reportedly fired on Graefestraße from a Mercedes, and the suspects fled.

title: Schwangere Beifahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus
summary: A Peugeot driver veered into oncoming traffic on Osdorfer Straße in Lichterfelde and collided with an electric car. Three people were hurt, including a pregnant passenger who was taken to hospital.

title: Festnahme nach Schüssen mit einer Schreckschusswaffe
summary: A 26-year-old man was arrested after firing shots with a starter pistol outside a restaurant in Wannsee at night. Police seized the weapon and cartridge cases; the man was later released and faces weapons law charges.

title: Nach Fahrstreifenwechsel mitgeschleift – Kradfahrer im Krankenhaus
summary: A truck changing lanes on Seestraße struck and dragged a motorcyclist, who suffered serious leg fractures. The motorcyclist was taken to hospital.

title: Polizeibeamtin angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A 16-year-old driver of a rental car was stopped by police, fled and punched a female officer in the face during his arrest. The officer and the suspect were taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: A 21-year-old man was stabbed and injured with a knife and a bicycle lock in an attack on Mehringdamm shortly after midnight. Police intervened, arrested both suspects, and the victim underwent surgery; his life was not in danger.

title: Spezialeinsatzkräfte nehmen bewaffneten Mann fest
summary: Special forces arrested a 37-year-old man in his Hellersdorf flat after he reportedly went door to door in an apartment block holding a weapon. Police seized two blank-firing guns, an air pistol, two machetes, fireworks and suspected narcotics.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen Verdachts des Menschenhandels und der Arbeitsausbeutung
summary: Police, prosecutors and customs searched three properties in Mitte, Friedrichshain and Kreuzberg in an investigation into suspected human trafficking for labour exploitation against eight suspects. Four workers were found at a kitchen-accommodation site, which was closed for hygiene and fire-safety deficiencies.

title: Frauen sexuell belästigt und Dienstwagen beschädigt – Festnahme
summary: A 45-year-old man was caught tampering with a police vehicle in Bismarckstraße and later allegedly sexually assaulted two women near the police station. He resisted re-arrest and injured an officer.

title: Auseinandersetzung im Volkspark – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A dispute at Volkspark Hasenheide escalated when a man from a group allegedly stabbed a 60-year-old who had tried to mediate. His 48-year-old friend, who came to help, was also stabbed; both were seriously injured and a homicide unit is investigating attempted killings.

title: Motorradfahrer lebensbedrohlich verletzt
summary: A 60-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured after a car collided with him at an intersection in Mitte. The motorcyclist was taken to hospital, and the traffic accident unit is investigating.

title: Fahrzeuge mit Steinen beworfen – Mann festgenommen
summary: A likely intoxicated 52-year-old man threw paving stones at passing cars in Nikolassee, hitting a Toyota driven by a 36-year-old woman. He was arrested after police checks.

title: Verdächtige Männer festgenommen
summary: Police arrested two masked men aged 18 and 19 near a bank branch in Marzahn after a resident reported them. One carried a blank-firing pistol and the other a kitchen knife; investigations into attempted aggravated robbery continue.

title: Zwei Männer durch Schüsse verletzt – Zielfahndung nimmt einen Tatverdächtigen fest
summary: Two brothers were injured by gunshots in a dispute in Kreuzberg. A suspect was arrested on 2026-06-01 in Schöneberg and placed in pretrial detention.

title: Mit Auto der Mutter vor Polizei geflüchtet
summary: A 17-year-old driver fled police in a car belonging to his mother, running red lights and driving against traffic in Friedrichshagen. He was stopped later, and the case was handed to the traffic crime unit for illegal street racing and traffic offences.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 39-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car on Gürtelstraße while crossing from the median strip and was seriously injured. The road was closed to traffic for about 1.5 hours, affecting two tram lines.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: An 80-year-old driver hit an eight-year-old boy on a pedestrian crossing on Teltower Damm in Zehlendorf. The child was taken to hospital with back, hip and facial injuries and suspected internal injuries.

title: Vermisstes Kind dank Zeugenhinweis angetroffen und Ex-Lebensgefährten der Mutter festgenommen
summary: A two-year-old boy reported missing since 29 May 2026 was found on the U3 subway line at Schlesisches Tor after a witness alerted police. A man accompanying the child was arrested and will be brought before a judge.

title: Frau getreten und rassistisch beleidigt
summary: A 32-year-old woman was kicked by a 41-year-old man and racially insulted by another man during an altercation early in the morning. The woman was injured and taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Mutmaßliches Gewaltverbrechen – Zweiter Tatverdächtiger in Untersuchungshaft
summary: Investigators are treating as a homicide the April 2026 abduction of a man in Waidmannslust, who was taken in a white van; a second suspect, aged 32, was remanded in custody on 29 May 2026. A male body found in a forest near Potsdam on 22 May 2026 is being examined for identity.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Radfahrern – Beteiligter entfernt sich vom Unfallort
summary: A cyclist was seriously injured after colliding with another cyclist who then left the scene in Neukölln. The injured 43-year-old was taken to hospital for emergency surgery.

title: Motorradfahrer und Sozia bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car and a motorcycle collided at a junction in Hermsdorf, causing the motorcyclist and his pillion passenger to fall. Both were injured; the passenger was kept in hospital, and police say there is no danger to life.

title: Beleidigung mit rassistischem Hintergrund und tätlicher Angriff auf Polizeivollzugsbeamte
summary: A 35-year-old man was arrested in Wedding after repeatedly making racist insults against two women and attacking police officers. One officer was hurt, and the suspect was also injured and later held in police custody.

title: Diebstahl und Computerbetrug
summary: Two unknown suspects allegedly stole two bank cards and PINs sent by post and made transfers and cash withdrawals between 24 January and 3 February 2025, including at an ATM on Hasenheide. The police are seeking the suspects.

title: Supermarkt-Mitarbeiter mit Schreckschusswaffe bedroht
summary: A 39-year-old man allegedly pointed a blank-firing pistol at a 33-year-old supermarket employee in Rosenthal and was arrested after a witness intervened. Police also found further weapons, suspected narcotics and cannabis plants during follow-up searches.

title: Festnahmen nach Schüssen in die Luft
summary: A man fired a firearm several times into the air in Wedding during the night. Police later searched a nearby venue on Luxemburger Straße, found a loaded handgun and arrested three male suspects aged 30, 32 and 34.

title: In Auseinandersetzung lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A brawl between groups of young men on Prinzregentenstraße in Wilmersdorf left an 18-year-old with a life-threatening stab wound; he is no longer in mortal danger. One suspect turned himself in later that day.

title: Radfahrerinnen zusammengestoßen
summary: Two cyclists collided head-on on the Tempelhofer Feld runway in the evening and fell. One woman, 61, suffered serious head injuries and was taken to hospital; the other, 35, suffered a leg abrasion.

title: Tätlicher Angriff auf Einsatzkräfte – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: Police arrested two 21-year-old men after an alleged drug sale; one allegedly hurled an e-scooter at an officer, who suffered bruises and abrasions. A taser was used to subdue another suspect resisting arrest.

title: Polizist von flüchtendem Auto angefahren – Schussabgabe
summary: After a stolen-plate car was stopped and its 35-year-old passenger arrested, the driver hit an officer with the car while fleeing. The officer's service weapon fired a shot during the incident; the officer was treated as an outpatient.

title: Verkehrsunfall während einer Eilfahrt
summary: A Berlin fire engine responding to an emergency ran a red light at a crossing in Wittenau and collided with a motorcyclist who had green light. The 30-year-old motorcyclist suffered rib and shoulder fractures.

title: Schüsse auf 23-Jährigen - Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: Four suspects aged 16 to 18 were identified and searched in connection with an attempted killing in which a 23-year-old man was shot on the street on 19 March 2026. Several blank-firing guns were seized during the searches.

title: Lkw-Fahrer kollidiert mit mehreren geparkten Fahrzeugen
summary: A truck driver ran a red light on Bismarckstraße in Charlottenburg and collided with several parked vehicles, including police vehicles, before coming to a stop in a tree. The 49-year-old driver was injured and taken to hospital; indications point to a medical emergency.

title: Jugendliche bei Verkehrsunfall mit E-Scooter verletzt
summary: A 14-year-old e-scooter rider left the cycle path and hit a traffic light pole at the Roedernallee/Lindauer Allee junction, injuring her; a 13-year-old passenger was unhurt. Police also found an insurance violation involving the scooter.

title: Vermisstes Kind wieder da
summary: A 12-year-old girl who left a psychiatric outpatient appointment on 28 May 2026 was reported missing; police have since reported that her whereabouts are known again.

title: Festnahmen nach Körperverletzung und Widerstand
summary: A 44-year-old man was punched and injured at Alexanderplatz, and the suspect was arrested nearby. Several companions then resisted officers, and pepper spray was used; one officer was lightly injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit drei Verletzten
summary: A car collision at a junction in Marzahn injured three people on the morning of 27 May 2026. One car was thrown against a lamp post, which had to be removed by the fire service.

title: Mann bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An ambulance with blue lights and siren collided with a cyclist at a junction in Schmargendorf on the evening before publication. The 79-year-old cyclist fell and was taken to hospital with injuries.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car driver allegedly ran a red light at a junction in Lichtenrade and collided with an e-scooter rider on the crossing. The 49-year-old scooter rider was thrown several meters and suffered head and spinal injuries; he was taken to hospital with no life-threatening injuries.

title: Gefährlicher Eingriff in den Straßenverkehr - Festnahme
summary: A 29-year-old man allegedly threw a shoe at a moving car in Köpenick, and the driver stopped to confront him. Police arrested him, used a taser after he resisted, and released him after a blood sample; he had 1.3 per mille alcohol.

title: Bedrohung im Straßenverkehr
summary: After a traffic dispute, a 45-year-old van driver allegedly threatened a 25-year-old motorcyclist with a replica handgun in Karlshorst. Police stopped the van, seized the pistol and magazine, and the driver faces charges of threatening with weapons.

title: Mann nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: An 85-year-old man lost control of his car at a T-junction in Köpenick, crashing through a garden fence and wall into a house facade. He died later in hospital after witnesses and police attempted resuscitation.

title: Mit Schere bedroht – DEIG Einsatz
summary: Police were called to an apartment building where a 33-year-old woman in a psychological crisis threatened officers with scissors. Officers used a conducted energy device (Taser) on her, and she was arrested and taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse vor Lokal
summary: After an argument between two groups near a restaurant in Lübars, several shots were fired. The people involved fled, and police secured several cartridge casings; no injuries were reported.

title: Antisemitischer Angriff – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Five young men allegedly attacked a 40-year-old man and his 45-year-old companion shortly after midnight, insulting the man antisemitically, and a bag was snatched from the woman. Police are seeking witnesses and are investigating the case with the State Protection unit.

title: Mann mit Waffe bedroht
summary: A 45-year-old man allegedly pointed a blank-firing pistol at a 41-year-old man in Zehlendorf and insulted him with a homophobic remark, without firing. Police found the replica weapon on the suspect and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Fensterscheiben eines Anti-Gewalt-Projekts beschädigt und beschmiert
summary: Windows of an anti-violence project facility in Schöneberg were damaged by a stone and a paint smear was found on another pane. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Raub in Lieferdienstfiliale
summary: Two masked men threatened an employee of a fast-food delivery outlet with knives shortly after midnight and took cash from the till. The employee was not hurt and called the police.

title: Mann erleidet lebensbedrohliche Verletzungen
summary: A 38-year-old man with life-threatening stab and cut wounds arrived at a hospital in Reinickendorf; the apartment of a dormitory in Conradstraße was identified as the presumed scene, and a 37-year-old woman was temporarily arrested and later released.

title: DEIG-Einsatz nach gefährlicher Körperverletzung
summary: A 24-year-old man allegedly attacked his 27-year-old brother with a steak knife during a dispute at a house in Falkenhagener Feld, causing knee cuts. When police arrived, the suspect resisted and was subdued with a Taser (DEIG) before being arrested.

title: Frau tot in Wohnung aufgefunden – Ehemann festgenommen
summary: A 69-year-old woman was found dead with a gunshot wound in her apartment in Lichtenrade. Her 84-year-old husband was arrested, and the homicide unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Zeugenaufruf zum Fall der seit 2000 vermissten Sandra Wißmann
summary: A 12-year-old girl disappeared on 28 November 2000 after leaving her home and being last seen near the Kottbusser Damm; the 5th Homicide Commission treats the case as a capital crime. Police and prosecutors issued a public appeal for witnesses on the 25th anniversary of the missing children day.

title: Verbotenes Kraftfahrzeugrennen – Fahrzeuge beschlagnahmt
summary: Police stopped two motorcyclists suspected of speeding and an illegal race on the BAB 113 in Johannisthal. Both vehicles and driving licences were seized, and two traffic offence reports were filed.

title: Schussabgabe auf Bäckerei
summary: Several shots were fired at the storefront of a bakery on Kottbusser Damm around 4 a.m. Police secured several cartridge casings on the roadside, and nobody was hurt.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A car and a motorcycle collided at the Feurigstraße/Dominicusstraße crossing in Schöneberg shortly after midnight. The 28-year-old motorcyclist suffered life-threatening injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Kinder mit Waffe bedroht – SEK-Einsatz
summary: A 35-year-old man allegedly threatened playing children with a long-barrelled weapon from a balcony after a noise complaint. A special operations unit entered the flat and found a rifle without ammunition, prohibited knives and untaxed cigarettes.

title: Homophob beleidigt und Reizstoff ins Gesicht gesprüht
summary: Three people aged 23, 24 and 29 were insulted with homophobic remarks and sprayed in the face with irritant spray by two unknown suspects. The state security unit is investigating.

title: Reizstoff in Straßenbahn versprüht
summary: Two unidentified teenagers sprayed irritant gas inside a tram (line M5) in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, affecting about five passengers. The suspects fled at the Gehrenseestraße stop.

title: Hauswand beschmiert – Festnahme
summary: A 34-year-old man was caught spray-painting a building facade at night and temporarily arrested after trying to flee. The State Protection unit (Staatsschutz) took over the investigation.

title: Auf Mann geschossen – Verletzter im Krankenhaus
summary: A 25-year-old man was shot in the legs during an argument on Naunynstraße in Kreuzberg. The shooter fled and the injured man was taken to hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit anschließendem Fahrzeugbrand
summary: A 21-year-old driver crashed into trees and a road sign on Hüttenweg in the early morning and the car caught fire after he left it. The driver was injured, taken to hospital, and preliminary breath testing showed about 0.8 per mille.

title: Handwerker von Bewohnerin beleidigt, eingesperrt und bedroht
summary: A 63-year-old woman racially insulted a 28-year-old craftsman, blocked his exit from her flat and threatened him with a pepper spray device. Police Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf fahrendes Auto
summary: Shots were fired at a moving car on Urbanstraße from a motor scooter, with a pillion passenger firing from the median strip. The 7th homicide unit is investigating for attempted murder; the occupants were not injured.

title: Autodiebe auf frischer Tat festgenommen
summary: Two men aged 33 and 34 were arrested while allegedly tampering with a car on Ringbahnstraße after a resident alerted police. Tools, diagnostic devices and license plates were found in their vehicle, and the car was seized.

title: Parkbänke mit Farbe beschmiert
summary: Six Middle East-related slogans were sprayed in silver paint on the backrests of four park benches, reported by a passerby. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Tötungsdelikt am Humboldt Forum – letzter Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 20-year-old man died after a brawl between two groups at the Humboldt Forum on 12 September 2025; two other men were slightly injured. The last suspect, a 16-year-old, was arrested at Gesundbrunnen station and remanded.

title: Verdacht des Drogenhandels und illegaler Waffenbesitz
summary: Police arrested two men in Rummelsburg after observing suspected drug dealing at a residential building and searching a car. A search of an apartment found a loaded firearm, ammunition, a knife and large quantities of suspected narcotics.

title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen nach unerlaubten Handel mit Betäubungsmitteln
summary: Police and prosecutors searched apartments, warehouses and an illegal gambling venue in Berlin, Brandenburg, Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt over alleged drug trafficking. Eight suspects were investigated, and three people were arrested.

title: Mann homophob beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: A 35-year-old man was insulted with homophobic remarks and punched in the head by a 23-year-old on a night bus. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation for possible hate crime.

title: Angriff am Alexanderplatz mit transphobem Hintergrund
summary: Three suspects allegedly insulted and pursued two people over their gender at Alexanderplatz, then threw a bottle and beer bottles at them, injuring two. The state security unit is investigating.

title: Frau nach schwerem Raub gesucht - Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erledigt
summary: A man was lured into a residential building in Aronsstraße, where he was robbed by several men and left unconscious. The public search for a female suspect has been closed, and the investigation continues.

title: Mahnmal beschmiert
summary: Unknown persons smeared a memorial for the destroyed synagogue and the Jewish victims of the Shoah in Spandau with wax crayon over recent days. The State Protection unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mit Messer angegriffen und beraubt
summary: A masked man attacked a 19-year-old employee of a convenience store with a knife as he was closing the shop, cutting his thigh, and then demanded cash and fled with the money. The employee was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Schüsse auf Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired at an apartment building on Grüntaler Straße in the night from Monday to Tuesday; a bullet hole was found in a living room window the next day. No one was in the room at the time.

title: Tatverdächtiger nach Messerangriff festgenommen
summary: A 32-year-old suspect was arrested in a shared accommodation in Spandau over a knife attack on a 15-year-old resident during the night of 18 to 19 May. The teenager suffered a stab wound to the back and was operated on; he was not in mortal danger.

title: Mann nach Auseinandersetzung in Wohnung verstorben – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 43-year-old man died after an argument with a 51-year-old man in an apartment. A suspect was arrested and the homicide unit is investigating.

title: Überfall auf Wechselstube – Tatverdächtiger erkannt
summary: An unknown man entered an exchange office at S-Bahnhof Alexanderplatz, pressed an employee against a wall, and tried to steal banknotes from a drawer, strangling her during a struggle. The suspect has since been identified, and the investigation continues.

title: Mutmaßliche Kabeldiebe gefasst
summary: Police arrested three suspected cable thieves after they were seen carrying cables out of a wooded area. Copper cables, tools and a utility knife were seized from a car trunk.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler nach Flucht vorläufig festgenommen
summary: A 30-year-old driver fled a police traffic stop in Köpenick at high speed and was arrested after his car was found parked nearby. Police seized cocaine, ecstasy and cannabis from the car and a later search of his flat.

title: Kinder bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 78-year-old driver hit two nine-year-old children on scooters who rolled out of a driveway onto the road in Wannsee. Both children were taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Brandstiftung im Gewerbegebiet
summary: A deliberate fire broke out in a commercial area in Heinersdorf, spreading to a commercial hall, storage containers and vehicles. The building owner suffered a minor burn while trying to extinguish it.

title: Schüsse auf Unternehmen
summary: Several bullet holes were found in a shop window of a company branch in Turiner Straße overnight. An employee discovered the damage around 4:30 a.m. and alerted police.

title: Wohnung nach mutmaßlichem Betäubungsmittelhandel durchsucht
summary: Police observed a 46-year-old man carrying suspected methamphetamine in Wröhmännerstraße, then searched the apartment of a 54-year-old suspect and seized suspected narcotics, packaging material, cash and a blank-firing pistol. Four children aged five to nine were in the apartment and the youth welfare office was informed.

title: Vermisster 53-Jähriger wieder da
summary: A 53-year-old man missing since 12 May 2026 has been found safe and returned to his residential facility in Schöneberg. He had left the facility on foot in an unknown direction.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: An 85-year-old driver hit a 6-year-old child who ran between parked cars into the road on Regattastraße in Grünau, despite an emergency braking attempt. The child was taken to hospital with a head wound and back injuries.

title: Erfolgreiche Ortung nach Wohnungseinbruch - Festnahmen
summary: Stolen headphones from a burglary in an apartment were located by their tracker at a hotel in Kaulsdorf, and four men were arrested. Stolen goods and burglary tools were found in the hotel room.

title: Blitzeinbruch in Modegeschäft
summary: Overnight, an unknown offender drove a silver car backwards through the locked entrance of a fashion store on Kurfürstendamm and stole several high-value handbags. The car then fled toward Zoologischer Garten and the trail was lost.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt – Mordkommission und Staatsanwaltschaft ermitteln
summary: A 61-year-old man was stabbed in the upper body at a shared accommodation in Lichterfelde and underwent emergency surgery. A 69-year-old suspect was arrested, and a homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Fahrerflucht
summary: A 15-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car on Sonnenallee and taken to hospital with injuries to arm, leg and head. The unidentified driver fled the scene in a dark estate car.

title: Durch Messerstich verletzt
summary: After a physical altercation between two men, one 21-year-old was stabbed in the upper body and taken to hospital. The other man fled the scene by car; police say his life is not in danger.

title: Frau beschädigt Wahlplakat und bedroht Personen mit Holzlatte
summary: A woman damaged an election poster at a party information stand with a wooden plank and threatened a party employee with it. She also repeatedly entered the roadway, forcing drivers to brake or swerve; she was arrested and taken to hospital.

title: Mann rassistisch beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 39-year-old man was racially insulted and struck in the face with a glass bottle by an unknown woman on Frankfurter Allee. The suspect fled, and the man declined further treatment after being attended to by paramedics.

title: Maßnahmen der BAO Ferrum und EG Telum - Schusswaffe bei Wohnungsdurchsuchung gefunden
summary: Police searched an apartment in Kreuzberg used to store licensed firearms, ammunition and narcotics and arrested a 71-year-old suspect. A firearm, ammunition, a non-trivial quantity of cocaine and gold bars were seized.

title: Schüsse auf ein Wohnhaus
summary: Several shots were fired at a residential building in Wittenau overnight. The perpetrator or perpetrators fled, and nobody was injured.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: Two cars collided at the Hasenheide/Jahnstraße junction in Kreuzberg around 23:30, reportedly while one driver was speeding. Four people were injured, and the cars were no longer roadworthy.

title: Feier unter Bewohnern eskaliert - Mann mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: After a party among residents of a refugee shelter escalated, a 38-year-old man was found with several stab wounds in his room. He was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, and two older men were arrested.

title: Schwere Körperverletzung und versuchte räuberische Erpressung – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 33-year-old man was stabbed in the neck at a bus stop in Neukölln early in the morning, and is in critical condition. Hours later, the 36-year-old suspect allegedly threatened a 32-year-old woman with a knife on a bus in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg and was arrested.

title: Hitlergruß gezeigt – Heranwachsender vorläufig festgenommen
summary: A 19-year-old was seen making a Hitler salute in a group in Grünau and was briefly detained. The police state security unit is investigating.

title: DEIG-Einsatz gegen verhaltensauffälligen Mann mit Baseballschläger
summary: A 33-year-old man allegedly threatened a 50-year-old visitor with a baseball bat and locked him in the flat, which led to a police operation. Officers used a taser on the suspect, who was arrested and taken to hospital.

title: Festnahme nach mehreren Straftaten und Angriff auf Polizeibeamten
summary: After being dismissed from his job, a 20-year-old man threatened a woman, stole a canister of liquid soap and caused disturbances in Rudow, then kicked a police officer during his arrest. The officer was injured and the man was taken into preventive custody.

title: Durchsuchungen und Haftbefehle wegen bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels
