summary: Police and prosecutors raided 17 addresses in Spandau and Neukölln over alleged gang-based drug dealing, mainly around Münsinger Park. Two suspects were remanded in custody, and one police officer was lightly injured.

title: Radfahrer flüchtet vor Kontrolle und verletzt Polizeikräfte
summary: A cyclist fled a traffic check in Moabit and struck a police officer with his bicycle, then resisted arrest. Two officers were injured and went off duty after outpatient treatment.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Diebstahl aus Fahrzeug
summary: A man damaged several parked cars and broke into a vehicle in Britz, going through its contents, before being arrested at the Blaschkoallee U-Bahn station. Stolen items were seized from him.

title: Seniorin fährt gegen geparkte Autos
summary: An 86-year-old driver crashed into two parked cars while turning left at a junction in Mariendorf. The driver and her 89-year-old passenger were injured and taken to hospital.

title: Sachbeschädigung - Mahnmal beschmiert
summary: Several graffiti were sprayed on the deportation memorial at Putlitzbrücke in Moabit, reported to police on the afternoon of the previous day. The Staatsschutz (political crime unit) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mit Messer angegriffen und verletzt
summary: After an argument on benches, a three-person group allegedly stabbed a 20-year-old man in the thigh. A 21-year-old passer-by who came to help was also injured, and both were taken to hospital; the suspects fled.

title: Radfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An elderly cyclist crossed a road without watching traffic and collided with a car in Johannisthal. The cyclist suffered serious, life-threatening head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: 56-Jähriger konnte identifiziert werden
summary: Police report that a man, aged 56, previously unidentified after dying in a Weißensee clinic in March 2026, has been identified following public tips. His sister confirmed his identity.

title: Gestohlener Rucksack führt zu mutmaßlichem Drogenhändler
summary: After a stolen tablet was located, police searched a flat in Pappelallee and arrested a 56-year-old suspected thief. Over one kilogram of cocaine, hundreds of ecstasy tablets and other drugs were seized, and the suspect was remanded in custody.

title: Frau mit Waffe bedroht – SEK-Einsatz
summary: A 35-year-old woman was threatened with a firearm and insulted from a window in a courtyard. Police later searched the 63-year-old suspect's flat with a SWAT unit and seized a gas pistol and an air-pressure revolver.

title: An Tankstelle Personen angegriffen und Brand verursacht
summary: A woman allegedly attacked several people with a bottle and a cigarette at a petrol station, then caused a fire by throwing a lit cigarette into spilled petrol. Firefighters contained the fuel trail; no one was reported injured.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Synagoge
summary: Police found paint graffiti covering about 2 by 8 metres on the roof of a synagogue, along with damage to the perimeter fence. No political motive has been identified so far.

title: Stein- und Flaschenwürfe auf Einsatzkräfte
summary: Around ten people attacked police officers with stones and bottles at Kottbusser Tor after a man was arrested for hitting an officer in the face. One officer was injured in the leg and another in the head, hand and knee area.

title: Busfahrer bedroht – Reizgas eingesetzt
summary: A man struck the windows of a BVG bus and threatened the 43-year-old driver, who then used pepper spray against him. The suspect fled toward Hackescher Markt station and the spray device was seized.

title: Wahlplakate beschädigt
summary: Overnight, 42 election posters of a party were damaged with an unknown substance in Baumschulenweg. The state security unit of the LKA is investigating.

title: Achtjähriger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An eight-year-old boy ran onto the road after a ball and was hit by a car, suffering a suspected head injury. He was taken to hospital for treatment.

title: Fußgängerin beim Rangieren angefahren und verletzt
summary: A 59-year-old driver hit an 86-year-old pedestrian while reversing at a property driveway in Rudow. The pedestrian suffered a suspected leg fracture and was taken to hospital.

title: Überfall auf Tankstelle
summary: Several unknown men entered a petrol station in Alt-Hohenschönhausen early in the morning, held an employee and stole a safe. They emptied a powder fire extinguisher in the sales area and fled in a waiting vehicle.

title: Randalierer leistet Widerstand und bespuckt Polizisten
summary: A 27-year-old man who was causing a disturbance in Friedrichshain resisted arrest, kicked officers and spat in an officer's face. One police officer was injured and went off duty.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Diebstahl von Autorädern
summary: Two men aged 24 and 29 were arrested in a car park after allegedly tampering with the wheels of an Audi in the early hours. Burglary tools were seized from them.

title: Auto angezündet
summary: Unknown perpetrators set fire to a parked Mercedes in Lichtenberg in the early hours, after a loud bang was heard. Two neighboring cars, an Opel and a Ford, were damaged, and nobody was hurt.

title: Tätlicher Angriff auf Polizeibeamte – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät eingesetzt
summary: After a dispute at a hostel, a 32-year-old man attacked police officers who escorted him out and tried to grab an officer's service weapon. He was arrested after a stun device was used, and one officer and the man were hurt.

title: Paar homophob beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: Two men aged 61 and 57 were insulted with homophobic remarks and knocked to the ground by an unknown man with a dog in a Charlottenburg park. Both were injured; the State Protection unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Wohnungsbrand – Frau tot aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out in a second-floor apartment of an apartment building in Weißensee. A woman was found dead after the fire was extinguished; other residents were evacuated and not injured.

title: Vermisste Seniorin nach Hubschraubereinsatz gefunden
summary: A 91-year-old woman missing since 5 May 2026 was found in a vehicle near the Rhin river in Brandenburg after a police helicopter search. She was taken to hospital for examination.

title: Mutmaßlicher Raser beschädigt Polizeifahrzeug und verletzt Polizeibeamten
summary: A 21-year-old driving a rented car at speed nearly hit a pedestrian, then left the car in gear, and it rolled into a parked police vehicle. An officer suffered grazed knees during the arrest of the suspect.

title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 8. und 9. Mai 2026
summary: Police issued a general order restricting certain symbols, uniforms and songs around the Soviet war memorials in Treptow-Köpenick, Mitte and Pankow for 8–9 May 2026. The order covers the commemoration of the end of World War II and is linked to the Russia-Ukraine war.

title: Junge Frau bedroht
summary: A 19-year-old man allegedly fired a blank-firing pistol into the ground several times during a dispute with a 22-year-old woman and then struck her in the face. Witnesses alerted police; the woman declined medical treatment.

title: Festnahmen nach Wohnungseinbruch
summary: Police arrested two suspected burglars, aged 27 and 28, in an apartment in a multi-family building after a resident reported noises from a neighboring flat. A third suspect fled.

title: Fußgängerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car turning right from Seesener Straße onto Hohenzollerndamm hit a 70-year-old woman crossing the road around 1 p.m. The pedestrian suffered a leg fracture and was taken to hospital.

title: Mann leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme nach Bedrohung
summary: A 30-year-old man who had escaped from a hospital was detained at a cemetery after holding two glass bottles and ignoring police commands; he was subdued with a conducted energy device. He resisted arrest and a police officer was injured in the arm.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Tram – Kind im Krankenhaus
summary: A ten-year-old boy was hit by a tram while crossing the tram tracks on Berliner Allee in Weißensee. He was seriously injured with head injuries and taken to hospital; the tram driver was also taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Festnahme nach Schüssen in Neukölln
summary: A 20-year-old suspect was arrested ten days after shots were fired at a 27-year-old and a 29-year-old in Anita-Berber-Park on 23 April 2026. He was also allegedly involved in another shooting in the park on 2 May 2026 and in a later theft of a police officer's phone.

title: Tatverdächtiger identifiziert
summary: A 21-year-old man was punched by a member of a four-person group in Friedrichshain, apparently for homophobic reasons. The suspect has since been identified after a tip, and the investigation continues.

title: Bedrohung im öffentlichen Nahverkehr – Tatverdächtiger ermittelt
summary: A suspect is reported to have pointed a weapon-like object at several passengers in a U2 subway train on 17 July 2025. A 42-year-old suspect has since been identified, and investigations continue.

title: Geschäftsmann überfallen, Mitarbeiter erleidet Stichverletzung
summary: Two men robbed a businessman of his day's takings in a backpack on Gerlinger Straße, threatening him with a firearm. An accomplice stabbed the businessman's employee in the thigh with a pointed object during the robbery.

title: Rotlicht missachtet – Schweren Verkehrsunfall verursacht
summary: A 36-year-old driver ran a red light at high speed at a major junction in Prenzlauer Berg while fleeing police after a hit-and-run, and collided with another car. The other driver, 50, suffered serious head injuries and a passenger was also taken to hospital.

title: Denkmal beschmiert
summary: Antisemitic graffiti with inflammatory content was found on a stele of the Holocaust memorial around 10:15 and removed by a security firm. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Streit eskaliert – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät eingesetzt
summary: A dispute in Görlitzer Park escalated, with one man hitting another on the head with a glass bottle and threatening officers with broken bottles. Police used a taser after the man began injuring himself and was then taken to hospital for psychiatric care.

title: Seniorin bei Raub verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 25-year-old man snatched the handbag of an 83-year-old woman in Friedenau, causing her to fall and injure her shoulder. He was arrested later the same day after a witness recognised him.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Schüsse auf Friseursalon
summary: Shots were fired at a hair salon in Lichtenrade, leaving several bullet holes in the shop front. No people were in the shop at the time, and the BAO Ferrum special unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf 44-Jährigen – Staatsanwaltschaft Berlin und 6. Mordkommission ermitteln
summary: A 44-year-old man was shot by an unknown gunman in Yorckstraße in Schöneberg in the early hours. He suffered life-threatening injuries, and the 6th Homicide Commission is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Fünfköpfige Personengruppe angegriffen
summary: Two unknown attackers sprayed a group of five men with pepper spray near Klausenerplatz around 1 a.m., then stabbed one 27-year-old man. The attackers fled by car; the injured man was taken to hospital, and the other two suffered eye irritation.

title: Körperliche Auseinandersetzung mit Verletzten
summary: Two men were injured in a physical fight in a residential building on Eichborndamm after a witness heard noises and saw blood in the stairwell. Police found blood-stained objects, including a knife blade, at the scene.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 59-year-old e-scooter rider was hit by a car at a junction in Mitte and later died of her injuries. The driver of the car was a 62-year-old man.

title: Alkoholisierter Mann nach wiederholten Straftaten im Unterbindungsgewahrsam
summary: A heavily intoxicated 41-year-old man repeatedly committed offences overnight, including a cyclist crash, insulting and spitting at a woman, and resisting arrest. He made antisemitic remarks and was taken into custody; the case is handled by the state security unit.

title: Auto überschlägt sich – Autofahrerin verletzt
summary: A car collided with another vehicle at an intersection where the traffic lights had failed, and overturned onto its roof. The driver was injured and taken to hospital, and a passenger in the other car had knee pain.

title: Nach Streit um Grillverbot – Mann verletzt
summary: After a dispute over a barbecue ban in a courtyard, a 36-year-old man was attacked with pepper spray and punched by two men, suffering serious facial injuries. The suspects fled before police arrived.

title: Unbekannte attackieren Mann und verletzen ihn
summary: Several unknown attackers punched and kicked a 37-year-old man in Prenzlauer Berg and took his jersey. The victim briefly lost consciousness and was taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse auf ein Café
summary: An unknown person fired shots at a café on the corner of Potsdamer Straße and Großgörschenstraße at about 4:50 am and fled. Police found damage to the building facade; nobody was injured.

title: Radfahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car turning left collided with an oncoming cyclist on Nalepastraße in Oberschöneweide on the evening before publication. The 63-year-old cyclist was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Homophober und fremdenfeindlicher Angriff in der U-Bahn
summary: A man on the U2 subway line harassed a young woman and then assaulted her male companion with homophobic and xenophobic insults, while her female friend was kicked. The suspect was arrested, and the Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Tram – Fußgängerin verletzt
summary: A 55-year-old pedestrian ran onto the tram tracks at the Buschallee stop in Weißensee and was hit by a tram on line M4. She was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries; the tram driver was treated for shock.

title: Jugendlicher und Mann nach erlittenen Schussverletzungen in Krankenhäusern
summary: Two men, aged 17 and 25, were shot in the legs on Hermannstraße in Neukölln, and the unknown shooter fled. Both were taken to hospital, and the 25-year-old needed emergency surgery but is not in danger of his life.

title: Polizeibeamter von Personengruppe angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A group of about ten people grilling illegally in Volkspark Friedrichshain attacked two police officers who had asked them to extinguish the grill, injuring one officer. Three suspects were arrested and the officer could not continue his duty.

title: Mit Pfefferspray in Moschee gesprüht - Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Two men entered a mosque in Gesundbrunnen and allegedly sprayed animal repellent spray in the hallway and prayer room while about 100 people were present. One suspect was detained by bystanders and police, and the 59-year-old was taken to hospital for chest pain not linked to the incident.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren Verletzten und Schaulustigen
summary: An 81-year-old driver turning at the junction collided with an oncoming car, pushing it into four parked vehicles; three people were injured. Three bystanders were later investigated for photographing the injured.

title: Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz zur Versammlungslage am 1. Mai 2026
summary: Police reviewed the May Day 2026 demonstrations across Berlin, with over 90 assemblies and more than 70,000 participants. During the evening Kreuzberg march, a police officer was lightly injured after being hit by bottles, and 15 officers were injured overall.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt
summary: A 28-year-old man was attacked by a group in the Charlottenburg nightlife area after a verbal dispute escalated, and was stabbed and cut in the neck, abdomen and back. He underwent emergency surgery; police say his life is no longer in danger.

title: Tödlicher Unfall im U-Bahnhof
summary: A 69-year-old man was dragged by a departing U-Bahn train at Gleisdreieck station after trying to hold the doors open with his walking aid. He was found dead beside the tracks around 5:30 a.m., and U1 and U3 services were suspended until 7 a.m.

title: Brennende Pkw
summary: Two cars were destroyed by fire in Marzahn early in the morning, and a third vehicle was damaged by the heat. Nobody was hurt, and an arson unit is investigating.

title: Schüsse auf Haus und Fahrschule
summary: A masked man fired several shots at a house on Magistratsweg around 1:40 a.m. and fled on foot. Police found several bullet holes; nobody was hurt.

title: Parkscheinautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a parking ticket machine in Tempelhof overnight; a witness discovered it around 0:30 and alerted police. A parked car was lightly damaged by flying metal parts.

title: Fahrradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 41-year-old cyclist was killed at about 8:40 a.m. after a truck turning right ran him over at Rudow. Police traffic investigators took over the case.

title: Vermisster Jugendlicher wieder im Kreis seiner Familie
summary: A missing 16-year-old boy was found safe at Grünau S-Bahn station after a citizen tip and was returned to his mother. He had been missing since 29 April 2026 after leaving a tram in Pankow.

title: Festnahmen und Durchsuchungen nach Drogenhandel
summary: Police arrested two suspected drug dealers in Hellersdorf after observing a cash-for-drugs handover in front of a residential building. Searches of the men and of an apartment seized cannabis, cocaine, prescription tablets, a blank-firing gun and knives.

title: Festnahme nach Fahrzeugdiebstahl, verbotenem Kraftfahrzeugrennen und mehreren Verkehrsdelikten
summary: After a car theft and a chase through Köpenick, police fired two shots at the vehicle and arrested the 35-year-old driver at the stadium car park. The driver was not hit, but one officer was injured during the arrest.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Zaunanlage des Görlitzer Parks
summary: Overnight, police found damage to the fence system of Görlitzer Park, including tampered locks on two gates. One gate could not be properly locked and was secured with a chain lock.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung mit Teppichmesser - Festnahme
summary: A 33-year-old man allegedly drew a box cutter during a dispute in a bar and injured two guests before being overpowered and arrested. Two guests suffered cuts, one requiring hospital treatment.

title: Zwölfjähriger Radfahrer bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A twelve-year-old cyclist was injured after colliding with a car at a crossing in Lankwitz. The 41-year-old driver was unhurt, and police are investigating which traffic lights were showing.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Fußgänger und Straßenbahn
summary: A 37-year-old pedestrian was hit by a tram line M1 after climbing over a pedestrian barrier under the U-Bahn viaduct on Schönhauser Allee. He was injured and taken to hospital, and the street was closed until about 14:10.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Fußgänger an
summary: An 81-year-old driver hit a 32-year-old pedestrian who allegedly crossed on red at the Buschallee and Sulzfelder Straße junction in Weißensee. The pedestrian suffered head and upper-body injuries, including fractures, and was hospitalized.

title: Tätergruppen schlugen und traten auf Mann ein
summary: Around 0:30 a 19-year-old man was attacked by several groups of men on Scheelestraße and then at a nearby playground, where pepper spray was used and he was beaten and kicked. The attackers fled when a witness intervened.

title: Sachbeschädigungen mit antisemitischem Hintergrund – Wer hat etwas gesehen?
summary: Unknown perpetrators sprayed antisemitic slogans and swastikas on building walls in Ueckermünder Straße over the past weekend and on the night of 11 April. The State Protection unit appeals for witnesses.

title: Schüsse auf Autoteilehandel
summary: Several bullet holes were found in the entrance door of an auto parts dealer in Neukölln on the morning of 27 April. Employees discovered the damage around 6 a.m. and alerted police, who secured several cartridge casings.

title: Nationalsozialistische Parole gerufen - Festnahmen
summary: Three men allegedly shouted a Nazi slogan and threw glass bottles at Wilmersdorfer Straße; two men aged 68 and 75 were arrested and later released. The state security unit is investigating the use of unconstitutional symbols.

title: Schüsse auf Fahrschule
summary: An unknown masked man fired several shots at the shop windows of a driving school in the early hours. He then fled, and police are investigating for property damage.

title: Vielzahl an Straftaten bei Flucht vor Polizei
summary: Plainclothes officers caught a 22-year-old loading construction material from a building site into a car in Britz; the group fled, crashing into parked cars, and the driver was arrested after a chase on foot. Investigators are pursuing charges including aggravated gang theft and attempted dangerous bodily injury.

title: Vormals Gesuchter gilt nicht mehr als vermisst
summary: A 45-year-old man previously reported missing is no longer considered missing; police found no indication of distress or a crime. The original missing-person search began on 25 July 2025.

title: Ermittlungen wegen des Verdachts des versuchten Mordes - Mordkommission sucht Zeugen
summary: An e-scooter was thrown from a bridge onto the urban motorway BAB 100, narrowly missing a passing motorist. Homicide investigators are probing a suspected attempted killing and seeking witnesses and dash-cam footage.

title: Handyortung überführt mutmaßlichen Räuber
summary: Two men allegedly robbed a 42-year-old man at knifepoint-style threat with a weapon and took his smartphone. One 26-year-old suspect was arrested after the phone was located, and a replica gas-type pistol was seized.

title: E-Roller-Unfall mit zwei verletzten Kindern
summary: Two 13-year-old boys were injured when the e-scooter they were riding crashed on Olympischer Platz while braking, reportedly at excessive speed. The scooter lacked an insurance plate, and a criminal complaint was filed.

title: Fahrzeug geraubt und Unfall verursacht
summary: After a taxi passenger fell from a moving taxi on the A113 motorway, he forced his way into a woman's car, snatched her handbag so she fell, and drove off. He crashed into bollards at the Johannisthaler Chaussee junction and was taken to hospital.

title: Unbekannte Person fährt mit Auto Fußgänger an und flüchtet
summary: An unknown driver hit an 83-year-old pedestrian with a car in Lehrter Straße around 1 a.m. and fled the scene. The injured man was taken to hospital by rescue services.

title: Zaunelement am Görlitzer Park beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons damaged a fence section around Görlitzer Park overnight, about 2.5 by 3.5 metres, discovered by a security guard at around 2:15 a.m. The report concerns criminal damage to property.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Auseinandersetzung mit Machete
summary: After a dispute in Gesundbrunnen involving pepper spray and a machete, three men were injured, one of them life-threateningly. A man was also stabbed after being approached by one of the disputants.

title: Radfahrer nach medizinischem Notfall verstorben
summary: A 76-year-old cyclist suffered a medical emergency and fell on the pavement in Rummelsburg. Bystanders gave first aid and CPR, but he died in hospital.

title: Kind von Autofahrer angefahren
summary: A 63-year-old driver hit a 13-year-old girl who ran into the Gardeschützenweg in Lichterfelde. She suffered head injuries and abrasions and was taken to hospital; her life is not in danger.

title: Reizgas in Jugendclub versprüht
summary: Several youths sprayed pepper spray inside a youth club in Marzahn, injuring 15 children and teenagers aged 8 to 15 before fleeing. Paramedics treated the injured at the scene, some with eye rinses.

title: Gegen Baum gefahren
summary: A 27-year-old man crashed his car into a tree on Tempelhofer Damm and was seriously injured. Police took a blood sample on suspicion of drug or drug-related impairment and seized the vehicle.

title: Polizist nach Steinwürfen verletzt
summary: Several stones were thrown at a police patrol car in Rigaer Straße while officers protected firefighters extinguishing a lamp post fire. One officer was injured and the patrol car's windscreen was damaged.

title: Mann mit Böller beworfen und verletzt
summary: An unknown masked person threw a firework at a 21-year-old supermarket security guard in Lichtenberg, causing him to suffer a blast-related eardrum trauma and leg injuries. The suspect also verbally threatened him before fleeing.

title: Junge Frau wieder da
summary: A 25-year-old woman who is cognitively impaired went missing on 21 April 2026 after leaving Gesundbrunnen S-Bahn station. She was found safe on 23 April and returned to her home.

title: Unbekannter schießt auf 27-Jährigen – BAO Ferrum und Ermittlungsgruppe Telum ermitteln
summary: A 27-year-old man was grazed in the leg by a bullet in Anita-Berber-Park after a group confronted him and a companion, one of them with a pistol. Police are investigating the shooting as an attempted homicide.

title: Geld geraubt und mehrere Personen mit Pfefferspray verletzt
summary: A 25-year-old allegedly robbed a 22-year-old of cash at Kottbusser Tor subway station, then pepper-sprayed him and several BVG employees. The suspect was arrested at the station and the case is under investigation by Kriminalpolizei.

title: Festnahmen nach Raubüberfällen auf Spätverkaufsstellen
summary: Police arrested two suspects (27 and 29) in a raid on an apartment in Wedding, linked to six armed robberies of late-night shops in Mitte between February and April 2026. Both were remanded in custody.

title: Allgemeinverfügung zum 1. Mai 2026 – Einschränkungen im Bereich Treptower Park
summary: Police issued a general order restricting assemblies in the Treptower Park area from 6 a.m. on 1 May 2026 to 6 a.m. on 2 May 2026 to protect the green space and listed garden monument. The order covers the area between the Spree, Bulgarische Straße, Am Treptower Park and the S-Bahn line.

title: Seniorin nach Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 76-year-old driver leaving a car park exit in Goltzstraße, Lichtenrade, hit an 88-year-old pedestrian. The pedestrian fell and was taken to hospital with a head wound and pain on the left side.

title: Drei verletzte Beamte – Polizeihubschrauber im Einsatz
summary: Up to 20 people gathered around a burning barrel on Rigaer Straße and sprayed fire extinguishers at officers who had asked them to extinguish it. Three officers reported breathing difficulties and continued their duty; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mutmaßlicher Wohnungseinbrecher festgenommen
summary: Police arrested a 22-year-old suspected of two apartment break-ins in Alt Hohenschönhausen after a caretaker reported markings on apartment doors. Stolen computer accessories linked to one burglary were found in his car.

title: Autofahrer fährt gegen geparkten Pkw
summary: An 87-year-old driver pulled out of a property driveway and hit a parked car, injuring its 69-year-old user who was unloading items from the open rear door. The injured woman suffered a rib fracture and was admitted to hospital.

title: Mutter und Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car driver allegedly ran a red light and hit a 28-year-old woman crossing on a pedestrian crossing with her three-year-old daughter in her arms. Both were injured and taken to hospital, where the child was admitted.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen Raubtaten vollstreckt
summary: Police searched properties of six suspects, aged 16 to 18, believed to have lured people into open-air meetings via fake profiles and robbed them. Weapons including a knuckleduster, a knife and an electric stun device were seized.

title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz
summary: Berlin police reported results of the ROADPOL "Speedweek" speed enforcement campaign from 13 to 19 April 2026, including a Blitzermarathon control day on 15 April. At 203 control sites, 6,732 speeding violations were recorded, 58 of them exceeding the limit by more than 31 km/h.

title: Frau bei Wohnungsbrand verletzt
summary: A fire broke out in a ground-floor apartment in a residential building on Buckower Damm in Britz overnight. A 71-year-old woman was found unconscious, resuscitated at the scene and taken to hospital with burns.

title: Nach Verkehrsunfall – Fahrradfahrer verstorben
summary: A 65-year-old cyclist who collided with another cyclist at a red light on Mühlenstraße later died in hospital from his injuries. The 14-year-old cyclist was unhurt.

title: Auseinandersetzung nach Fußballspiel
summary: After a football match, around 20 people allegedly attacked two players and a spectator of the visiting team with punches, kicks and shoves. One attacker allegedly tried to hit a player with a fire extinguisher in the changing room, but witnesses prevented it.

title: Fußballspiel nach mutmaßlich antisemitischer Volksverhetzung abgebrochen
summary: During a football match in Hakenfelde, a spectator allegedly made antisemitic remarks to a team captain, and the match was abandoned. The State Protection unit is investigating for suspected antisemitic incitement and insult.

title: Mit dem Auto überschlagen – Fahrer verletzt
summary: A 61-year-old man overturned his car on Wilhelmsruher Damm in the Märkisches Viertel area overnight and was seriously hurt. Two parked cars were also damaged, and the road was closed during the accident investigation.

title: Auseinandersetzung mit Reizgas, Messer und Machete
summary: Around 20 people were involved in a brawl in a car park in Wedding overnight; three men were hurt, one with stab wounds, and tear gas was used. Police seized several knives and a machete and arrested one 20-year-old.

title: In den Rücken gestochen und ausgeraubt
summary: A 39-year-old man was attacked overnight by several young men with pepper spray, a glass bottle and a knife, and robbed of several hundred euros. He suffered a stab wound to the back and a head laceration.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe gefunden
summary: Police arrested four suspects after drug handovers on Krossener Straße and a search of an apartment found a firearm, about 300 grams of cocaine, over 1,500 LSD strips and cash. One suspect resisted arrest and kicked officers.

title: Anwohner beraubt
summary: Two men posing as police officers searched two men near a garden allotment in Marzahn. One of them pointed a handgun at the 21-year-old and took his wallet containing cash before fleeing.

title: Info-Stand einer Partei attackiert
summary: A man took a political party's flag from an information stand in Köpenick and fled, then pushed two members/companions who tried to retrieve it, injuring one at the knee. The 32-year-old suspect, about 2 per mille, was arrested and later released; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach körperlicher Auseinandersetzung
summary: After a boxing match at a sports complex in Prenzlauer Berg, relatives of a losing fighter allegedly stormed the ring and a physical altercation with pepper spray followed. Nine people, including three children and a teenager, reported eye irritation and the perpetrators fled.

title: Verdacht der versuchten gefährlichen Körperverletzung vor einem Parteibüro
summary: A 19-year-old woman reported that a stone was allegedly thrown at her near a party office, narrowly missing her. No one was hurt, and the political police unit is investigating.

title: Streit eskaliert – rassistische Beleidigung und wechselseitige Körperverletzungen
summary: A dispute between women in Prenzlauer Berg escalated into a racist insult and mutual assaults, with one woman fleeing and hitting a man who had blocked her car. Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Seniorin nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A car struck an 81-year-old pedestrian who stepped onto the road with a shopping trolley near Wannsee bridge. She later died in hospital; the cause of death is still under investigation.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Kind auf Fahrrad an
summary: A car driver hit a four-year-old girl riding a bicycle at a junction in Lichtenberg. The girl fell onto the road, suffered leg abrasions and was taken to hospital.

title: Schussabgaben von Unbekannten
summary: Unknown persons fired shots in the night on Kapaunenstraße in Rudow, with cartridges and cases found on the street. Nobody was injured and no damage to residential buildings was found.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A car and an e-scooter collided on Buckower Damm in Britz on the evening of 17 April. A 14-year-old e-scooter rider died and a 14-year-old passenger was seriously injured; the 42-year-old driver was taken into police custody for blood tests after alcohol was detected.

title: Tödliche Auseinandersetzung – Mordkommission und Staatsanwaltschaft ermitteln
summary: A 25-year-old company manager was fatally stabbed during an argument at a firm's premises in Gesundbrunnen. Two men were arrested nearby, and the homicide unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mutmaßlicher Brandstifter festgenommen
summary: Police arrested a 36-year-old suspected arsonist in Britz after a series of six fires in the Hufeisensiedlung area and an adjacent allotment colony. No one was hurt.

title: Nach EC-Karten-Betrug - Festnahme
summary: Police were alerted around 0:30 that a credit card was being used without authorisation on Liegnitzer Straße. A 30-year-old suspect was arrested temporarily in a convenience store and cards were seized.

title: Mehrere Brandstiftungen in einer Schule
summary: Several arson fires were set in a school building on Olbersstraße, including a fire in the first floor and fires in two toilets. Earlier fires had been set on 14 April, and no one was injured.

title: Alkoholisiert mit E-Scooter Unfall gebaut – Vater und Tochter verletzt
summary: A 38-year-old man and his nine-year-old daughter fell from an e-scooter in Staaken on Tuesday evening, with no third party involved. The man was found to have about 1.1 per mille blood alcohol.

title: Nach Streit im Straßenverkehr – Radfahrer verletzt
summary: After a traffic dispute, a car driver allegedly drew a knife and injured a 35-year-old cyclist's chin. The cyclist was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Feuer vor Supermarkt gelegt
summary: Three unknown individuals set fire to wooden chairs and two e-scooters in front of a supermarket entrance in the night. One attacker pointed a knife at a 15-year-old-age witness group member after being confronted; nobody was injured.

title: Steinwürfe auf U-Bahn
summary: Two stones were thrown at a moving U-Bahn train between the Louis-Lewin-Straße and Hönow stations, destroying two windows. Nobody was hurt.

title: Geraubte Wertgegenstände zum Kauf angeboten - Festnahme
summary: Two men rang a resident's door on 9 April, threatened him with a knife and stole a laptop and phones. On 15 April one suspect returned offering to sell the items back and was arrested.

title: Schwerer Raub auf ein Pfandleihhaus – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Three men robbed a pawn shop on Karl-Marx-Straße on 7 April 2026 and fled in a silver Audi with out-of-town plates, which had been stolen earlier from a car park. Police are asking witnesses for information.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach Fahrerflucht
summary: A driver fled a traffic check at high speed through Berlin, ran red lights, and crashed at the Wintersteinstraße / Otto-Suhr-Allee junction, hitting a pedestrian on a traffic island. The pedestrian was injured and taken to hospital, and the driver was later arrested after leaving the scene.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren beschädigten Fahrzeugen – Fahrer verletzt
summary: A 57-year-old driver veered off the road in Zehlendorf and crashed into four parked cars, overturning his vehicle. He was injured, taken to hospital, and a blood test was taken because of suspected alcohol influence.

title: Flucht endete mit Unfall
summary: A 22-year-old driver without a valid licence fled a traffic check in Plänterwald and crashed into a tree after mounting the pavement and hitting a pedestrian's area. A pedestrian suffered only grazes and the 19-year-old passenger was hospitalised.

title: Mann überfallen und verschleppt
summary: Two masked men attacked a 52-year-old man on the street, forced him into a van and bound him, then stole cash, a phone and documents. He freed himself about two hours later and was taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Zwei Männer festgenommen und Falschgeld beschlagnahmt
summary: Police arrested two men in a car on a parking area on Alt-Friedrichsfelde while they were allegedly handing over counterfeit money. More than 20,000 euros in fake banknotes were seized, and one officer was slightly injured when the driver rammed a police vehicle.

title: In der Straßenbahn sexuell belästigt – Helfer verletzt
summary: In a tram in Hellersdorf, three suspects sexually harassed a woman. When a 36-year-old man and his companion intervened, they were physically attacked near the U-Bahnhof Hellersdorf stop.

title: Angriff auf Fan-Bus
summary: A masked group of 20 to 30 people attacked a bus carrying ice hockey fans, stole fan goods and entered the bus. One passenger was injured by a thrown bottle.

title: Fahrradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A car driver lost control on Hochstraße in Gesundbrunnen and hit a 54-year-old cyclist on the bike lane, dragging him about 30 metres. The cyclist was seriously injured and hospitalised; police are seeking witnesses and video footage.

title: Brandstiftung in Friseursalon
summary: Unknown persons smashed the window of a hairdressing salon in Lichtenrade and set a couch on fire with an unknown liquid. Firefighters extinguished the blaze and prevented it spreading to a neighbouring hotel; nobody was hurt.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Zusammenstoß verletzt
summary: During a cycling race on the Tempelhofer Feld, a 13-year-old e-scooter rider allegedly entered the racecourse and collided with a 31-year-old cyclist, and both fell. The cyclist suffered abrasions and was treated on scene, while the teenager was hospitalized.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An e-scooter rider crashed head-on into a car on Puschkinallee early in the morning and was taken to hospital with injuries. A breath test showed about 1.6 per mille alcohol, and a blood sample was taken.

title: Polizist mit Pfefferspray angegriffen
summary: After police were called to S-Bahn Tegel over people surfing on a train, a 15-year-old sprayed an officer with pepper spray as he pursued them. The officer was injured and treated in hospital, and the teenager was handed over to his parents.

title: Schüsse im Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: Shot sounds were heard from an apartment in a residential building on Wollankstraße early in the morning, prompting a police response. Officers found a starter pistol and blank cartridges during a voluntary search; no one was hurt.

title: Nach Widerstand – DEIG eingesetzt
summary: Police were called to a domestic violence report in Alt-Treptow. A 45-year-old man resisted officers, who used a taser after other measures failed, and five officers were hurt.

title: Mann mit Glasflasche angegriffen
summary: Around 5 a.m. a 30-year-old man was injured with a glass bottle during a dispute at a refugee shelter on Columbiadamm. A 31-year-old man is suspected of striking him; the injured man was taken to hospital.

title: Mann ausgeraubt und Polizei angegriffen
summary: A 34-year-old man allegedly robbed a 76-year-old man at a bus stop in Altglienicke and put him in a chokehold. Police intervened, and the suspect and one officer were injured during the arrest.

title: Diebstahl und Beschädigung einer Staatsflagge
summary: A man was approached at the Weltzeituhr on Alexanderplatz, and an Israeli flag he was carrying was taken, thrown to the ground and trampled. Police handle the case through the political crime unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Schusswaffe abgefeuert
summary: An unknown man fired a gun at Mainzer Straße in Neukölln around 8 p.m. after stepping out of a car. No injuries were reported and the street was closed during the crime scene search.

title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf
summary: Police issued a temporary general order banning carrying weapons and knives on 19 April 2026 from 7:00 to 16:30 around the Olympiastadion for the S25 running event. The restriction covers a defined area in Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen illegaler Autovermietungen – Vermögenswerte sichergestellt
summary: Police and tax investigators searched 16 properties in Berlin and Brandenburg over alleged insurance premium fraud linked to illegal car rentals. Six suspects are under investigation, with an estimated damage of at least 111,400 euros, and luxury jewelry and four high-end vehicles were seized.

title: Schüsse im Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A witness reported several gunshots from an apartment in a multi-family building in Friedenau. Police found several firearms, replica weapons and drugs in the suspect's apartment; he was later released after identity checks.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 82-year-old pedestrian stepped onto Hohenzollerndamm in Schmargendorf and was struck by a car around 12:40. The pedestrian suffered fractures and a head wound and was taken to hospital; the driver was unhurt.

title: Zwei Verletzte nach körperlicher Auseinandersetzung
summary: After a dispute at a venue in Britz escalated, two men aged 20 were found injured in the street, one with stab wounds to the thigh and one with head injuries from blunt force. Both were taken to hospital, and the suspects are still at large.

title: Verkehrsunfallflucht – Radfahrerin verletzt im Krankenhaus
summary: A hit-and-run driver pulled out of a parking area and struck a 65-year-old cyclist on Kladower Damm, causing her to fall and be hurt. The driver fled toward Gatow and the cyclist was taken to hospital.

title: Kind im Bus angegriffen und beleidigt – Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erfolgreich
summary: A man insulted and punched a 13-year-old boy during a verbal dispute on a M 21 bus. Police publicly appealed for information, and the suspect has since been identified.

title: Bundeskanzleramt beschmiert
summary: A 76-year-old man sprayed red paint over about six square meters of the Federal Chancellery facade and held a political banner, while a 40-year-old companion filmed it. State security police took over the investigation for criminal damage.

title: Mann mit Stichverletzungen aufgefunden
summary: A 31-year-old man was found on a pavement at the corner of Elsenstraße and Harzer Straße with several stab wounds. He was taken to hospital and is not in life-threatening danger.

title: Verdacht der Körperverletzung und Bedrohung - Polizeilicher Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: A 61-year-old man allegedly threatened a politician running an information stand and threatened violence; he was arrested and released after identity checks. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann nach Auseinandersetzung im Krankenhaus – Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 30-year-old man was seriously injured with a knife outside a bar in Moabit after trying to mediate a dispute. The 25-year-old suspect was arrested and the 1st Homicide Commission has taken over the investigation.

title: Mit Reizgas und Machete angegriffen
summary: Several unknown attackers assaulted three men in Neukölln, using pepper spray and a machete. The two men with cut injuries were taken to hospital, and the suspects fled.

title: Versuchter Geldautomateneinbruch
summary: Unknown suspects broke into a food store in Britz at about 1:40 a.m. to attack an ATM inside. They fled without loot after an alarm was triggered.

title: Mann nach Auseinandersetzung im Krankenhaus
summary: After a 30-year-old was repeatedly removed from a bar for aggressive behaviour, a physical fight broke out outside the bar in the early hours. A 49-year-old was treated in hospital for cut and stab wounds to his thigh, and the suspect was arrested after discarding a knife.

title: Beschädigung eines Oberlichtes
summary: A hole was found in the transom window of a shop display on Namslaustraße, with a projectile resembling shotgun ammunition found inside. An unknown man reportedly took the projectile and left a stone before fleeing.

title: Einschussloch im Fenster eines Imbisses
summary: A bullet hole was found in the serving window of a snack bar at Nollendorfplatz; two cartridge casings were found nearby. Nobody was injured.

title: Griff zur Dienstwaffe durch DEIG-Einsatz verhindert
summary: After a dispute and threat at a snack bar in Grünau, police arrested a 20-year-old man who attacked officers and tried to grab an officer's service weapon, which was prevented. Two officers were injured and unable to continue duty, and the man suffered a cut to the head.

title: Nach DEIG-Einsatz festgenommen
summary: A 27-year-old man allegedly stole two bottles of brandy from a petrol station shortly before midnight and resisted arrest, requiring the use of the DEIG (police special unit) to subdue him. He was taken into custody while intoxicated.

title: Rollerfahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 50-year-old woman riding a scooter crashed on Frankfurter Allee in Lichtenberg after leaving the road and hitting a median kerb, then collided with an oncoming car. She died at the scene despite resuscitation attempts.

title: Politiker an Informationsstand angegriffen
summary: A man attacked a 39-year-old member of the Berlin House of Representatives at a party information stand, striking him in the face after tipping a drink over the stand. The case was taken over by the State Protection unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Wohnung ausgebrannt – 17 Menschen verletzt
summary: A ground-floor apartment in a residential building in Neukölln burned out early in the morning, and residents were rescued by fire crews using an aerial ladder and forced doors. Seventeen people were treated for smoke inhalation, one of whom was taken to hospital; arson investigators are investigating.

title: Unbekannte attackieren zwei Männer
summary: Two 32-year-old men were attacked by unknown assailants after leaving a bar in the early hours, with racist insults and kicks to the head. Both suffered headaches and one a cut, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Brand auf Diakoniegelände
summary: Several wheelie bins caught fire overnight at a waste area on a Diakonie site in Hakenfelde, destroying five bins and damaging a nearby building's canopy. The state criminal police fire unit is taking over the investigation.

title: Krankenhaus-Patientin nach Brand verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in a hospital bed at a clinic in Zehlendorf around 23:15. The 64-year-old patient was later taken to intensive care with life-threatening burns and died; the cause is under investigation.

title: Mehrere Schusswaffen nach Bedrohung aufgefunden
summary: A 20-year-old man threatened to shoot through a locked apartment door in Charlottenburg and assaulted two people after it was opened. Police later found several firearms, a starter pistol and over 650 rounds of ammunition in his Friedenau apartment.

title: Raubüberfall– Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Two men robbed a 22-year-old on his way home, hitting him on the head with a beer bottle and taking his belongings. Two suspects, aged 17 and 20, were arrested nearby and a machete and a starter pistol were seized.

title: Schwerer Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 75-year-old woman drove her car off the Potsdamer Chaussee near a petrol station and hit two parked vehicles, and the car overturned onto its roof. She suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Einbruch mit Auto
summary: An unknown man drove a car into the entrance door of a shop on Münzstraße at about 5 a.m., destroying it. He took goods and fled with the car.

title: Auf Lokal geschossen
summary: Two masked men fired several shots at the front window of a bar in Neukölln early in the morning while up to six people were inside. No injuries have been reported so far.

title: Geschäftseinbruch mit Auto
summary: A shop's entrance door was forced open with a vehicle around 3:15 a.m. and a fireplace was stolen from the entrance area. Police found the damage during a patrol and investigations are ongoing.

title: Mann festgenommen - Schusswaffe und Bargeld beschlagnahmt
summary: Plainclothes officers arrested a 28-year-old man driving around Charlottenburg with a firearm and a large amount of cash after noticing his car on Kurfürstendamm. The car, the man's home-area addresses and further property were searched and seized.

title: Schüsse vor Lokal – zwei Verletzte
summary: Shots were fired after an argument spilled out of a bar in Moabit, leaving two men with gunshot wounds. Both were taken to hospital and temporarily arrested.

title: Mehrere Schüsse auf Lokal
summary: Several bullet holes were found in a restaurant or bar on Buschkrugallee in Neukölln when an employee opened it around 15:10. Police secured several cartridge casings; no one was reported injured.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Bandendiebstahl
summary: Two men were arrested in Steglitz after being seen removing wheels from a parked Mercedes. Police are continuing their investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletztem Autofahrer
summary: A garbage truck crashed head-on into a car stopped on the Schnellerstraße in Niederschöneweide early in the morning. The car driver suffered an ankle fracture and was hospitalized; the truck driver was unhurt.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletztem Fußgänger
summary: A van collided with a car at a crossing in Reinickendorf and then hit a pedestrian, who was pinned against a parked vehicle and seriously injured. Three people were injured in total, two treated as outpatients.

title: Brand in Mehrfamilienhaus – Haus vorsorglich evakuiert
summary: A fire broke out in a top-floor flat of an apartment building on Potsdamer Straße in the evening, after a loud bang and falling facade parts were reported. The fire was extinguished, the wings were evacuated, and nobody was injured.

title: Sprayer auf frischer Tat festgenommen
summary: Four men aged 22 to 30 were arrested after spraying walls in an underpass in Schöneberg during the night. Spray cans and mobile phones were seized, and the State Criminal Police Office took over the investigation.

title: Ausschreitungen bei einem Fußballspiel
summary: Fans of BFC Dynamo set off pyrotechnics outside the stadium and attacked police with bottles, firecrackers and punches during a football match, injuring a child, a steward and twelve officers. Two cases of Nazi salute display and one of insulting police were also recorded, plus a separate group chanting unconstitutional slogans in a pub on Weitlingstraße.

title: Polizeibeamte bei Festnahme verletzt
summary: A 37-year-old man struck a police officer in the face and resisted arrest after being questioned about a theft from a clothing container. Two officers were injured, one seriously enough to end his shift.

title: Kiosk überfallen
summary: Three men robbed a kiosk in Mehrower Allee, attacking the 44-year-old employee with blunt objects and a pointed object before stealing tobacco products. The employee was injured and treated on site by paramedics.

title: Bedrohung mit Schusswaffe
summary: A 42-year-old delivery driver was threatened with a handgun by a resident of an apartment building in Hellersdorf. A special forces unit later arrested the 49-year-old man in his flat and seized the firearm.

title: Schussabgaben auf Lokal
summary: Several shots were fired from a car at the front windows of a bar on Hermannstraße in the early morning while people were inside. Nobody was injured, and the car drove off toward Hermannplatz.

title: Bewaffneter Mann in Kreuzberg festgenommen
summary: Plainclothes officers arrested a 24-year-old man who allegedly drew and loaded a firearm during an confrontation between two cars in Kreuzberg. The loaded gun was found under a vehicle, and knives, pepper spray and suspected narcotics were also seized.

title: Fahrer nach illegalem Kraftfahrzeugrennen geflüchtet
summary: A driver fled from a police traffic check in Westend, colliding with a police car during an illegal street race and driving on a sidewalk. Both officers in the police car were injured and ended their shifts.

title: Senior bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car struck a pedestrian aged 76 on Oranienstraße around noon. The pedestrian was taken to hospital with injuries to the arm, leg and head, and the driver was unhurt.

title: Mutmaßliche Wohnungseinbrecher festgenommen
summary: Two men were caught trying to force open an apartment door in a multi-family building in Lichtenberg; they fled and were arrested nearby with burglary tools. They were released on site after identity checks.

title: Seniorin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 66-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car on Schönefelder Chaussee in Altglienicke and was taken to hospital for emergency surgery. The 39-year-old driver was unhurt, and the road was closed until the evening for the accident investigation.

title: Mitarbeiter bei Raubüberfall verletzt
summary: A man threatened two kebab shop employees with a fork and took cash from the till around 3:10 a.m. He then stabbed one employee with a kebab knife, injuring him, before fleeing.

title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte
summary: Police issued temporary general orders banning assemblies and carrying of weapons and knives in several areas of Mitte around a state visit on 29-30 March 2026. The restricted zones cover the Ritz Carlton, Schloss Bellevue and the Federal Chancellery.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt – Schusswaffe, Geld und Drogen beschlagnahmt
summary: Police and prosecutors executed ten search warrants across Berlin against five suspects accused of cocaine trafficking. Officers seized a loaded pistol, about 50 kg of cannabis, 500 g of cocaine and around 100,000 euros in cash.

title: Toter Mann in Laube – kein Verdacht einer Straftat
summary: A 36-year-old man was found dead in a garden allotment hut in Oderstraße, initially investigated by a homicide unit. The autopsy found injuries consistent with a fall and no indication of third-party involvement.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Polizei stoppt Lkw-Fahrer
summary: A truck driver allegedly sideswiped and overtook a 17-year-old e-scooter rider in Weißensee, who fell and was seriously injured. The truck was stopped by police shortly afterwards in Berliner Allee.

title: Nach medizinischem Notfall reanimiert
summary: A 49-year-old man collapsed from a medical emergency in Biesdorf and was resuscitated by police officers until paramedics arrived. He regained consciousness and was taken to hospital.

title: Zwei Männer bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt
summary: Two men aged 39 and 46 were injured in a clash with a group of unknown people in Volkspark Humboldthain, Gesundbrunnen, in the evening. The suspects were stabbed with a knife and attacked with pepper spray, then fled toward Gesundbrunnen U-Bahn station.

title: Verdacht der Brandstiftung – drei Fahrzeuge beschädigt
summary: A vehicle caught fire in an underground car park on Iburger Ufer early in the morning and the flames spread to two more cars and part of the building. Nobody was hurt; police are investigating suspected arson.

title: Mann und Frau nach Machetenangriff verletzt
summary: Two unknown men allegedly attacked a 19-year-old man and a 19-year-old woman with a machete in Friedrichshain after a bar visit, injuring both. The suspects reportedly shouted unconstitutional slogans while fleeing, and the Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Tramunfall - Kind verletzt
summary: An eleven-year-old boy stumbled at a tram stop and was hit by a tram in Neu-Hohenschönhausen. The child was taken to hospital with foot injuries; the tram driver and a companion were treated as outpatients.

title: Reifen in Brand gesetzt - zwei Autos beschädigt
summary: Unknown perpetrators set several tyres on fire on Rigaer Straße overnight, damaging two nearby parked cars. Pyrotechnics were thrown at responding firefighters, who were not injured; the case is handled by the state security unit.

title: Geldautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators forced their way into a shopping centre in Biesdorf early in the morning and blew up an ATM using explosives. The offenders fled without being caught.

title: Antisemitisch beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: A 37-year-old woman was arrested after allegedly insulting a 39-year-old man antisemitically and striking him on the head in Oderberger Straße. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Durchsuchungen nach Brandanschlag im September 2025 auf Berliner Stromnetz
summary: Police searched about 500 officers' worth of premises in Berlin, Hamburg, North Rhine-Westphalia and Brandenburg in connection with a September 2025 arson attack on two power pylons that caused a large blackout in Berlin. Four suspects aged 28 to 36 are investigated for suspected anti-constitutional sabotage.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Einsatzfahrzeug
summary: A police vehicle chasing a motorcyclist crashed into a wall in Kleinziethen (Brandenburg) shortly before midnight. Both officers were injured and taken to hospital, and the motorcyclist escaped.

title: Blitzeinbruch mit Auto in Einkaufszentrum
summary: Three unknown suspects drove a car through the locked entrance of a retail store in a shopping centre in Steglitz around 3:30 a.m., smashed display cases and stole jewellery and watches. They fled in a second vehicle parked nearby.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 11-year-old cyclist was struck by a car on Alt-Moabit while crossing the road. The child suffered head injuries and was treated as an outpatient at a hospital.

title: Mann in Wohnung gelockt, gefesselt und geschlagen
summary: A 26-year-old man was lured into an apartment on Pankstraße, beaten, attacked with an iron bar and pepper spray, and bound with tape. Two suspects, aged 18 and 29, were arrested; a police officer was injured.

title: Auto überrollt Frau
summary: An unsecured car rolled over a woman, aged 61, who was lying on the ground after a collision with another car. She suffered fractures and was taken to hospital.

title: Schläfer krankenhausreif getreten
summary: A 28-year-old man allegedly kicked two sleeping homeless men in the head and upper body overnight. One victim, 65, suffered severe facial injuries and needs inpatient treatment; the suspect was arrested and taken into custody.

title: Brandstifter festgenommen
summary: A 38-year-old man entered an apartment building on Pillnitzer Weg in Staaken and left shortly after; residents found burning waste in the ground-floor hallway and put it out. The man was arrested nearby on suspicion of serious arson.

title: Hochwertige Armbanduhr brutal geraubt
summary: Two unknown men attacked a 69-year-old man in the ground floor of an apartment building, tore off his wristwatch and tried to steal his wallet. The victim was treated on scene for injuries to his hand and torso.

title: Von mehreren Männern angegriffen und niedergestochen worden
summary: A 28-year-old man was attacked by several men at Grünau S-Bahn station and stabbed in the back with a knife. He suffered a stab wound, is in hospital, and is not in danger of his life.

title: Mann mit Schussverletzungen – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 23-year-old man with gunshot wounds and a 22-year-old man with facial injuries were found on Brandenburgische Straße in Wilmersdorf. The homicide unit is investigating and seeking witnesses.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A 60-year-old driver turning left at a junction collided with a 61-year-old pedestrian who crossed against a red pedestrian light. The pedestrian was seriously injured, underwent emergency surgery and remains in intensive care.

title: Mann leistet Widerstand – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät (DEIG) eingesetzt
summary: A 34-year-old man resisted police officers who were checking his identity and was arrested after a struggle. A taser was used, and two officers were injured.

title: Abi-Mottowochen lösen Polizeieinsätze aus
summary: Up to 1,000 young people gathered at parks in Pankow and Schöneberg for graduation-week events, leading to police clearance operations. Bottles and fireworks were thrown or lit at officers, police vehicles were damaged, and five people were arrested.

title: Mann nach Überfall mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 38-year-old man was attacked by several unknown people in a park in Charlottenburg around 1:30 a.m., using pepper spray and a pointed object. He suffered stab wounds to the legs and was taken to hospital; no property was taken.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen des Verdachts des Handeltreibens mit Betäubungsmitteln vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors searched six residential and other addresses in Berlin and Brandenburg in an investigation into cocaine delivery by rented cars. One suspect was arrested, and weapons, forged documents and silver bars were seized.

title: Farbschmiererei – Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: Plainclothes officers arrested a 21-year-old man who was spraying an antisemitic slogan on a clothing shop's facade on Residenzstraße. The slogan was made illegible and the case was handed to the Staatsschutz.

title: Mann angegriffen und verletzt
summary: Two unknown men attacked a 21-year-old on a riverside path in Rudow after demanding his belongings, stabbing him in the leg several times. He was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Mit Drogen im Auto geflüchtet - Unfall
summary: A 24-year-old driver fled police at high speed through several red lights and crashed into a wall and traffic light at Invalidenstraße/Gartenstraße. Nearly 100 suspected drug units and cash were found in the car and on the passenger, a 22-year-old who was slightly injured.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler festgenommen – umfangreiche Beweismittel beschlagnahmt
summary: Plainclothes officers stopped a car in Charlottenburg and arrested its 22-year-old driver, a suspected drug dealer. Several hundred prescription pills and narcotics, plus cash and US dollars, were seized in the car and the suspect's apartment.

title: Auf dem Dach gelandet
summary: An 81-year-old woman drove her car off the road at night and hit two parked vehicles, overturning onto its roof. She was rescued and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Nationalfahnen angezündet und Flugblätter verteilt
summary: An unknown woman publicly burned two national flags, one of Germany and one of Iran, at Platz des 18. März and distributed leaflets, some containing Nazi symbols. The State Protection unit is investigating.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Radfahrerin und Radfahrer verletzt
summary: Two cyclists collided on the bike lane of Schöneberger Straße while one attempted to overtake on the right as the other turned into a driveway. The female cyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital, and the male cyclist sustained minor injuries.

title: Verkehrsunfall bei Einsatzfahrt
summary: Two police officers responding to an emergency call collided with a turning car at Hermsdorf while driving with sirens and lights. Two officers and the 83-year-old driver were hurt, and the road was closed during the investigation.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe geschossen
summary: After a dispute involving several people at a sports ground, a man aged 18 allegedly fired a blank-firing pistol several times at two people fleeing. He was arrested at the scene of the dispute and later released; the investigation continues.

title: Vermisste wieder da
summary: A 77-year-old woman with dementia who had been missing since 12 March 2026 has been found alive and is receiving medical care in hospital. She was found after a public appeal led hospital staff to recognise her.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Beteiligung eines Einsatzwagens der Polizei
summary: A police patrol car responding with lights and siren collided with a VW turning left in Lankwitz while using the oncoming lane. The police passenger was injured in the arm and two parked cars were damaged.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei endet in Festnahme
summary: A 29-year-old woman fled from a police traffic check at high speed, damaging her car and crashing into an oncoming van. She was arrested on foot; the car was uncleared and reported with stolen plates, and she admitted driving under the influence of drugs.

title: Mann nach Sturz mit Fahrrad im Krankenhaus
summary: A 61-year-old man fell from his bicycle in Lankwitz in the evening and suffered serious head and torso injuries. He remains in intensive care, and a traffic unit is investigating the cause of the fall.

title: Fahrgäste mit einem Messer bedroht und erheblichen Widerstand geleistet
summary: A 50-year-old man with a knife threatened passengers on a tram at a stop on Am Tierpark and damaged seats and windows. He was overpowered after resisting arrest, taken to hospital, and found to be under the influence of drugs.

title: Autofahrerin fährt gegen BVG-Wartehäuschen
summary: A 22-year-old woman drove her car off the road and crashed into a BVG bus shelter in Rahnsdorf. She was taken to hospital with injuries; no one else was hurt.

title: Festnahmen nach räuberischem Diebstahl
summary: Two men were arrested after a suspected snatch theft on a subway platform, during which a 41-year-old woman and her 38-year-old companion were assaulted. An axe was used in the ensuing fight, and the 38-year-old was injured.

title: Vermisster Mann tot geborgen
summary: A 31-year-old man missing since February 2026 was found dead in the Landwehrkanal, east of the Lohmühlenbrücke. No signs of a criminal offence have been found so far and an autopsy has been suggested.

title: Motorradfahrer fährt Seniorin an
summary: A motorcyclist hit an 85-year-old woman crossing Akazienstraße in Schöneberg; both fell. The woman suffered life-threatening injuries and remains in critical condition, while the motorcyclist was slightly hurt.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler mit scharfer Schusswaffe unterwegs – Haftbefehl erlassen
summary: Police observed a suspected drug dealer selling narcotics at S-Bahn station Tempelhof, then arrested him at Hermannstraße station after a chase. He carried a firearm, ammunition, drugs and a knife, and an arrest warrant was issued.

title: Festnahme und Haftbefehl nach zwei Wohnungseinbrüchen
summary: A suspected burglar was arrested in Reinickendorf after a resident reported suspicious noises and a man fleeing with a backpack from an apartment building. Stolen goods from two break-ins were recovered, and a judge issued an arrest warrant.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeibeteiligung
summary: A police vehicle with blue lights and siren collided with a motorcycle at a junction in Kreuzberg. The 23-year-old motorcyclist was treated at the scene and later went to a doctor himself.

title: Personengruppe greift Mann an
summary: A 23-year-old man was attacked by a group of about ten people over unpaid money in Neukölln shortly after midnight. He suffered head injuries and two suspects, aged 24 and 27, were temporarily arrested.

title: Mann mit Glasflasche verletzt
summary: A 37-year-old man was stabbed in the neck with a broken glass bottle during an argument with a 50-year-old man on a green area at Osloer Straße U-Bahn station. The suspect fled but was arrested in a nearby apartment; the victim is not in danger of dying.

title: Mutmaßlich mit Messer in Schulter gestochen
summary: A 32-year-old man was stabbed in the shoulder by an unknown attacker on a pavement in Buch. The attacker fled and the victim was taken to hospital with serious injuries.

title: Verkehrsunfall und Festnahme nach Flucht vor Verkehrskontrolle – zwei Polizisten verletzt
summary: After fleeing a traffic check at high speed, a 15-year-old driver crashed into a police car at the Uhlandstraße/Steinplatz junction and was arrested. He was suspected of being under the influence of drugs and had no valid driving licence.

title: Kind erleidet Stichverletzung
summary: A 13-year-old was stabbed in the buttock with a knife during a confrontation between children and a group of about 20 youths in a park. The injured boy was taken to hospital; police say his life was not in danger.

title: Toter Mann nach Wohnungsbrand geborgen
summary: A flat fire in a residential building in Tegel left one man dead, likely the 63-year-old occupant, and damaged several other flats. Six residents were taken to hospital with suspected smoke inhalation.

title: Zwei Männer nach Auseinandersetzung verletzt
summary: A group of 15 to 20 people attacked two men in front of a supermarket on Sonnenallee, reportedly using baseball bats and knives. Both men were injured, one with a stab wound, and the 23-year-old remains in hospital.

title: Bekämpfung der Arzneimittelkriminalität
summary: Police searched eight properties, including two pharmacies, over suspected illegal trade in prescription-only medicines. About 300 packs of medication and 249,910 euros in cash were seized.

title: Mit Messer verletzt
summary: A group attack in Hellersdorf left two men injured after a dispute was to be settled; one was stabbed in the arm. The attackers reportedly carried knives, batons and pepper spray and fled.

title: Aktionswoche zum Schutz von zu Fuß gehenden Seniorinnen und Senioren
summary: Police Berlin announced a road safety awareness week from 16 to 20 March 2026 to protect elderly pedestrians, with information stands at weekly markets across the city. The events are held in cooperation with the pedestrian association FUSS e.V.

title: Beleidigung mit politischem Hintergrund
summary: A 44-year-old woman allegedly insulted two security staff working for BVG at the entrance to Schlesisches Tor subway station with xenophobic and antisemitic remarks. The State Security unit of the LKA has taken over the investigation.

title: Körperverletzung nach Streit in Gaststätte – Wirt verletzt
summary: After a dispute over refused alcohol service, a 63-year-old guest allegedly punched a 54-year-old pub owner in the face, and the owner later returned to the bar with a serious head injury. The owner was taken to hospital; police are investigating for assault.

title: Radfahrer und Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A cyclist crossing Sonnenallee collided with a motorcyclist who had right of way, and both fell to the ground. The cyclist was taken to hospital and admitted, and the motorcyclist suffered minor injuries.

title: Jugendliche flüchten vor der Polizei und verursachen Verkehrsunfall
summary: Four teenagers fled from police in a car without a number plate, driving through several red lights and onto the wrong side of the road before crashing into bushes at Bocksfeldplatz. Three were arrested and one slightly injured.

title: Verletzte bei Wohnungsbrand
summary: A fire broke out in a flat in a residential building in Falkenhagener Feld overnight. One resident was seriously hurt, two others were treated for smoke inhalation, and 19 flats are uninhabitable.

title: Zeugenaufruf zu einem Tötungsdelikt
summary: A 45-year-old man was found dead in the Havel at the Freybrücke in Spandau; police believe he was the victim of a homicide and have launched a witness appeal. The 6th Homicide Commission is investigating.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Tramfahrer und Autofahrer
summary: A car driver turning left collided with a tram on the M10 line in Prenzlauer Berg after failing to yield, despite emergency braking by the tram driver. The car driver, 45, was injured in the chest area and taken to hospital.

title: Körperverletzung nach Streit im Straßenverkehr
summary: After a traffic dispute, a cyclist allegedly kicked a car's mirror and then beat a 44-year-old driver, who fell to the ground and was injured. Passers-by intervened, and the cyclist fled.

title: Versuchte Sprengung eines Geldautomaten
summary: Unknown perpetrators attempted to blow open a cash machine with explosives around 4 a.m. and damaged the machine. The State Criminal Police Office's specialist unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Balkonbrand in Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A balcony caught fire in an apartment building in Kreuzberg on the afternoon of 8 March. Firefighters extinguished the blaze shortly after, and nobody was hurt.

title: Hauswand mit politischem Inhalt beschmiert
summary: A house wall in Thulestraße was smeared with paint, including a politically themed slogan and symbols. A resident alerted police around 9 a.m.; the case is being investigated by a state criminal police specialist unit.

title: Vor der Polizei geflüchtet, verunfallt und festgenommen
summary: A 25-year-old driver fled from police at high speed in Staaken and lost control at a junction, colliding with five parked cars. He was arrested shortly afterwards and had no driving licence.

title: Radfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 76-year-old cyclist was injured in a collision with another cyclist at the Dieffenbachstraße/Graefestraße crossing in Kreuzberg. The other cyclist, 27, was unhurt, and the cyclist was taken to hospital for treatment.

title: Bedrohung mit einer Schreckschusswaffe – SEK-Einsatz
summary: A 21-year-old man threatened a 25-year-old doorman at a nightclub entrance with a blank-firing pistol and fled. He was later arrested by a SWAT team after barricading himself in his apartment, and the pistol was seized.

title: Frau bei Messerangriff verletzt
summary: A 27-year-old woman was stabbed in the lower body in an apartment in Alt-Marzahn around 1 a.m. A 21-year-old man was arrested at the scene on suspicion of domestic violence.

title: Mann bei Streit mit Messer verletzt
summary: During an argument in Neukölln, an unknown suspect allegedly stabbed a 29-year-old man several times in the leg with a knife. The victim was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Mehrere Festnahmen nach mutmaßlichem Drogenhandel
summary: Police arrested five men in Kreuzberg and searched two flats in Neukölln linked to suspected commercial drug dealing. Cocaine, ketamine, LSD, a machete and cash were seized.

title: Obdachlosen in Wohnung gelockt und ausgeraubt
summary: A homeless man was lured into a residential building in Marzahn and robbed of his bank card by a 19-year-old, who showed a firearm and demanded his PIN. The victim reported the robbery to police.

title: Mann nach Streitigkeiten niedergestochen
summary: After an argument at Alexanderplatz S-Bahn station in the early hours, an unknown man stabbed a 25-year-old in the abdomen with a pointed object and fled. The victim needed emergency surgery but was never in life-threatening danger.

title: Polizistin angegriffen
summary: An off-duty police officer was pushed and sprayed with white paint in the face by a man after she identified herself to a group where one member made a Hitler salute. The officer suffered eye irritation; the state security unit is investigating.

title: Brandstiftung an einem Veranstaltungsgebäude
summary: Arson fire at the technical installation of an event building on Revaler Straße was extinguished early in the morning. Nazi symbols were sprayed on the building wall and ventilation system; the political police unit is investigating.

title: Mann mit Fahrrad von Tram angefahren
summary: A 79-year-old man crossing the tram tracks on Osloer Straße was hit by a tram on the M13 line. He suffered multiple fractures and internal injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Fanartikel geraubt
summary: Four teenagers were surrounded by up to 30 people on Greifenhagener Straße and robbed of backpacks, with threats of violence. Police later checked a group of eleven men nearby, and the investigation into whether they are connected is ongoing.

title: Radfahrer stürzt und verstirbt später im Krankenhaus
summary: A 67-year-old cyclist fell on a pavement without outside involvement and died later in hospital after resuscitation attempts. Police investigators are looking into the cause of death.

title: Brand in Einfamilienhaus – Mann tot aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out in a residential house in Wilhelmstadt, with six residents escaping unhurt. An 81-year-old bedridden resident was found dead in his room after the building burned almost completely.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen gewerbsmäßiger Hehlerei von Mehrwegpfandkisten
summary: Police executed four search warrants over suspected commercial handling of stolen reusable deposit crates, with two brothers aged 51 and 56 suspected. About 8,000 crates and around 950,000 euros in cash were seized.

title: Versuchter Autodiebstahl - Festnahme
summary: Three men attempted to steal a car in Zehlendorf using a radio-wave jammer but were disturbed and fled without loot. All three were arrested shortly afterwards.

title: Nationalsozialistische und antisemitische Parolen entfernt
summary: Unknown persons sprayed several National Socialist and antisemitic slogans on a station name sign at Ullsteinstraße subway station. Police removed the slogans after documenting them, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Autofahrer angegriffen
summary: After a honking dispute at a traffic light in Rummelsburg, an unknown driver allegedly cut a 23-year-old driver's finger with a knife. The victim was treated as an outpatient after an ambulance took him to hospital.

title: Während der Flucht auf Einsatzkräfte geschossen
summary: After a chase that began with reports of men with a gun, a passenger fired a handgun repeatedly at pursuing police officers, who were unhurt. Two men were arrested after hiding in a residential building's basement; one officer was injured during the arrest.

title: Einbruch in Feuerwehrwache
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into a fire station in Frohnau overnight and stole equipment and protective gear worth five-figure sum. The break-in was discovered by a caretaker on the morning of 5 March.

title: Waffen und Sprengstoff beschlagnahmt
summary: Police seized an unlawfully possessed firearm and black powder during a weapons storage inspection at a flat and vehicle of a 79-year-old man. The Berlin LKA is investigating under explosives and weapons laws.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Fußgänger an
summary: A 58-year-old woman driving a car reversed while pulling away from the kerb at a bus stop in Staaken and struck a 32-year-old pedestrian. The pedestrian fell onto the road and was taken to hospital with head and arm injuries.

title: Gedenkstätte mit antisemitischen Schriftzug beschmiert
summary: An antisemitic inscription was found sprayed on the outer wall of a memorial site in Neukölln. Police State Protection (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Vor der Polizei geflüchtet und festgenommen
