summary: A 29-year-old driver fled from police in a rental car at high speed in Niederschöneweide and was stopped after a chase. Officers found suspected narcotics and a knife in the car, and the driver was later released.

title: Mann nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A residential flat fire in an apartment building in Märkische Allee was discovered early in the morning. A 61-year-old man was found unresponsive, died later, and the cause of the fire is still under investigation.

title: Jugendliche beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 16-year-old girl was insulted and physically attacked over her headscarf on a pavement in Märkisches Viertel. The attacker tried to pull off the scarf, which was wrapped around her neck, causing her to be choked; the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Bilanz zur Verkehrssicherheitslage 2025 in Berlin
summary: Annual road safety review for Berlin covering 2025: 137,373 traffic accidents, 37 people killed and 1,840 seriously injured. Both the number of killed and seriously injured fell compared with 2024.

title: Schussabgaben im Volkspark Friedrichshain - Zeugenaufruf
summary: Shots were fired in Volkspark Friedrichshain in the early hours; a 50-year-old man was found with life-threatening gunshot wounds and taken to hospital. The 3rd Homicide Commission is investigating attempted manslaughter and seeks witnesses.

title: Mehrere Polizisten bei Festnahme verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man resisted arrest and kicked and hit police officers, injuring several of them. His father and an acquaintance then tried to stop the police measures with physical force, and officers used pepper spray.

title: Umzäunung des Görlitzer Parks beschädigt
summary: Overnight, damage was found on the fence of Görlitzer Park in Kreuzberg, including bicycle locks fitted to six access gates and adhesive in the locks. Police removed the locks so the gates could be closed, and a specialist unit is investigating.

title: Rettungskräfte mit Schusswaffe bedroht
summary: A man threatened emergency responders with a blank-firing pistol at an apartment in Hakenfelde after treating a domestic violence injury. He was arrested and the weapon was seized.

title: Verdacht des Fahrens unter Einfluss von Lachgas – Fahrer gestoppt
summary: Police stopped a 19-year-old driver suspected of driving under the influence of nitrous oxide after a witness reported erratic, speeding driving. The driver barricaded himself in the car, was arrested, and drugs-related containers were seized.

title: Versuchter Einbruch in Sicherheitsfirma
summary: Several men attempted to break into a security company's building in Lichtenberg overnight, damaging a fence and a fire door. They failed to get past a further security system and fled toward Buchberger Straße.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei auf der Autobahn
summary: A driver fled from a plainclothes police patrol on the A100 motorway after a speeding offence, driving on the hard shoulder and ramming two cars before escaping. Nobody was injured.

title: Raubüberfall auf Hotel – Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erledigt
summary: An armed man with a knife robbed a hotel reception at about 4:20 a.m. and fled by taxi. The suspect has since been identified, and the investigation continues.

title: Festnahme nach versuchtem Autoeinbruch
summary: A police officer on patrol arrested a 24-year-old suspected of attempting to break into a parked car with a tool. The suspect dropped the tool when the officer approached.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A 16-year-old e-scooter rider was hit by a car turning left at a junction in Reinickendorf and was injured. She was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Mann mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: After a dispute at a bar, a 27-year-old man was stabbed several times in the torso outside the bar in the early hours of the morning. He was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, and two other men were hurt in the same altercation.

title: Bei Verkehrsunfall tödlich verletzt
summary: A 29-year-old driver crashed a car into a tree on Aroser Allee in the early hours and died at the scene. Two passengers aged 29 and 30 were hospitalized with injuries.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Zugangstor im Görlitzer Park
summary: A swing gate at the Görlitzer Park access point was found damaged in the morning after its lower mounting bolt had been cut through with a tool. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach mutmaßlichem Rennen
summary: A 19-year-old driver rear-ended a car on Alt-Friedrichsfelde after a suspected street race with an unidentified vehicle. Two women were slightly injured and treated as outpatients; the driver's licence and car were seized.

title: Mutmaßlicher Raub
summary: Two 18-year-olds were robbed of cannabis in a landscape park, and one was chased, held down and choked while his phone was stolen. The suspects threatened to stab them; the victim was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Mutmaßlicher Raub mit Messer
summary: Three unknown men allegedly robbed a 20-year-old man of his backpack at knifepoint, and one of them injured him with a knife. The victim was treated as an outpatient and the investigation is ongoing.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt – mehrere Festnahmen
summary: Police and prosecutors executed nine search warrants in the Märkisches Viertel linked to a drug trafficking and robbery investigation, arresting six people. Several hundred grams of cocaine, about 2.5 kg of marijuana and cash were seized, and arrest warrants were issued for four suspects.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Wahlkreisbüro
summary: White paint graffiti was sprayed on a bench mounted on the wall of a constituency office in Wilmersdorf, damaging it. The police Staatsschutz (political crime unit) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mutmaßliche Autodiebe festgenommen
summary: A car was reported stolen overnight in Bohnsdorf. Police found the vehicle in a car park on Adlergestell and arrested three occupants aged 17, 21 and 27.

title: Autofahrer durch Personengruppe angegriffen
summary: A group attacked an 18-year-old driver in his car at the Mehringplatz/Friedrichstraße crossing around 11 p.m., smashing a window and beating and kicking him. The victim was taken to hospital with injuries to the head, arm and torso.

title: Festnahme nach mehreren Betrugsversuchen
summary: Two men were arrested after allegedly attempting purchases with stolen bank cards at shops on Alboinstraße. The 39-year-old allegedly drove a vehicle with stolen number plates and a forged driving licence.

title: Schockanrufe in russischer Sprache – hohe Schadenssummen in sehr kurzer Zeit
summary: Fraudsters posing as relatives and police made phone calls targeting Russian-speaking elderly residents, with about 20 cases and roughly 400,000 euros in losses in Berlin since January. In the example case, an 84-year-old in Spandau handed over cash to a courier after a fake traffic-accident bail scam.

title: Van-Fahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A 64-year-old van driver turning into a property driveway hit a 10-year-old boy walking on the pavement, who was run over by the van. The boy suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Frau nach Angriff verletzt
summary: A man punched a 41-year-old woman in the face outside a shop in Müllerstraße, then fled. He was arrested at Wedding subway station, and the woman was taken to hospital.

title: Festnahme nach Einbruch
summary: Two men aged 40 and 58 were arrested after breaking into a single-family house in Lankwitz, and searches of their homes found further evidence. Both were remanded in custody.

title: Brand in Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A fire broke out in a hallway of an apartment building in Steglitz on the evening of 24 February, and the building was evacuated. Three people were treated for suspected smoke inhalation, and 25 residents were placed in an emergency shelter.

title: Kind von Autofahrer angefahren
summary: A car driver hit a four-year-old boy crossing Hoeppnerstraße with his father and drove on without stopping after running over him. The child was taken to hospital with injuries and is not in danger of his life.

title: Mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 24-year-old woman with multiple stab wounds and a 24-year-old man with a leg stab wound were treated at a hospital in Mitte after an alleged attack in Neukölln by her former partner. A knife with blood traces was seized.

title: Frau bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 65-year-old driver lost control of his car while reversing into a roadside parking space on Grazer Damm after a medical emergency, running over his 59-year-old wife. She suffered multiple fractures and was taken to hospital.

title: Frau fremdenfeindlich beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A young woman was xenophobically insulted and hit on a bus in Steglitz; the attacker also insulted her at the Schloßstraße stop. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Drei Autos nach Brandstiftung nicht mehr fahrbereit
summary: Three cars were set on fire overnight in Neu-Hohenschönhausen after a man was seen at the first vehicle, who fled. All three cars were rendered undriveable and nobody was hurt.

title: Sicherheitsdienstmitarbeiter angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A 26-year-old resident allegedly stabbed a security guard at a refugee accommodation in Buch after being refused a cigarette. The guard was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.

title: Zigarettenautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a cigarette vending machine in Hellersdorf during the night. They took cigarette packs and fled, and nobody was hurt.

title: Kind angefahren und verletzt
summary: A 63-year-old driver hit a 13-year-old boy who ran onto the road past a stopped bus in Baumschulenweg. The boy was seriously injured in the head and taken to hospital.

title: Nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 35-year-old driver died after his car skidded and hit a tree on Mariendorfer Damm late at night. The road was closed in the stadteinwärts direction during the accident investigation.

title: Jugendliche mit Messer angegriffen
summary: Two teenage girls attempted to rob a 15-year-old and her 14-year-old friend at the Rathaus Spandau subway station, and the 15-year-old was threatened with a knife and injured on one hand. The attackers fled without loot.

title: Politisch motivierte Sachbeschädigungen an einem Bürokomplex
summary: Overnight, unknown persons smashed windows, sprayed red paint on signs and stole two flags at an office building of an insurance company in Adlershof. The police state-protection unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Zwei Festnahmen nach Geschäftseinbruch
summary: Two suspects, aged 17 and 15, broke into a shop in Wollankstraße early in the morning and stole the cash register. Both were arrested nearby shortly after fleeing.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall mit BVG-Bus
summary: A car crossed into oncoming traffic on Gatower Straße in Gatow and collided with a BVG bus, which then hit a tree. Thirteen people were injured, including the driver, and the road was closed for about eight hours.

title: Queerfeindlicher Angriff
summary: A 30-year-old woman was attacked on her way home in Kreuzberg at about 5 a.m. after being addressed about her appearance, and was seriously injured in the face. The police Staatsschutz (political crime unit) has taken over the investigation.

title: Auto nach Verkehrsunfall überschlagen – Fahrerin im Krankenhaus
summary: A car driver lost control after a collision with a minibus at a driveway exit in Alt-Hohenschönhausen and the car rolled over into the tram track. The 40-year-old driver was taken to hospital.

title: Spätkauf überfallen – Räuber mit Schusswaffe bewaffnet
summary: An unknown man threatened an employee of a late-night shop with a firearm shortly before midnight and demanded money and tobacco products. He fled after the employee activated the shutters, and the employee was unharmed.

title: Wohnungseinbrecher auf frischer Tat gefasst
summary: Three suspected burglars were caught in the act at a residential building in Charlottenburg after plainclothes officers observed them. Burglary tools and stolen goods from an apartment were found on them.

title: Schüsse mit Schreckschusspistole abgegeben
summary: After an argument on a sidewalk, a 22-year-old fired several shots from a blank-firing pistol past a 37-year-old man in the early hours. The 37-year-old reported ear pain but declined medical treatment; the suspect was taken into custody and later released.

title: Jugendliche fremdenfeindlich beleidigt
summary: A 45-year-old man insulted a 16-year-old girl with xenophobic remarks in Kreuzberg in the evening. Police took the suspect to a station, where he showed about 2.5 per mille alcohol, and the state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Transmann angespuckt
summary: A 32-year-old trans man was stopped and spat at by an unknown man at Rosenthaler Platz around 11:50. The police state Security Division (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation as a transphobic attack.

title: Angriff auf Besatzung eines Rettungswagens
summary: A 17-year-old was taken by ambulance crew to hospital when he attacked the two paramedics, hitting and biting them. The crew suffered wounds and had to end their shift; the suspect was police-restrained and later admitted to a psychiatric ward.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgänger an
summary: A 35-year-old driver turning left hit a 75-year-old pedestrian at the junction of Pablo-Neruda-Straße and Salvador-Allende-Straße in Köpenick. The pedestrian fell, suffered head injuries and is being treated in hospital.

title: Autofahrer flüchtete vor Überprüfung - Festnahme
summary: A driver fled a plainclothes police check at around 21:30, endangering other road users and dragging an officer along the car before being stopped and arrested. Cocaine and cannabis were found in the vehicle, and the driver had no valid licence.

title: Fußgängerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car collided with a 58-year-old pedestrian crossing Nonnendammallee in Haselhorst on the evening before publication. The pedestrian was injured in one arm and taken to hospital.

title: Raubüberfall – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: An unknown suspect pushed a 64-year-old woman off her rollator on the pavement and stole her handbag on 17 February 2026. A witness chased the suspect and recovered the bag; police are seeking information.

title: Ermittlungserfolg – Festnahmen und Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: Police with about 160 officers raided a venue on Wollankstraße and nearby locations in Gesundbrunnen, seizing five firearms. Three people were arrested and handed over to the BAO Ferrum task force.

title: Überfall auf Hotel
summary: A masked man threatened a hotel receptionist with a knife at around 2 a.m. and fled with cash. The 21-year-old employee was not injured.

title: Unfall beim Abbiegen
summary: A car turning left collided with an oncoming car at a junction in Buckow in the evening. Both drivers, a 31-year-old woman and a 26-year-old man, were injured and taken to hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit zwei Verletzten
summary: A 58-year-old truck driver struck two 39-year-old women standing behind his vehicle in Rahnsdorf, running over one woman's legs. Both women were injured, one requiring inpatient hospital treatment.

title: Transphober Angriff
summary: A 22-year-old man allegedly attacked a 40-year-old trans woman in Schöneberg late at night, hitting her on the head with a phone and insulting her. Police arrested him shortly after in a nearby snack bar; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Vermisster wieder da
summary: A 71-year-old man who went missing after leaving a hospital on 16 February 2026 has been found and is in hospital. The police had appealed for public help in the search.

title: Angriff auf ein Lokal – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Unknown attackers with hammers reportedly attacked the bar "Fischladen" and stole a banner before fleeing. The State Protection unit is investigating and seeks witnesses.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletzter Radfahrerin
summary: A car and a cyclist collided at a junction in Prenzlauer Berg around 10:40. The 37-year-old cyclist suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Kind nach Unfall im Krankenhaus
summary: An 82-year-old driver allegedly ran a red light on Landsberger Allee and struck a 37-year-old pedestrian and a four-year-old child crossing the road. The child was seriously hurt and taken to hospital, while the pedestrian was treated as an outpatient.

title: Mann mit Schussverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: Shortly after 3 a.m., a masked man allegedly shot a 19-year-old in the leg in Herbertstraße, Schöneberg, then fled by car. The injured man went to a nearby fire station and was admitted to hospital.

title: Autofahrer stößt mit Tram zusammen
summary: A 78-year-old car driver turning left collided with a tram on Allee der Kosmonauten in Marzahn. The driver and one passenger were injured, and tram traffic was interrupted until about 18:00.

title: Toilette besprüht und Jugendlichen geschlagen
summary: A 19-year-old man sprayed paint inside a public toilet and in the face of a 17-year-old in Karlshorst, then struck him twice in the face. The suspect was arrested and later released after identity checks.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 39-year-old woman died after her car crashed into a parked truck trailer on Hellersdorfer Straße. Her 13-year-old daughter was taken to hospital for observation.

title: Mutter und Kind nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A residential building fire in Friedrichsfelde killed a nine-month-old infant; the mother and five-year-old brother later died of their injuries. The cause is still under investigation by the state criminal police.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Fußgängerin verletzt
summary: A 20-year-old driver struck a 15-year-old pedestrian crossing the road in Neu-Höhenschonhausen on the evening before publication. The pedestrian suffered head and internal injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Lebensbedrohliche Verletzungen nach Schüssen auf Mann im Fahrzeug
summary: A 37-year-old man was shot several times from the pavement while sitting in a vehicle in Tegel and was seriously injured. He is now out of danger, and police are searching for the unidentified gunman, with a homicide unit investigating an attempted killing.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A 79-year-old driver hit a six-year-old girl who was crossing Buckower Chaussee in Lichtenrade. The child was taken to hospital with leg injuries.

title: Autofahrer nach Flucht und Verkehrsunfall festgenommen
summary: After fleeing a police vehicle check through several districts, a 23-year-old driver crashed into three cars under the Tempelhofer Damm motorway bridge and was arrested. Three other drivers were injured, one of them seriously enough to be admitted to hospital.

title: Schüsse auf eine Wohnungstür
summary: Unknown persons fired several shots at the front door of an apartment in a multi-family building in Köpenick. Nobody was in the apartment and nobody was hurt.

title: Autofahrerin fährt gegen Fußgänger
summary: A 35-year-old woman driving a Jeep hit a 60-year-old pedestrian while leaving a shopping centre car park onto Karl-Marx-Straße, and the car ran over him. The man suffered multiple fractures and internal injuries but is not in life-threatening danger.

title: Versuchter schwerer Diebstahl aus Pkw
summary: Two men aged 31 and 32 were arrested after attempting to steal from a parked car in Neukölln. Police also seized a signal jammer from one of them.

title: Drei Festnahmen nach Verdacht des Betäubungsmittelhandels
summary: Police arrested three men on suspicion of illegal drug trading after checks and searches in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, seizing cannabis, cocaine, MDMA, amphetamine and ecstasy. During the pursuit of one suspect, a police officer was injured after he tried to resist arrest.

title: Festnahmen nach schwerer Brandstiftung
summary: Two suspects, a 45-year-old woman and a 39-year-old man, were arrested after a serious arson fire in a 16th-floor apartment on Frankfurter Allee. Both were injured and treated at the scene.

title: U-Bahnwagons beschmiert - Festnahmen
summary: Two men were arrested after BVG staff saw them spraying graffiti on two subway cars at Spichernstraße station in the night to 9 February. The suspects fled into the tunnel and were caught at an emergency exit.

title: Räuberischer Diebstahl in Einkaufscenter – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 26-year-old man allegedly grabbed cash from a cash register drawer during a payment at a shopping centre and fled, but was detained by off-duty police officers who were lightly injured. The suspect was taken into custody and the investigation continues.

title: Gedenktafel zerstört
summary: Unknown perpetrators destroyed a memorial plaque at a Jewish cemetery in Mitte, leaving glass shards and a damaged metal frame. The police state security department (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Geldausgabeautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a cash machine inside a supermarket in Weißensee in the early hours and fled with the loot. The explosion heavily damaged the store's sales and entrance areas, and no one was hurt.

title: Nach Verkehrsunfall reanimiert
summary: A car driver suffered a medical emergency while driving on Altstädter Ring and the car crashed into a bus stop pole, median and embankment. The driver was resuscitated and both occupants were taken to hospital.

title: Vermisster junger Mann wieder da
summary: A 25-year-old man reported missing by relatives on 2 February 2026 has been found and is receiving medical treatment. He was believed to be in a psychological crisis.

title: Auf BVG-Bus geschossen
summary: Shots were fired at a BVG bus in Wilhelmstadt overnight, leaving a bullet hole in a side window. A passenger sitting behind the window was unhurt.

title: Schüsse auf Lokal
summary: Bullet holes were found in the door frame and transom of a bar on Konstanzer Straße, with the door frame apparently damaged days earlier and the transom shots reportedly fired overnight. No one was inside and nobody was hurt.

title: Verdacht auf ein Tötungsdelikt in Grünanlage
summary: A 40-year-old woman was found dead in a green area in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, and a 46-year-old suspect was arrested at the scene. The 1st Homicide Commission is investigating.

title: Mehrere Autos in Brand
summary: Several cars were set on fire in the Falkenhagener Feld area around 4 a.m. and burned out despite firefighting efforts. The flames also damaged five other vehicles parked nearby; the state criminal police fire unit is investigating.

title: Schüsse auf Bürogebäude
summary: Unknown person fired several shots at an office in Neukölln on the evening before publication. Bullet holes were found in an office door of a workshop; nobody was injured.

title: U-Bahnhof mit Farbe beschmiert
summary: A 50-year-old man was detained at Seestraße subway station after BVG security found a large multicolored graffiti on a wall. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mutmaßlich politisches Tatmotiv - Personengruppe greift zwei Männer an
summary: Around 17:00 a group of about six masked people allegedly chased and attacked two men, aged 20 and 22, at a subway station after they passed a Middle East-related demonstration. One attacker allegedly used a knuckle duster; the State Protection unit is investigating a politically motivated assault.

title: Bilanz zu gestrigen Versammlungen im Stadtgebiet
summary: Police used direct force to clear protesters from a road during a demonstration against a party event in Reinickendorf, with 30 arrests across several demonstrations in the city on the same day. One officer was hurt and one cyclist reported leg pain after a reported car collision.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Radfahrer und Tram
summary: A cyclist crossing against a red light collided with a tram on Schönhauser Allee in Prenzlauer Berg. A 65-year-old woman in the tram was slightly injured after the emergency braking and was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung durch Stichverletzungen
summary: A 19-year-old man was stabbed several times after being approached by a group of five masked youths at a bus stop on Sonnenallee. The attackers fled toward the Köllnische Heide S-Bahn station, and the victim underwent emergency surgery.

title: Mann nach mehreren Straftaten und Flucht vor der Polizei festgenommen
summary: A 31-year-old man broke into a flat, threatened and robbed the 45-year-old resident, then stole a vehicle and damaged a swimming hall before a chase and arrest. Police also found suspected narcotics and a police officer was slightly injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach Flucht vor Polizeikontrolle
summary: A car fleeing a police check crashed into an oncoming-priority vehicle on Salzufer and then damaged three parked cars. The two occupants fled on foot and the car was seized.

title: Verdacht des Arzneimittelhandels - Wohnungsdurchsuchung
summary: Police searched a flat in Hakenfelde on suspicion of illegal medicine trafficking after plainclothes officers found prescription drugs and a pepper spray and telescopic baton in a driver's car. A loaded service pistol that had been stolen from police 15 years earlier was found during the search.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren beschädigten Fahrzeugen
summary: A driver lost control of his rented car on Brunsbütteler Damm in Staaken and crashed into parked vehicles, pushing one into a residential building. The driver and his passenger were injured, and police are investigating suspected drunk driving and an illegal street race.

title: Fußgänger von Autofahrerin angefahren
summary: A 57-year-old woman driving a car struck a 64-year-old pedestrian crossing Heerstraße in Staaken early in the morning. The pedestrian suffered fractures and a head laceration and was taken to hospital.

title: Tote Person nach Feuer in einem Bungalow entdeckt
summary: A fire broke out in a bungalow in Altglienicke in the night, and firefighters found one dead person inside. Police arson investigators have taken over the ongoing inquiry.

title: Nach Einbruch Flüssigkeit verschüttet
summary: Unknown offenders broke into an office of a research institute in Adlershof overnight and forced open a safe, stealing precious metals. They poured a liquid over the scene, possibly to destroy evidence, before fleeing.

title: Polizisten bedroht – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät gegen Tatverdächtigen eingesetzt
summary: Police were called to a garden allotment hut after a threat report and a man was threatened officers. When he left the hut and ran at a policeman, he was hit with a stun device and arrested; he was taken to hospital.

title: Verdacht der Schussabgabe auf Lokal
summary: Suspected shot fired at a bar in Otto-Suhr-Allee around 3:20 a.m.; a bullet went through the metal cladding of the outer wall and lodged in the ceiling inside. No one was in the affected area and nobody was hurt.

title: Nicht angezeigte Versammlung im Zusammenhang mit einem Stammtisch einer Partei
summary: Police were called to a restaurant in Wittenau where people disrupted a political party's regulars' table and an unregistered assembly formed outside. Two people who sat down inside resisted when they were carried out, and the State Protection unit took over the investigation.

title: Geldautomatensprengung verhindert
summary: Unknown offenders attempted to blow up an ATM in Neu-Hohenschönhausen overnight, but fled when a security guard noticed them around 3:40 a.m. No explosion occurred.

title: Mann attackiert Frau in Wohnung
summary: A 50-year-old man attacked a 45-year-old woman in an apartment in Weißensee, stabbing her several times. The suspect was arrested at the scene and was about 1.4 per mille intoxicated.

title: Baucontainer und Mofa in Brand gesetzt
summary: An unknown person set fire to a moped and other items next to a construction container used as shelter by homeless people, and the fire spread to the container. No one was inside, and the fire brigade extinguished the flames.

title: Frau und Mann bei Raubüberfall verletzt
summary: Three masked men robbed a jewelry and watch shop in Rudow in the morning, dousing and beating the owner and a 57-year-old employee with an unknown liquid. Both victims were injured and treated as outpatients.

title: Mutmaßlicher Räuber durch Kopfhörer überführt
summary: An 18-year-old was robbed in Kreuzberg after being punched in the face and forced to withdraw more cash from an ATM. A 18-year-old suspect was arrested in Schleiermacherstraße with the stolen headphones and cash.

title: Brand in Wohnungslosenlager
summary: A fire broke out at a homeless encampment on Yorckstraße in Kreuzberg, spreading to a church door. Police suspect arson, and nobody was hurt.

title: Auseinandersetzung mit Messern
summary: A 19-year-old and a companion were attacked by a group of four men on Bismarckstraße, with knives, a glass bottle and pepper spray used. The 19-year-old was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Passant stellt mutmaßlichen Räuber - Festnahme
summary: A suspect shoved a 54-year-old shop owner during a meeting about a watch offered online and fled with the watch. A passer-by detained him in Zillestraße until police arrested him; a pocket knife was found on him.

title: Stein- und Flaschenwürfe bei Versammlung – Polizist verletzt
summary: During a demonstration in Wedding, participants threw stones, bottles and wooden slats toward a residential building, and a bottle hit a police officer on the head. Five people were temporarily detained and the State Protection unit took over investigations into riot charges.

title: Vermisste Frau wohlbehalten angetroffen
summary: A 61-year-old woman who had left her residential care facility in January was reported missing. She has since been found safe and is back at her facility.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe geschossen
summary: After an argument at the Warschauer Straße station forecourt, a 42-year-old man allegedly fired a blank-firing gun toward a 27-year-old's head. The 27-year-old was injured in the face and head and treated by paramedics; the suspect was detained.

title: Mann nach Schussabgaben tödlich verletzt – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 44-year-old man was fatally shot in his vehicle in Weißensee after shots were fired at a parked van from a passing car. The perpetrators fled, and the homicide unit is seeking witnesses.

title: Über die Fahrbahn gerannt - Autofahrer fährt zwei Kinder an
summary: A car driver hit two nine-year-old girls who ran into the road against a red pedestrian light at a junction in Wilmersdorf. Both girls were taken to hospital with their guardians.

title: Verkehrskontrolle entzogen – Fahrzeug beschlagnahmt
summary: A 43-year-old man fled a police traffic check at high speed, running red lights and driving onto the sidewalk, before crashing into a traffic light pole and a police car. Two police officers were hurt, and the car was seized.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A driver turning right hit a six-year-old boy crossing the road at a junction in Charlottenburg. The child was taken to hospital with a suspected leg fracture.

title: 21-Jähriger stirbt in Wohnung - Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 21-year-old man was found dead with stab wounds in an apartment in Mahlsdorf, and the homicide unit has taken over the investigation. A 30-year-old suspect was arrested near the scene.

title: Geschlagen und beschossen
summary: A man was punched in the face and then hit by a blank-firing pistol shot to the face in Reinickendorf after urinating against a residential building. He was taken to hospital for treatment.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A 52-year-old driver hit a seven-year-old girl who stepped onto the road from behind a stopped bus in Karow. The child suffered head injuries and the driver was also taken to hospital with chest pain.

title: Cannabisplantage und scharfe Schusswaffe festgestellt - Festnahme
summary: Police searched an apartment on Fasanenstraße after a citizen tip about hydrogen handling and found a cannabis plantation with over 30 plants, plus a firearm and ammunition. A 26-year-old resident was arrested.

title: Verkehrsunfall - Fahrradfahrer verletzt
summary: A 25-year-old cyclist turned left across several lanes on Heerstraße and collided with an oncoming van. The cyclist was injured and taken to hospital; the van driver was not reported hurt.

title: Jugendlicher verletzt und fremdenfeindlich beleidigt
summary: A 14-year-old was pushed and xenophobically insulted during an argument with a 45-year-old man, and a passing pedestrian then punched the man. The police Staatsschutz is handling the case.

title: Schüsse auf Restaurant
summary: Unknown persons fired shots at a restaurant on Oranienstraße overnight from Monday to Tuesday. Bullet holes were found in the front window on Tuesday morning and nobody was injured.

title: Brand in Krankenhauszimmer
summary: A fire broke out in a hospital patient room overnight, spreading from an object near the bed to the mattress. Fourteen people were injured, including the 71-year-old patient, emergency workers and hospital staff; police are investigating aggravated arson.

title: Computerbetrug
summary: Police seek a suspected member of a gang that committed computer fraud: on 14 July 2025 an unknown woman presented a forged passport at a bank branch and obtained an activation code for a business online banking account. The group then made unauthorized transfers of six-figure sums from the victims' accounts.

title: Zwei Autofahrerinnen und ein Beifahrer nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus
summary: Two women and a male passenger were injured in a collision at an intersection in Alt-Hohenschönhausen after a traffic light outage. One driver had no valid driving licence and faces an investigation for driving without a licence.

title: Volksverhetzung bei Gedenkveranstaltung
summary: A 59-year-old woman made antisemitic statements at a commemoration event for the liberation of Auschwitz and insulted a teenage participant. Police detained her at the scene and the State Protection unit is investigating.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: A car driver struck a pedestrian crossing Hohenzollerndamm in Wilmersdorf at about 7:15 p.m. The woman was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Mann leistet Widerstand – DEIG eingesetzt
summary: A 37-year-old man who was asked to leave a women's residence after 10 p.m. resisted arrest, and police used a stun device to subdue him. An officer was injured during the arrest and ended his shift.

title: Frau mit Kind vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 43-year-old woman took her seven-year-old son from in front of a day-care centre and left with him in an unknown direction. Police are searching for both, and a risk to themselves or others cannot be ruled out.

title: Zeuge hat sich gemeldet
summary: Two unknown men allegedly threatened a 28-year-old with a knife, assaulted him and robbed him of a bag, cash, jewellery and his phone. A witness sought in the case has since reported to a police station.

title: Verkehrsunfälle mit Fahrradfahrerin und BVG-Bus
summary: A 63-year-old driver hit a cyclist at a crossing and then collided with a waiting BVG bus while leaving the scene. The cyclist and the driver were injured and taken to hospital; bus occupants were unhurt.

title: Schüsse in Wohnung – mehrere Verletzte
summary: Several shots were fired in an apartment after a family dispute, injuring four people, two with life-threatening wounds. Attempted manslaughter investigations were opened by a homicide unit.

title: Spätkauf mit Schusswaffe überfallen
summary: A masked unknown man threatened a convenience store clerk with a firearm and took cash at around 20:45 in the evening. He then fled the shop.

title: In den Gegenverkehr geraten – Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren Verletzten
summary: A 66-year-old driver lost control of his car and crashed head-on into an oncoming vehicle driven by a 51-year-old woman in Zehlendorf. Three people were injured, one of them seriously enough to be taken to hospital.

title: Angriff mit politischer Tatmotivation
summary: Four men attacked a 29-year-old man in a supermarket queue after he asked them not to cut in line, insulting and punching him. Witnesses intervened, and the man was taken to hospital; the state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Beraubt und mit Messer verletzt - Notoperation
summary: Several unknown men robbed a 24-year-old man on a parking lot and stabbed him in the abdomen. The victim reached the bus station waiting hall, where passengers gave first aid until emergency services arrived, and he underwent emergency surgery.

title: Beifahrer im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A car crashed into a parked truck on Aroser Allee in the early hours and the driver fled the scene. The 16-year-old passenger, who was critically injured, died in hospital the following day.

title: DEIG-Einsatz gegen akut eigengefährdete Frau
summary: Police in Moabit used a taser against a 30-year-old woman who was threatening self-harm with a knife after a witness called for help. She was injured with a cut wrist, received first aid and was taken to hospital.

title: Trickdiebstahl in Wohnung – Seniorin bestohlen
summary: Two unknown women posed as cleaners and visited an 87-year-old woman in her apartment, then left and did not return. The woman later noticed cash and jewelry were missing.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletzter Autofahrerin
summary: A car pulling out of a parking space collided with a Smart on Potsdamer Chaussee in Nikolassee, and the Smart overturned. The female driver of the Smart was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man was stabbed in the abdomen and chest during an attempted robbery at a bus stop in Köpenick after refusing to hand over his belongings. He fled to his nearby apartment and was taken to hospital, where he was operated on.

title: Jugendlicher nach Starkstromschlag im Gleisbett verstorben
summary: A 17-year-old died after an electric shock on the track bed at Deutsche Oper underground station while trying to retrieve an object that had fallen there. Police found no indication of third-party involvement; the death investigation is ongoing.

title: Beschuldigter in Untersuchungshaft – Ermittlungen dauern an
summary: Two men posing as plainclothes police robbed a buyer of cash during a planned car purchase, then fled and threatened pursuers with a weapon. A suspect, later identified as an off-duty police officer, has been in pretrial detention since 17 January 2026.

title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen nach Angriff und Schussabgaben auf 31-Jährigen
summary: Multiple shots were fired at a 31-year-old man outside a convenience store in Spandau, and he was seriously injured. Police later searched 14 addresses citywide and arrested suspects on suspicion of attempted manslaughter.

title: Fußgängerin von Auto angefahren
summary: A 37-year-old driver struck a 55-year-old woman crossing Wiesenweg in Lankwitz while turning left. The woman was taken to hospital with head injuries.

title: Mitarbeiter eines Discounters überfallen
summary: Three men robbed a 37-year-old discount store employee after he locked up at night, forcing him to reopen the shop and hand over the takings. One of the attackers hit him repeatedly on the head, and he was taken to hospital.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler festgenommen
summary: Plainclothes officers arrested a 30-year-old suspected drug dealer in Moabit after he accelerated toward an officer during a traffic stop and resisted arrest. Cocaine-containing packages, cash and the car were seized.

title: Senior vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 73-year-old man with dementia has been missing since 11 January 2026. Police are asking the public for information on his whereabouts.

title: Unbekannter nach gefährlicher Körperverletzung gesucht
summary: An unknown man is sought after allegedly attacking two men aged 37 and 38 at Maaßenstraße corner Nollendorfplatz, punching and kicking them and hitting one with a sign stand. Police are investigating for dangerous bodily injury.

title: Fußgänger angefahren und verletzt - Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen
summary: A 72-year-old pedestrian was struck by a car while crossing Markstraße in Wedding on New Year's morning and suffered life-threatening injuries. Police are seeking witnesses and the driver of a ride-hailing car that was reportedly at the scene.

title: Raubüberfälle auf Tankstellen und Geschäfte – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Series of eight armed robberies at petrol stations and shops in Berlin between November 2025 and January 2026, committed by the same suspect who threatened staff with firearms or knives. Police are asking the public for information.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe verletzt und angefahren worden
summary: A 28-year-old man was hit in the arm after a starter-pistol shot was fired during an argument with two men in a car in Wedding. The man was then struck by an unrelated vehicle whose driver fled.

title: Mitarbeitende des BVG-Sicherheitspersonals angegriffen
summary: A group of seven men allegedly attacked four BVG security staff at Hermannplatz underground station after being asked not to smoke on the platform. Two of the staff were taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Fahrerflucht nach Fahrzeugkontrolle auf der A 100
summary: A driver fled a traffic stop on the A 100 motorway, dragging an police officer about ten metres and injuring his hand. The car was later found abandoned on a car park at Sachsendamm and seized.

title: Raub auf Spielcasino
summary: Two masked attackers used a pepper spray and an axe during a robbery at a casino in Reinickendorf overnight. A 53-year-old employee was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse auf Lokal
summary: Unknown perpetrators fired several shots at a closed café on Schönleinstraße around 3 a.m. Nobody was inside or hurt; bullet holes were found in the shop windows and cartridge cases on the pavement.

title: Mehrere Autos in Brand gesetzt
summary: Unknown perpetrators allegedly set three cars on fire on a residents' parking area on Am Rötepfuhl in the early morning. Two vehicles burned out completely and three further parked cars were damaged by heat; no one was hurt.

title: Sachbeschädigung mit homophoben Hintergrund
summary: An unknown person threw a paving stone through the glass door of an LGBTQ+ bar on Sachsendamm around 23:30. No one was hurt, and the State Security unit is investigating a suspected anti-gay hate crime.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: A car driver struck a 71-year-old pedestrian crossing the road in Marienfelde and then left the scene before later turning up at a police station. The pedestrian was taken to hospital with head and torso injuries.

title: Hitlergruß gezeigt und Bierflasche geworfen - Festnahme
summary: A man on a balcony allegedly gave a Hitler salute and made xenophobic remarks, then threw a beer bottle at a 17-year-old, hitting him in the head. He was arrested and later released, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Brandstifter festgenommen
summary: Burning debris was found and extinguished in front of a flat door on the 10th floor of an apartment building, and a 25-year-old suspected of arson was arrested. Nobody was injured.

title: Autofahrer fährt E-Scooter-Fahrer an – 22-Jähriger im Krankenhaus
summary: A car driver turned left against a ban and collided with an e-scooter rider crossing the road at about 1:40 a.m. The 22-year-old e-scooter rider was seriously injured and taken to hospital; the driver was not hurt.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall mit Straßenbahn verletzt
summary: A tram struck a 63-year-old pedestrian on Greifswalder Straße shortly after 1:15 a.m. The pedestrian suffered a head injury and was taken to hospital; the tram driver was treated for shock.

title: Sicherheitsvorfall an der iranischen Botschaft
summary: Six people repeatedly gathered outside the Iranian embassy in Dahlem and two of them climbed the fence, removed the Iranian flag and tried to hoist historical flags. Security staff used pepper spray; one man was slightly injured and the six suspects face charges including trespassing and property damage; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mann nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A kitchen fire broke out in a fourth-floor apartment in a residential building in Fennpfuhl, and a 44-year-old resident was found unresponsive. He died in hospital shortly afterwards; the investigation is handled by a fire unit of the LKA.

title: 73-Jährige tot geborgen
summary: A 73-year-old woman reported missing since 27 December 2025 was found dead in the Teltow Canal in Kleinmachnow. Brandenburg police are investigating, with no indication of third-party involvement so far.

title: Festnahmen wegen des Verdachts des illegalen Drogenhandels
summary: Police stopped a car in Neukölln overnight, found over 240 small bags of suspected cannabis, and arrested the two occupants, aged 17 and 19. Forged vehicle registration documents were also seized during searches of apartments.

title: Schlafende Wohnungslose attackiert
summary: A man attacked a 43-year-old woman sleeping on the ground near Alexanderplatz station around midnight, hitting and kicking her head and trying to take her sleeping bag. She fled before police arrived and the woman declined medical treatment.

title: Rettungsring in die Havel geworfen, Widerstand geleistet und Einsatzkräfte beleidigt
summary: Three young men were caught after taking a lifebuoy from the Havel bank and throwing it into the water. The youngest, 18, resisted arrest, insulted officers and was taken into custody; one officer was slightly injured.

title: Passanten und Einsatzkräfte angegriffen
summary: A 36-year-old man attacked a police patrol and bystanders after reporting an alleged theft of cash in Kreuzberg. He was arrested, sustained a facial injury, and is being investigated for incitement, assault and resisting officers.

title: Gestohlene Kopfhörer führten zu Drogen - Festnahme
summary: Police recovered stolen headphones in an apartment on Soldiner Straße and found over one kilogram of suspected heroin and cash. A 31-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of drug trafficking.

title: Festnahme nach Verdacht des Betäubungsmittelhandels
summary: Police arrested a 37-year-old driver suspected of drug trafficking after a traffic check in Halensee. Drugs and a knife were found on him and in the car, and two blank-firing pistols were later found during a search of his apartment.

title: Großflächige Sachbeschädigungen mit kommunistischen Symbolen und Parolen
summary: Unknown persons sprayed large communist slogans and symbols on building facades and a subway station exit in Lichtenberg. Police Staatsschutz (political crime unit) has taken over the investigation.

title: Festnahme nach Drogenhandel
summary: Plainclothes officers arrested a woman and two men on suspicion of drug trafficking after a car was stopped at a crossing in Charlottenburg. Cocaine, a knife, other drugs and packaging material were seized, and two officers were hurt during resistance.

title: Waffen in Bar gefunden
summary: During a premises inspection at a bar in Kreuzberg, police found several firearms with ammunition hidden in a pool table and arrested two men aged 27 and 29. The weapons, magazines and ammunition were seized.

title: Mehrere Verletzte bei Auffahrunfall
summary: An 80-year-old driver rear-ended a car waiting at a red light in Oberschöneweide, pushing it into a third vehicle. Three people were injured and taken to hospital, one person was unhurt.

title: Mieterin stirbt in brennender Wohnung
summary: A fire broke out in a second-floor apartment on Greifswalder Straße in Prenzlauer Berg. An 88-year-old tenant was found dead in the kitchen after firefighters extinguished the blaze.

title: Mutmaßliches Kokstaxi aufgespürt – zwei Festnahmen
summary: Plainclothes officers stopped a car in Uhlandstraße after noticing cannabis odour and found numerous dealing packets of cannabis, amphetamine, cocaine and ecstasy. Both occupants, aged 25 and 35, were arrested.

title: Mann verschanzte sich in Unterkunft - Festnahme
summary: A 51-year-old man barricaded himself in a room at a shelter in Westend; a SEK unit with a police dog arrested him after finding Molotov cocktails and preparation materials. He was bitten on an arm and taken to hospital.

title: Alleinunfall mit verletzter Person
summary: A 57-year-old driver lost control of his car while overtaking on Wilhelm-Kabus-Straße in Schöneberg, hitting a tree and a metal fence. The driver was injured and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt – 5. Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 47-year-old man was found bound and seriously injured in Görlitzer Park and left in the cold; a homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing. He was taken to hospital for treatment.

title: Trickdiebstahl bei Seniorin
summary: Two unknown men posing as a criminal police officer and an electricity network employee gained access to a 91-year-old woman's flat, obtained her PIN and stole her bank card. The pair fled in an unknown direction.

title: Zaunelement entwendet
summary: Unknown perpetrators removed a fence panel of about 2.4 by 2.5 meters at the entrance of Görlitzer Park overnight. A security employee noticed the missing panel around 22:15, and police searches of the area found no trace of it.

title: Mann bei Straßenraub verletzt
summary: Four unknown assailants attacked a 27-year-old man at a street corner in Spandau in the evening, beating and stabbing him before stealing his backpack and cash. The man was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment with bruises, contusions and cuts.

title: Einbruchsversuch - Festnahmen
summary: Police arrested four men after an attempted break-in at a cash machine in a power-outage area during a night patrol. Burglary tools were found in the car they were in.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgänger an
summary: A car driver lost control while swerving at a car pulling out and struck a 27-year-old pedestrian getting into a parked car in Wedding. The pedestrian suffered rib and pelvis fractures and underwent emergency surgery; the driver was also hurt and five parked cars were damaged.

title: Seniorin nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in a second-floor apartment in Zehdenicker Straße. The 91-year-old resident was found unresponsive and died despite resuscitation attempts.

title: Starkstromkabel angezündet – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Unknown perpetrators set several high-voltage power cables on fire near the Teltow Canal in Lichterfelde, causing a large-scale power outage. The state security unit is investigating and seeking witnesses.

title: Räuberische Erpressung bei Essenszustellung
summary: Two unknown men lured a 24-year-old delivery worker to a street under the pretext of a food order, held a knife to his neck and demanded his belongings and cash. The victim was not injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeibeteiligung
summary: A police vehicle using emergency rights collided with a car at the Cecilienstraße/Blumberger Damm crossing in Biesdorf. Four people, including the two occupants of the car and two police officers, were treated for injuries.

title: Schüsse auf Wohnungstür
summary: An unknown person fired several shots at an apartment door in an apartment building's stairwell on New Year's Eve. The residents were inside at the time, and nobody was injured.

title: Brand eines Obdachlosenlagers
summary: A tent fire broke out at a homeless encampment under a bridge on Lewishamstraße in the evening. Three men were rescued and nobody was injured, but nearly the entire camp burned down.

title: Kältebus eines gemeinnützigen Vereins in Brand gesetzt
summary: Arson was committed on a cold-weather bus of a charity on a parking lot in Lehrter Straße, and security staff held the suspect until police arrived. A 43-year-old man was arrested and is to be brought before a judge.

title: Polizist bei Fahrzeugüberprüfung mitgeschleift – Fahrer flüchtet
summary: During a vehicle check on Seestraße, a driver started his car and dragged a plainclothes police officer several metres before fleeing. The officer fell to the road and was injured.

title: Gesprengter Geldausgabeautomat
summary: An unidentified explosive detonated at a freestanding cash machine on Alt-Reinickendorf, causing heavy damage in the early morning. Two suspects fled toward Roedernallee; it is unclear whether any money was taken.

title: Geldausgabeautomaten aufgebrochen
summary: Unknown offenders broke into a supermarket in Köpenick overnight and heavily damaged a cash machine inside before fleeing with the loot. The Landeskriminalamt is investigating.

title: Bilanz der polizeilichen Maßnahmen zum Jahreswechsel 2025/2026
summary: Police report on New Year's Eve operations citywide: 35 officers injured, about 800 investigations opened, roughly 430 arrests, and 47 vehicles set on fire between 18:00 and 06:00. Many attacks on emergency crews with pyrotechnics were recorded.
